speakers.name: Nicola Favini
speakers.title: CEO
speakers.bio:
Nicola Favini is CEO of Logotel, an Independent Design Company. He works in strategy, consulting, and training, with a focus on Change Management and Sales Transformation. A pioneer in the design of platforms for digital collaboration within organizations, in 2001 he developed the first business communities in Europe and, over the past twenty years, has overseen their strategy and international expansion. A keynote speaker at conferences and seminars in Italy and abroad, he is the author of articles and contributions published on Weconomy (www.weconomy.it
) and in major national newspapers.

speakers.name: Lurie Galazzini
speakers.title: Presales Director
speakers.bio: Pre-Sales leader at Factorial, focused on helping sales teams turn product knowledge into real revenue. Works at the intersection of product, sales, and strategy to scale multi-product SaaS across Europe.

speakers.name: Cristiana Darra
speakers.title: Manager Solutions Consulting
speakers.bio: Born in Rome, where she earned a degree in Computer Science, she began her career in the IT industry working as a consultant and later as a solutions specialist for leading technology companies. Over the years, she has built strong expertise in Customer Experience technologies. Passionate about technology, innovation, and the practical application of artificial intelligence to business processes, she joined Genesys in 2019, a global leader in AI-powered experience orchestration solutions. Since 2021, she has been leading the Italian Solutions Consulting team, supporting organizations in designing intelligent, data-driven, omnichannel experiences.

speakers.name: Oreste Pollicino
speakers.title: Full Professor of Constitutional Law and AI Law, Bocconi University | Founder, Pollicino AIdvisory
speakers.bio: Oreste Pollicino is Full Professor of Constitutional Law and AI Regulation at Bocconi University and Director of the LL.M. in Law of Technology and Automated Systems. He is a leading European expert on digital governance, fundamental rights, AI, and disinformation policy. Pollicino serves in institutional and global advisory roles on AI regulation and digital rights frameworks.

speakers.name: Andrea Valletta
speakers.title: Head of Customer Success
speakers.bio: Passionate about product design and UX, I enjoy understanding needs, identifying opportunities, and transforming them into products that inspire people and—why not—make them a little happier.

speakers.name: Luca Nardone
speakers.title: Head of Artificial Intelligence
speakers.bio: Luca Nardone is Head of Artificial Intelligence at the Unipol Group. He leads initiatives for the development and adoption of AI in the insurance sector, with a focus on enterprise scalability, output reliability, security, and the transformation of processes through innovative solutions.

speakers.name: Sara Gaviano
speakers.title: Sr Solution Consultant
speakers.bio: Sara Gaviano is a Senior Solution Consultant at ServiceNow, where she helps organizations reimagine how work gets done by leveraging AI-driven workflows and intelligent automation. Working closely with business and IT leaders, she demonstrates how the ServiceNow platform can streamline complex processes, enhance employee and customer experiences, and drive measurable business outcomes.

speakers.name: Enzo La Rosa
speakers.title: Chief Executive Officer
speakers.bio: Enzo La Rosa is Co-Founder, CFO, and COO of ReQurv, with extensive experience in management control, project management, and AI solution development. He runs Studio La Rosa e Associati for business management, and is also a trainer, startup mentor, and Python programmer. He combines strategic vision, technical expertise, and strong communication skills in the field of innovation.

speakers.name: Federico Pinna
speakers.title: Head of Product Development
speakers.bio:
With 40 years of experience in coding and a background in international R&D across Italy and the UK, Federico Pinna is a former co-founder and CTO of Vivocha and now leads product development at Smile.CX.
Author of six patents, he combines lateral thinking with strong technical expertise to transform challenges into scalable platforms.

speakers.name: Giada Franceschini
speakers.title: AI Solutions Architect & Co-founder
speakers.bio: Giada Franceschini is Architect of Agentic AI Systems, AI Keynote and TEDx Speaker. Lecturer at IED, RUFA, and UNINETTUNO. Supports entrepreneurs and companies as a mentor, speaker, and advisor to turn artificial intelligence into a tangible competitive advantage. Leads AI implementation projects in SMEs and large enterprises.

speakers.name: Daniele Grandini
speakers.title: Chief Executive Officer
speakers.bio: Chief Executive Officer at Impresoft and CIO at Impresoft 4ward with over 30 years of experience in IT solutions. Team Leader in developing scalable multi-industry solutions. Microsoft MVP since 2009. Advocate of Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and GenAI. Speaker and author on AI, cloud, and datacenter topics.

speakers.name: Elvis Tusha
speakers.title: AI Consultant, Host
speakers.bio: Elvis Tusha is a consultant and advocate in the field of artificial intelligence. With a solid academic background and extensive experience in implementing AI solutions, he is dedicated to making artificial intelligence accessible and understandable. He shares his journey in AI and Data Science through educational and informative content, aiming to make artificial intelligence both accessible and comprehensible.

speakers.name: Alex Combessie
speakers.title: Co-founder & co-CEO
speakers.bio: As co-founder & CEO of Giskard, a Paris-based AI security company, Alex Combessie helps major European enterprises control GenAI operational risks. He works directly with clients like Michelin, BPCE, and SG to ensure the deployment of reliable and secure LLM applications.

speakers.name: Federico Tonioni
speakers.title: Partner
speakers.bio:
Over 20 years of experience as a presales engineer, technical project manager, and tech lead of unleashed dev teams.
• I have always worked on projects in digital marketing, e-commerce, enterprise content management, and customer data platforms.
• I play in Kozminski, the first Italian band to have been on Saturn.
• I haven’t written AI in any of the previous three lines. Ask me why.

speakers.name: Markus Tretzmüller
speakers.title: cortecs® | Building Europe’s AI Gateway
speakers.bio: Markus Tretzmüller is the founder of Cortecs AI, a University of Vienna spin-off specializing in NLP since 2021. Driven by his passion for European technological sovereignty, Markus and his team built Europe’s first and largest LLM routing platform. This work is paving the way for advanced multi-agent workflows and pushing the adoption of sovereign AI in Europe.

speakers.name: Nicoletta Tarducci
speakers.title: informatica in pensione, volontaria in associazioni del terzo settore, mi occupo di alfabetizzazione informatica.
speakers.bio: Information Science graduate with experience in telecommunications and IT at companies such as Olivetti, CSELT, and Noicom. After roles in engineering and training, since 2007 she has worked in the non-profit sector promoting inclusion and digital literacy, now also focused on AI.

speakers.name: Diego Lavezzi
speakers.title: AI Solution Manager
speakers.bio: AI Solution Manager and Innovation Advisor. I design and lead end-to-end AI initiatives, integrating strategy, processes, and operating models. I have over 20 years of experience in leading multidisciplinary teams and developing innovative solutions with a focus on value, sustainability, and people.

speakers.name: Antonio Di Marzo
speakers.title: Senior Director, Product Management
speakers.bio: Antonio Di Marzo is Senior Director of Product Management at EPAM, where he leads strategic initiatives related to the development and management of digital products. With an international background and solid experience in digital transformation, he supports global organizations in defining product strategies focused on value, innovation, and scalability. He works closely with cross-functional teams to translate complex business needs into concrete solutions, combining strategic vision, technological expertise, and a strong focus on market impact.

speakers.name: Fabio Oscari
speakers.title: CEO
speakers.bio: Quindi CEO Fabio Oscari, PhD, bridges top-tier research (UC Irvine, Columbia) with a decade of shop-floor experience at Luxottica & Riello. Today, he is revolutionizing production scheduling and execution for manufacturers worldwide.

speakers.name: Giacomo Giacopelli
speakers.title: EY Studio+ Italy Managing Partner
speakers.bio: He works on brand strategy, customer experience, technology, and AI transformation projects to accelerate organizational growth. He has over 15 years of experience in the consulting sector and joined EY in 2016. Since 2021, he has been appointed Europe West Customer & Growth Leader. Since 2025, he has been Managing Partner of EY Studio+ in Italy.

speakers.name: Natale Leoni
speakers.title: CTO
speakers.bio: CTO with a passion for innovation. From pharmaceuticals to fintech, from automotive to media & entertainment: I design AI, cloud, and complex system architectures. I turn technical challenges into scalable solutions that create tangible business impact.

speakers.name: Enrico Frascari
speakers.title: Technology innovation & AI evangelist
speakers.bio: Enrico Frascari is a manager with over 45 years of experience managing complex projects at numerous international companies. He began working in the field of artificial intelligence in the 1980s as head of Olivetti’s AI center and has followed its evolution ever since. Today, as a Senior AI Evangelist, he focuses on the ethics, culture, and adoption of artificial intelligence, supporting organizations and individuals through conferences, training programs, and strategic consulting.

speakers.name: Nicola Scarfone
speakers.title: Sr. Business Solutions Manager
speakers.bio: With over 15 years of experience in data-driven innovation, as a Business Solutions Manager at SAS he supports large Italian and European organizations in the industrialization of Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Analytics. With in-depth experience in the design and implementation of advanced analytical solutions, he works on the practical adoption of technologies such as Machine Learning, Generative AI, and Synthetic Data to transform complex data into scalable decisions and processes.A speaker and university lecturer, he focuses on making advanced AI technologies accessible and on guiding companies and professionals toward a strategic, responsible, and value-driven use of Artificial Intelligence.

speakers.name: Jacopo Nairoukh
speakers.title: Advisory Solution Consultant
speakers.bio:
Jacopo Nairoukh is an Information Technology professional with over 15 years of experience driving innovation at the intersection of technology and business. As an Advisory Solution Consultant at ServiceNow, he partners with organizations, with a focus on Financial Services, to streamline and modernize their business processes through
tailored, high-impact solutions. Results-driven by nature, Jacopo combines deep technical expertise with a strategic mindset to deliver measurable outcomes for his clients. He is actively engaged in the rapidly evolving landscape of AI and Generative AI, helping organizations harness these technologies to unlock new levels of efficiency, automation, and intelligent decision-making.

speakers.name: Antonio Giovinazzi
speakers.title: Pilota
speakers.bio: Antonio Giovinazzi is a Ferrari driver. Winner of the FIA World Endurance Championship™ in 2025 and of the 24 Hours of Le Mans™ in 2023. He represents Italian excellence in international motorsport.

speakers.name: Stefano Dindo
speakers.title: Head of Software Development
speakers.bio:
Head of Software Development di Var Group, dove guida progetti con una missione chiara:
ascoltare le idee virtuose delle organizzazioni e renderle possibili grazie alla tecnologia. Software
enthusiast nel senso più genuino del termine, ha fatto del codice e delle sue evoluzioni una vera
passione — da developer di cuore, prima ancora che da manager. Esperto di modernizzazione applicativa, sviluppo cloud native e metodologie DevOps e Agile, è convinto che il software ben fatto non sia solo uno strumento, ma un ponte tra mondi. È proprio questa visione che lo avvicina all'AI: non come fine a sé stessa, ma come leva per connettere persone e tecnologia in modo
più naturale, accessibile e inclusivo. Per Stefano, l'AI ha il potenziale di abbattere le barriere che da sempre separano chi "sa usare la tecnologia" da chi ne rimane escluso. Apple fan boy di lungo corso e osservatore attento del mondo tech, il suo motto: "Learn quickly & think well".

speakers.name: Nataliya Kosmyna
speakers.title: Research scientist
speakers.bio: Dr. Kosmyna, researcher at MIT Media Lab’s Fluid Interfaces group and Visiting Researcher at Google, is co-author of Your Brain on ChatGPT. At MIT, she designs and tests new hardware solutions and paradigms for various users and applications, with over 15 years of experience in BCI, AI, and HCI.

speakers.name: Francesco Zucchetta
speakers.title: Chief Innovation Officer
speakers.bio: Francesco Zucchetta is Chief Innovation Officer at Serenis, leading the adoption of new technologies and innovative initiatives. He oversees strategic projects and promotes the development of effective processes and solutions to support the company’s growth.

speakers.name: Gianmario Marongiu
speakers.title: CRM Advisory Solution Consultant
speakers.bio: Gianmario Marongiu began his career writing code on the shores of Sardinia. More than two decades later, his mission remains the same: translating technological complexity into operational clarity. With a deep-rooted background in Cybersecurity, Digital Identity, and Enterprise Platforms, Gianmario has built his career around the human outcome at the end of every workflow. Today, as a CRM Advisory Solution Consultant at ServiceNow, he helps enterprises move past traditional silos to embrace a broader definition of AI. His vision is to move beyond simple automation toward a world where AI agents reason, plan, and act, transforming the CRM from a system of record into an intelligent engine of action.

speakers.name: Carlo Di Fiore
speakers.title: Country Manager Italia
speakers.bio: Sales and business development expert with over 20 years of experience in ICT, telecommunications, A/V, Fintech, and healthcare/pharma, currently focused on developing and strengthening the Italian market for SaveFamily, a European brand of technological solutions for the safety of families and the elderly.

speakers.name: Ignasi Barri
speakers.title: Global Head of AI & DATA | Regional Head of Business Development (Western and Continental Europe)
speakers.bio: Ignasi Barri is Business Development Leader at GFT Europe and Global Head of Data & AI. With over 10 years of experience in IT consulting, he leads AI- and Cloud-based digital transformations across various industries, standing out for his ability to integrate technology, design, innovation, and market strategy into solutions with measurable impact.

speakers.name: Umberto Pardi
speakers.title: Chief Revenue Officer
speakers.bio: Umberto Pardi leads the development and execution of sales strategies for key artificial intelligence sectors at Expert.ai, supporting the alignment of offerings with market needs, from positioning to go-to-market. He is CEO and shareholder of Payglobe Srl and a member of the boards of directors of GUM Group SpA and FINIX.

speakers.name: Mirko Gilioli
speakers.title: Lead Google Cloud Instructor
speakers.bio: Google Developer Expert (GDE) in AI/ML & Cloud | Lead Trainer at Datatonic Academy Mirko brings over 15 years of technical training expertise. Specialized in democratizing complex cloud technologies, he focuses on the practical application of Data and AI tools to solve business challenges.

speakers.name: Henri Allegra
speakers.title: Founder & Programme Lead
speakers.bio: Founder and Programme Lead of Homo Promptus, Henri Allegra helps leadership teams drive deep cultural, organisational, and cognitive transformation by building augmentation cultures and innovative practices through human-centred, inclusive, responsible, and intentional AI adoption.

speakers.name: Giacinto Fiore
speakers.title: co-Founder
speakers.bio: He founded “IA Spiegata Semplice”, the largest Italian community—and eponymous podcast—on Artificial Intelligence dedicated to Entrepreneurs and Managers. He is among Italy’s leading experts and speakers on A.I., and his talks aim to foster understanding and awareness of the tremendous potential Artificial Intelligence can bring to the business world. He is also a co-organizer of AI WEEK, the largest event in Europe dedicated to Artificial Intelligence.

speakers.name: Andreas Unger
speakers.title: CDO, Head of AI Development
speakers.bio:
Andreas Unger is Head of AI Development at BWO Systems AG, where he shapes the technological vision in tandem with its operational realization. At the intersection of the Chief Digital Office and the engineering organization, he leads the strategic AI agenda and translates it into scalable, production-grade systems.
He stands for an AI architecture that is not merely implemented, but consciously conceived, designed, and guided in its societal impact. With deep expertise in machine learning, large language models, agentic systems, and platform architectures, he orchestrates the full lifecycle of intelligent systems — from data strategy, modeling, and training to MLOps, governance, and secure integration into mission-critical enterprise environments.

speakers.name: Gerasimos Marketos
speakers.title: Chief Product Officer
speakers.bio: Gerasimos Marketos is CPO at HTB, where he leads product strategy, platform innovation, and the company’s AI initiatives. He's responsible for shaping the evolution of a global cybersecurity training platform that develops cyber capabilities for both humans and agents. He operates at the intersection of cybersecurity, data, and product, with extensive experience in cybercrime and fraud prevention.

speakers.name: Udo Würtz
speakers.title: CTO
speakers.bio: Udo Würtz is CTO of FSAS European Platform Business (Fujitsu) and a Fujitsu Fellow for his role as a technology thought leader. A top management advisor on generative AI, quantum computing, and software-defined data centers, he has extensive experience as a CIO, CEO, and global speaker.

speakers.name: Emma Marcandalli
speakers.title: Managing Director e membro del Management Team Italia
speakers.bio: Head of the Products & Services Business Area, which includes solutions in Audit & Compliance, Risk & Sustainability, Digital Transformation, and Business Performance Improvement for clients in the industrial, manufacturing, and non-financial services sectors.

speakers.name: Jinxia Niu
speakers.company: The California Initiative for Technology and Democracy
speakers.title: Advisory Council Member
speakers.bio: Jinxia Niu is Senior Program Manager of Digital Engagement at Chinese for Affirmative Action, leading work on media, tech, and social justice with a focus on disinformation and digital impact.

speakers.name: Stefano Spinelli
speakers.title: Sales Director
speakers.bio: Stefano, Sales Director at altermAInd, has over 10 years of experience in IT and digital transformation. Specialized in the banking sector, he has led complex projects in credit. He combines strong technological expertise with a results-driven sales approach.

speakers.name: Francesca Fortunato
speakers.title: Senior Data Science Solution Designer
speakers.bio: Senior Data Scientist & Presales Consultant at Var Group, PhD in Statistics. I support companies in the adoption of AI, from use case definition to implementation, ensuring data quality and measurable value.

speakers.name: Francesco Cabras
speakers.title: Head of Cloud & AI
speakers.bio: Entrepreneur in the software and IT sector. Expert in software architecture and data-driven solutions on cloud, generative AI and complex systems for industrial contexts.

speakers.name: Shiran Brodie
speakers.title: Head of Marketing & Growth at Softr
speakers.bio: Shiran Brodie is Head of Marketing & Growth at Softr, the AI platform for building business software. Previously Head of Marketing at Make, she brings 10+ years leading full-funnel marketing and GTM strategy, with a passion for launching products that help people create their own tools and systems.

speakers.name: Antonio Nannotti Nannini
speakers.title: IT Operation Manager - Human Company
speakers.bio:
Antonio Nannotti Nannini is IT Operations Manager at Human Company, where he coordinates digital innovation projects in hospitality services, including initiatives in conversational AI and automation.
He focuses on technology integration and the improvement of operational processes aimed at enhancing customer experience.

speakers.name: Alessandro Pirozzi
speakers.title: Product Manager
speakers.bio: Alessandro Pitozzi leads AI product strategy with a focus on Generative AI. Formerly a Mathematical Model Developer, he has built predictive systems and optimization algorithms, combining a strong background in mathematical engineering with a strategic business vision.

speakers.name: Vladimir Grankovsky
speakers.title: Co-founders at Callable* and Hidoba Research
speakers.bio:
Vlad holds a Master’s degree in Computer Science. He has expertise in machine learning and neuroscience, taught programming at a high school, and served as a judge for Computer Science Olympiads.
He is the co-founder of Callable, a platform that enables human experts to create AI clones of themselves.

speakers.name: Luca Barbazza
speakers.title: COO
speakers.bio: Quindi Co-Founder & COO Luca Barbazza, PhD, blends elite research (Columbia, DTU, Zegna Scholar) with hands-on tech strategy & deployment. Today, he drives manufacturing excellence by optimizing plant-level live decisions and human-machine collaboration.

speakers.name: Massimo Ruffolo
speakers.title: Founder & CEO
speakers.bio: CEO of Altilia, a deep-tech company that democratizes Agentic AI for the automation of complex processes. A CNR researcher with over 20 years of experience in ML and NLP, he combines the rigor of an academic career with the leadership of intelligent solutions at an international scale.

speakers.name: Giuseppe Perrone
speakers.title: AI & Data Consulting Leader
speakers.bio: With over 15 years of global experience, Giuseppe Perrone is a Partner at EY, where he leads the Technology AI & Data team in Italy and serves as Blockchain Leader for EMEIA. He holds a degree in Management Engineering from the University of Rome Tor Vergata and is an expert in emerging technologies, AI, blockchain, and digital transformation. He has led the development of new services and technological solutions to support business transformation across multiple industries, including consumer products, automotive, energy, financial services, and the public sector. He launched the world’s first blockchain-based traceability solution for the wine supply chain and teaches in specialized master’s programs at the University of Rome Tor Vergata, Luiss Business School, and Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore in Milan.

speakers.name: Geo Ceccarelli
speakers.title: founder i-broS™
speakers.bio:
Geo Ceccarelli is a professional with over twenty-five years of experience in creativity, strategy, and technology, gained at leading agencies such as McCann, Leo Burnett, and TBWA. With a C-level profile, he specializes in MarTech and applied artificial intelligence, having contributed to the development of one of the first hybrid AI systems.
He is the author of the book Marketising and a well-regarded keynote speaker on innovation, marketing, and branding.

speakers.name: Mario Paiano
speakers.title: Coordinator and Developer of AI Professionalization in Education
speakers.bio: Mario Paiano works at Fontys Education as a coordinator and developer of AI education and professionalization. He is responsible for the design, content, and continuous development of AI-related learning for both internal staff and the broader educational field. His work includes developing an 18-week specialization program and a graduation track focused on AI for teachers, alongside his roles as lecturer and speaker. His focus is on improving how people learn with AI, not by making things faster, but by making learning more meaningful. He examines how AI can support deeper understanding, reflection, and skill development, and where it genuinely adds value in the learning process. At the same time, he explores how AI reshapes the role of the teacher: what should remain human, what can be supported by AI, and how educators can create more space for guidance, coaching, and real interaction. A central theme in his work is shifting students from passive consumption back to active creation. He designs learning experiences where AI functions as a thinking partner rather than a shortcut, pushing students to engage, produce, and think critically. With a background in media design, marketing, and pedagogy, he connects technology to what matters in education: growth, dialogue, and ownership of learning. His work is grounded in practice, focusing on what actually works in real educational contexts.

speakers.name: Vladimir Tsaganov
speakers.title: Head of AI Products and Solutions
speakers.bio: Vladimir Tsaganov is Head of AI Products and Solutions at Alibaba Cloud, leading the development and adoption of advanced AI products to transform business processes and drive innovation in areas such as sports technology and cloud‑based digital solutions.

speakers.name: Daniele Pucci
speakers.title: CEO
speakers.bio:
Daniele Pucci is CEO of Generative Bionics, a spinoff of the Istituto Italiano di Tecnologia.
With a PhD in Control Engineering, he has led research on humanoid robotics, including iCub and jet-powered flying robots.
Named MIT Technology Review’s Innovator Under 35 Europe, he has managed interdisciplinary teams and international projects.
Under his leadership, Generative Bionics raised €70M to develop humanoid robots for manufacturing, healthcare, and surveillance.

speakers.name: Matteo Russo
speakers.title: Head of Digital Communication & Content Hub
speakers.bio: He works on integrating Artificial Intelligence and Generative AI into corporate communication. He has a background in Cyber Security and IT, which informs his strategic approach to innovation, content, governance, and digital transformation.

speakers.name: Antonio Lanza
speakers.title: Head of Product and R&D Team
speakers.bio: Chief Growth Officer with 20 years of experience in Sales and Finance. He leads Altilia’s commercial expansion, supporting global institutions in adopting Agentic AI to evolve decision-making models and enable intelligent process automation.

speakers.name: Massimo Canducci
speakers.title: Innovation & Strategy Director in Spindox
speakers.bio:
Massimo Canducci is Innovation & Strategy Director at Spindox.
A manager, technologist, and essayist, he is part of the Global Faculty at Singularity University, with a particular focus on innovation, the future, and exponential technologies.
A keynote speaker at national and international conferences, he is a professor in the Executive MBA Ticinensis and teaches Innovation Management at the University of Turin.
He is also a member of the Advisory Group “Standardization for Emerging Technologies and Innovations,” which helps guide ISO’s global strategic direction on emerging technologies and innovation.
His latest essay, Artificial Empathy – How We Will Fall in Love with Machines and Why They Will Not Love Us Back, published by Egea Editore, is currently available in bookstores.

speakers.name: Massimiliano Calipari
speakers.title: CTO
speakers.bio: CTO, Senior Software Architect, and Agile Leader with nearly 20 years of experience, specialized in microservices architectures, software development, managing multidisciplinary teams, and delivering innovative products using Agile methodologies.

speakers.name: Andrea Corain
speakers.title: Principal Solution Engineer
speakers.bio: Andrea Corain is a Principal Sales Engineer at UiPath with 25+ years in IT, specializing in DATA, Automation, and AI for business processes. He excels in designing innovative architectures for digital transformation and leads enterprise-level technical solutions with proven expertise.

speakers.name: Jaron Hirschhuber
speakers.bio: 14-year-old Co-Founder of 241.travel, leading creative direction and marketing. Focused on brand, user experience, and growth strategies. Co-develops AI-driven concepts and product ideas together with the AGI241labs team.

speakers.name: Nicola Picco
speakers.title: Chief Revenue Officer
speakers.bio: Nicola Picco is Chief Revenue Officer at Datlas. speakers.name: Luana Lavecchia
speakers.title: Head of Government Relations Italy, Greece, Malta and Cyprus
speakers.bio:
Luana Lavecchia is Senior Public Policy & Government Relations Manager for Italy and Greece at TikTok.
With a background in public affairs consulting across tech, media and telecoms, she leads institutional engagement and policy dialogue on regulatory, safety and digital innovation issues.

speakers.name: Giuseppe Tortorelli
speakers.title: CTO e Co-fondatore
speakers.bio: Computer engineer specialized in AI and computer vision. Designs and deploys deep learning systems for automated visual analysis, managing architecture, training, deployment, and monitoring of AI models on real-world use cases.

speakers.name: Alex Ball
speakers.title: Senior Vice President
speakers.bio: Alex Ball is Senior Vice President, Genesys Cloud, overseeing global commercial operations and security, privacy, and compliance teams. With over a decade of leadership experience across customer success, sales, and product at Genesys, as well as leadership roles at Infobip and Twilio, Alex brings a broad perspective on customer and employee experience transformation.

speakers.name: Guido Scorza
speakers.title: Avvocato, Docente di privacy e diritto delle nuove tecnologie, giornalista
speakers.bio: Guido Scorza is an Italian lawyer specializing in digital law and personal data protection. He works on technology regulation, privacy, and compliance, and is active as a consultant, speaker, and academic contributor in the field of digital rights and innovation.

speakers.name: Armando Crisafo
speakers.title: Sr Advisory Solution Consultant, Security Solutions
speakers.bio: Armando Crisafo is an Advisory Solution Consultant at ServiceNow, specializing in Security Operations with over eight years of hands-on experience. Through his presales work, he guides organizations in adopting AI-powered security solutions — from automated vulnerability management to intelligent incident response — helping customers strengthen their security posture and reduce risk exposure.

speakers.name: Andrea Spanò
speakers.title: Machine Learning & Computer Science Expert
speakers.bio: Andrea is a Data Scientist at SDG Group with over three decades of expertise spanning traditional statistics, machine learning, and deep learning. He currently specializes in Generative AI, where he builds robust, scalable, and reproducible analytical pipelines to support data science initiatives.

speakers.name: Virginia Padovese
speakers.title: Managing Editor & Vice President Partnerships, Europe

speakers.title: CEO
speakers.bio: Giovanni Bennato is an industrial engineer with nearly 20 years of experience in digital marketing. After leading several digital development companies, in 2017 he founded Aimage, one of the first Italian startups specializing in conversational AI applied to digital communication.

speakers.name: Hovig Etyemezian
speakers.title: Head of Innovation
speakers.bio: Hovig Etyemezian is currently Head of UNHCR Innovation. He is passionate about equality in rights, equity, solutions, peace and humanitarian response. For most of his adult life, he has worked with and for refugees and forcibly displaced communities.

speakers.name: Claudio Ferraris
speakers.title: Chief AI Engineer
speakers.bio: Electronic Engineer with strong Experience in System and Software development in Space and Defense sectors. In AVIO since 2011, today I work as System Engineer Manager and I’m in charge of the coordination of System Engineering activities for development programs and for mission preparation. I am also responsible for the development of AI-based algorithms for the optimization of company processes.

speakers.name: Mauro Panigatti
speakers.title: Group Manufacturing & Logistics Director di Bianchi Bicycles
speakers.bio: Bianchi Bicycles Group Manufacturing & Logistics Director Mauro Panigatti blends deep operations expertise with strong manufacturing digitalization skills. Today, he drives Bianchi’s production efficiency and innovation by implementing Lean principles and advanced tech systems (MES, WMS, AI).

speakers.name: Marco Barra Caracciolo
speakers.title: CEO e Chairman
speakers.bio: Marco Barra Caracciolo was born in Benevento in 1967 and holds a degree in Electronic Engineering. Since 2019, he has served as Chief Information Officer of the Italgas Group, leading the company’s IT strategy and digital transformation program. Since July 2021, he has also been CEO and Chairman of Bludigit SpA, the digital company of the Italgas Group. In the past, he built extensive experience within the Enel Group, taking on increasingly senior responsibilities across various areas before joining the ICT division (Global Digital Solution) in 2012.

speakers.name: Advait Sarkar
speakers.title: Senior Researcher
speakers.bio: Advait Sarkar is a Senior Researcher at Microsoft, specialized in human-computer interaction, artificial intelligence, and programming languages. He studies the impact of generative AI on knowledge work and develops tools to support and enhance human thinking.

speakers.name: Tinnix J. He
speakers.title: Co-founder at Callable
speakers.bio: Tinnix has a Masters in Landscape Architecture and loves design, nature and robots. She has built a humanoid robot that was invited international high-level conferences and summits. She is now building Callable, a platform that allows people to interact with experts through their voice AI personas.

speakers.name: Edoardo Scotti
speakers.title: Co-founder
speakers.bio: Edoardo Scotti has a background in cinema and audiovisual production. After training in film directing in the United States and years of experience in Italian television productions, he now works in creative direction, relations, and new business development. He is co-founder of Thousand Dreams, an Italian AI studio dedicated to the production of audiovisual content.

speakers.name: Elisabetta Rotolo
speakers.title: CEO, Founder, Creative and Executive Producer
speakers.bio: Elisabetta Rotolo is a creative strategist, Art Director and executive producer working at the intersection of immersive arts, XR, AI, and spatial computing. She is the Founder and CEO of MIAT – Multiverse Institute for Arts & Technology – a pioneering hub merging an Immersive Academy, Studio and Research. Elisabetta leads cutting-edge immersive productions and international training programs, and is a sought-after keynote speaker shaping the future of AI-driven creativity and experiential storyliving.

speakers.name: Giovanni Nicolosi
speakers.title: Co-Founder
speakers.bio: Giovanni Nicolosi operates at the intersection of product design, strategy, and AI. He designs digital products and experience systems with a concrete approach focused on performance and quality. He is co-founder of Thousand Dreams, an Italian AI studio dedicated to the production of audiovisual content.

speakers.name: Mark Mettler
speakers.title: Lecturer, Educational Innovator & AI Specialist in Technical Education
speakers.bio: Mark Mettler is a lecturer, educational innovator, and AI specialist at Fontys University of Applied Sciences, where he operates at the intersection of technology, creativity, and teacher education. He is actively involved in the Teacher Training Program for Technical Vocational Education, where he educates future teachers within the domains of Media, Design & ICT (MVI) and Dienstverlening & Producten (D&P). In addition to his current teaching responsibilities, Mark is closely involved in the development of a new specialization focused on Artificial Intelligence in education. This emerging track, set to launch in February, aims to prepare future educators to effectively integrate AI into their teaching practice and to train a new generation of AI-literate teachers. Within Fontys Educatie and the Fontys Educational Center (FEC), Mark contributes to educational innovation by exploring and implementing technologies such as generative AI, extended reality (XR), and blended learning. He designs and facilitates professional development programs, supports implementation processes, and collaborates with multidisciplinary teams to translate technological advancements into meaningful educational applications. Mark is an active member of initiatives such as MDT Blended Learning and the Generative AI Community, where he co-develops workshops and innovation trajectories for educators. His work focuses not only on technology adoption, but also on fostering creativity, critical thinking, and an explorative mindset in education. He has contributed to international conferences and collaborations on AI in education, sharing insights and practical approaches to innovation. Mark approaches his work as a collaborative innovator, positioning himself as a connector and co-creator within educational ecosystems rather than a traditional project leader.

speakers.name: Chester Wisniewski
speakers.title: Global Field CTO
speakers.bio:
Chester Wisniewski is Director, Global Field CTO at Sophos, a global leader and innovator in advanced security solutions to neutralize cyberattacks.
With over 25 years of experience in cybersecurity, his interest in security and privacy dates back to the 1980s, when he learned hacking by reading text files on bulletin board systems—a passion that has stayed with him ever since. Chester collaborates with Sophos X-Ops researchers worldwide to analyze the latest trends, research, and behaviors of cybercriminals. This perspective helps deepen the industry’s understanding of evolving threats, attacker tactics, and the most effective defense strategies.
Having previously held roles in product management and sales engineering, he now applies this experience to help organizations design enterprise-scale defense strategies and develop security roadmaps with some of the world’s largest brands. Based in Vancouver, Chester is a regular speaker at industry events including RSA Conference, Virus Bulletin, and Security BSides across multiple cities worldwide. He is widely recognized as a leading cybersecurity researcher and is frequently cited by major media outlets, including BBC News, ABC, NBC, Bloomberg, The Washington Post, CBC, and NPR.

speakers.name: Gabriele Gaetano Fronzé
speakers.title: CEO
speakers.bio: Gabriele Fronzé is the CEO and co-founder of Elemento Cloud. With a background in physics and scientific research, he now leads the development of cloud infrastructures—open, efficient, and scalable solutions that enable operators to build and manage their own cloud.

speakers.name: Paolo Crivelli
speakers.title: Regional Technical Sales Director South Europe and Middle East
speakers.bio:
Paolo Crivelli is Regional Technical Sales Director for South EMEA and the Middle East at Denodo, where he leads technical and pre-sales strategies to support customers in their digital transformation journey with “AI-ready” solutions that deliver contextualized, secure, and hyper-personalized data.
With over 25 years of experience in the IT sector, before joining Denodo he held key roles at IBM, contributing to strategic projects in Data Integration, Data Quality, Cloud Analytics, Artificial Intelligence, and Cognitive Collaboration, further strengthening his expertise in the design and implementation of complex data architectures.

speakers.name: Vincenzo Savarese
speakers.title: Senior Solution Engineer
speakers.bio: Within SAS’s Financial Services team, Vincenzo supports leading Italian organizations in implementing and delivering high-impact Data & AI solutions, with a particular focus on Generative AI, AI Agents, and MLOps.

speakers.name: Pietro Alberto Rossi
speakers.title: CEO
speakers.bio: Passionate about programming since the age of 11, he has gained significant experience in the IT sector through numerous roles in both public administration and private companies. An active member of the Italian startup ecosystem, he has participated in several Startup Weekends as both a participant and a coach. He is currently exploring fast-growing fields such as Business Intelligence, Data Analysis, and Machine Learning.

speakers.name: Christian Scquizzato
speakers.title: AI & Data Sense Presales Manager
speakers.bio: For over 20 years, he has been turning data, technology, and strategy into value for companies and teams, guiding the conscious and scalable adoption of AI. An expert in innovation and Data & AI, he has created solutions and frameworks such as BIDx and provides training on reliable AI, data governance, and digital strategies.

speakers.name: Alessia Preda
speakers.title: CCO & Board Member
speakers.bio: Alessia Preda is the CCO and Board Member of LivingMedia, with extensive experience in corporate consulting and training. Specializing in professional development, Alessia provides support in human resources, marketing consulting, public relations, and corporate event management. Her expertise enables her to guide companies in improving internal performance and creating effective strategies for growth and visibility.

speakers.name: Marco Ferioli
speakers.title: DHL Head of IT Program Management
speakers.bio:
Passionate about Technology applied to Logistics world,  I'm the key enabler to help business to bring ideas to life, in a competent,concrete and innovative mood.

I strongly believe in a better future for all, let's work together to have it Greener, more Respectful and Inclusive for everyone.

speakers.name: Mattia Gallegati
speakers.title: AI Solutions Leader
speakers.bio: With a solid methodological and architectural approach, Mattia Gallegati has for years led strategic initiatives in data and Artificial Intelligence for leading industrial, banking, and insurance organizations. Passionate about open-source technologies and innovation, he is now a key reference for the strategic and technical leadership of AI initiatives at GFT Italia.

speakers.name: Luca Coppo
speakers.title: CTO | Tech lead @ ATS - Base Digitale Group
speakers.bio: Expert in cloud-native architectures and distributed enterprise systems, with skills in microservices and micro frontends, Kubernetes, and DevOps. Currently focused on Generative AI, agents, and agentic software engineering.

speakers.name: Evan Reiss
speakers.title: SVP, Head of Marketing
speakers.bio: Evan Reiss is an Atlanta-based marketing executive currently leading international marketing at Foxit PDF Software, where he champions AI-driven marketing growth strategies. Evan is particularly passionate about how CMOs modernize their tech stacks and how AI can empower brand, creative, and content teams. A frequent writer and speaker, he explores the intersection of AI, design thinking, and the evolution of AEO/AIO, emerging best practices, and it's impact on traditional SEO practices for modern technology companies.

speakers.name: Claudio Tonti
speakers.title: Co-founder, VP of AI & Innovation
speakers.bio: VP of AI & Innovation at Websolute, with over 25 years of experience across technology, digital marketing, and UX. Specialized in Agentic AI, he develops AI-driven solutions for business applications. As a co-founder, he leads innovation and applied research to drive the digital transformation of SMEs.

speakers.name: Marcello Ricci
speakers.title: Founder and CEO
speakers.bio: Marcello Ricci is the Founder and CEO of Flowvenue. With over 15 years of experience in CRM, system integration, and digital transformation, he founded Flowvenue to simplify and accelerate the implementation of business processes.

speakers.name: Davide Rossi
speakers.title: Head of Design Studio
speakers.bio: Davide Rossi is Head of Design Studio at GFT Technologies, where he leads multidisciplinary teams in designing digital experiences and innovative solutions. With over 15 years of experience in digital product design, he has worked on complex projects for enterprise clients, particularly in the banking and financial sectors. In his role, he defines design strategies, promotes user-centered approaches, and integrates creativity and technology to develop high-impact digital products.

speakers.name: Yari Nardiello
speakers.company: The Italian Institute of Artificial Intelligence (AI4I)
speakers.title: Head of Strategic Projects
speakers.bio: MBA and former Manager at Bain & Company, he has supported companies through strategic and operational transformations. At AI4I, he leads high-impact national and European strategic initiatives to strengthen AI innovation and adoption, including the European Commission-funded IT4LIA AI Factory project.

speakers.name: Raffaele Gaito
speakers.title: Founder IA360
speakers.bio:
I founded IA360, the academy for those who want to stay up to date in the world of AI.
I share knowledge through a blog, a YouTube channel, and a podcast.
I have delivered my workshops and talks in companies such as Vodafone, HP, Microsoft, Enel, Chiesi, Sella, and others.
I believe experimentation is the only key to innovation.

speakers.name: Maurizio Ipsale
speakers.title: Lead Google Cloud
speakers.bio: Google Developer Expert (GDE) in AI/ML & Cloud | Lead Trainer at Datatonic Academy With a Ph.D. in Electronic Engineering and over 20 years of experience, Maurizio specializes in bridging the gap between research and production. He helps enterprises turn complex AI concepts into deployed, scalable systems.

speakers.name: Daniele Zeme
speakers.title: AI Presales Manager
speakers.bio: AI Manager at SDG, member of the global technical pre-sales team.With over 7 years of experience delivering scaled AI solutions across diverse sectors, Daniele specializes in designing and implementing high-impact, production- ready agentic architectures.

speakers.name: Francesca Moriani
speakers.title: CEO
speakers.bio: Born in Fucecchio in 1977, she holds a degree in Business Administration from the University of Pisa and an MBA in International Management from the University of Brighton. Determined and driven, she first became Managing Director with responsibility for Sales and Products (2014), and later CEO of Var Group (2021). More than just a company, Var Group is a driver of business transformation, with a presence in 16 countries and the ambition to be not “the best company in the world” but “the best company for the world,” supporting organizations in their digital evolution through innovative, tailored solutions. Winner of the Microsoft Power Women Award 2024, she is also the author of her first book, Braveship, published by Egea.

speakers.name: Andrea Zucchiatti
speakers.title: Product Design Lead
speakers.bio: Andrea is a Product Design Manager at Qonto, where he leads a team of designers making finance management smooth, accessible, and cool for freelancers and SMEs. With roots in behavioral design and writing, he brings this unlikely mix to how AI shapes financial products.

speakers.name: Francesco Pozzobon
speakers.title: Chief Growth Officer
speakers.bio: Francesco Pozzobon is an executive with over 20 years of experience in corporate growth strategy and transformative leadership across multiple industries. He has a strong track record in leading sales and marketing teams, developing and executing high-impact go-to-market strategies, and building strategic partnerships with large enterprises and public institutions. Specialized in scaling operations and driving revenue, he is known for his ability to align strategy with execution, contributing to measurable and sustainable value for organizations.

speakers.name: Nicolò Nepote
speakers.title: VP Data Science & AI
speakers.bio: Nicolò Nepote is VP DS&AI at Brembo. Having spent 20 years in IT Systems, HPC, Data Science and AI-oriented Application, he now drives the delivery and the adoption of digital and AI-powered solutions. Passionate about AI applied to industry, he fosters innovation, collaboration, and skill development to create tangible value from AI projects.

speakers.name: Pavlos Kolios
speakers.title: Staff Product Manager
speakers.bio: Pavlos Kolios è Staff Product Manager presso Hack The Box. È responsabile della creazione di simulazioni ad alta intensità per i team red e blue all’interno della piattaforma CTF. Pavlos ha una vasta esperienza in cybersecurity, avendo partecipato e vinto diverse competizioni CTF, come la European Cyber Security Challenge, CSAW, GreHack e la Hack The Box Business CTF. È inoltre un penetration tester certificato e OSCE. Inoltre, in passato ha scoperto vulnerabilità che hanno portato alla pubblicazione di CVE.

speakers.name: Marco Gori
speakers.title: Professor University of Siena
speakers.bio: He is a professor of computer science at the University of Siena. His research interests are in the field of Artificial Intelligence, with a particular focus on machine learning and game playing. In recent years, he has mainly worked on learning in relational domains within the continuum setting. He is interested in applying the developed models to problems in pattern recognition and web mining. He is also very interested in discussing new computational models and their relationship with the human brain.

speakers.name: Marco Galli
speakers.title: Avv. Marco Galli,  Senior Counsel Intellectual Property & Technology Law Data Protection & Data Governance Space Law
speakers.bio:
Marco Galli is a Senior Counsel at PedersoliGattai, where he heads the Data Protection & Data Governance team and, since 2025, has also been responsible for the Space Law & Economy focus group.
He has gained considerable experience in end-to-end management of high-complexity technology and compliance projects, including aspects related to the protection and exploitation of personal and non-personal data, particularly in the banking and finance, healthcare, and utilities sectors. He advises national and international clients on a wide range of legal issues related to IT, data protection and data governance, with particular
reference to the management of complex projects with a high technological impact, particularly in the AI field.
Marco has been the Firm’s front man speaker with a talk on “interactions between blockchain and AI” in the context of the Blockchain Forum Italia, two days of meetings dedicated to the world of the blockchain and an important point of reference for all professionals and enthusiasts of fintech initiatives.
He has been also exhaustively Involved in all Privacy and Data Protection matters connected to the Firm’s ESG project “Diritto allo Studio”.
He has played a leading role in several lectures, conferences and seminars, including
“Implementation of the DORA Regulation Requirements: Key Insights,” organized in collaboration with Formalize; the seminar series “Data and Artificial Intelligence
Week in Banking” promoted by the Associazione Bancaria Italiana (ABI), where he delivered a speech entitled “Algorithmic Training, Intellectual Property Protection,
and Personal Data Protection: The Data Governance Act as a Forward-Looking Solution”; the seminar series “New Literacies and Digital Citizenship” at the Università degli Studi di Modena e Reggio Emilia, focusing on “Authorship, Data and Digital Identity: (Non)Artificial Citizenship”; and a lecture within the Master in International Business at the Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore, addressing topics related to AI, technology contracts and data governance. Marco is also a member of the
AI Committee in PedersoliGattai and co-authored the work “Responsible AI. A Global Policy Framework”, edited by I TECH LAW, first edition.

speakers.name: Giulio Coraggio
speakers.title: Head of Intellectual Property & Technology
speakers.bio: Giulio Coraggio is the Partner who leads the Intellectual Property & Technology department of DLA Piper in Italy and serves as the Global Co-Chair of the firm’s Gaming & Gambling group. He is one of Italy’s most highly regarded professionals in the fields of new technologies law, cybersecurity, privacy, artificial intelligence, and machine learning.

speakers.name: Valeria Procoli
speakers.title: Advisory Solution Consultant
speakers.bio: Valeria Procoli is an Advisory Solution Consultant at ServiceNow, helping Italian government agencies turn AI from buzzword into reality. She leverages ServiceNow's workflow automation and AI capabilities to bridge the gap between complex public sector needs and solutions that actually work.

speakers.name: Igor Bailo
speakers.title: Executive Director AI & Data
speakers.bio: Senior executive is a senior executive with over 25 years of experience in IT and Operations. An expert in AI, Cloud, and digital transformation, he has led growth initiatives, M&A integrations, and turnaround projects within groups such as Engineering, WIIT, CSE, and McKinsey & Company.

speakers.name: Gianmarco Ciarfaglia
speakers.title: Head of AI
speakers.bio: He leads the team that develops AI solutions for businesses and Public Administration, including EngGPT, EngGPT, the proprietary sovereign LLM of Engineering.

speakers.name: Luigi Cudia
speakers.title: Responsabile Infrastrutture e Operations
speakers.bio: Since 1996, he has worked in the telecommunications sector for Telecom Italia and other operators. Since joining Infratel Italia in 2004, he now leads the Infrastructure and Operations Area, overseeing the development of the public fiber network and the technical and economic management of the BUL Plan, Italia a 1 Giga, and SINFI, the digital registry of infrastructure.

speakers.name: Roberto Carlo Rossi
speakers.title: Presidente Ordine dei Medici Chirurghi e Odontoiatri di Milano e Provincia
speakers.bio: President of the Order of Physicians, Surgeons and Dentists of Milan and Province for the four-year terms 2025–2028 and 2021–2024, and for the three-year terms 2018–2020, 2015–2017, and 2012–2014. Member of the Central Committee of FNOMCeO for the 2025–2028 term. General Practitioner in primary care, contracted with the ASL Città di Milano since June 1, 1993 to the present day.

speakers.name: Andrea Chiarentin
speakers.title: partner in Ki Reply
speakers.bio: Andrea Chiarentin is a Partner at Ki Reply, where he focuses on rethinking software delivery through innovative models built around factories of specialized AI agents. He works on integrating hybrid client-Reply teams with the goal of making software development more efficient, scalable, and driven by intelligent automation.

speakers.name: Angela Carpinelli
speakers.title: Head of Solution Services & Quality Assurance
speakers.bio: Angela Carpinelli is Head of Solution Services & Quality Assurance at Plenitude, where she focuses on AI Software Factory, Solution Design, and end-to-end Quality Assurance. Her work is centered on internalizing technical capabilities, driving automation, and leveraging artificial intelligence across the entire software development lifecycle, with the aim of making processes more efficient, scalable, and innovative.

speakers.name: Giuseppe Papaianni
speakers.title: Account Executive
speakers.bio:
Giuseppe Papaianni is an Account Executive at Amazon Web Services (AWS), where he manages relationships with Italy's leading sports organizations, including Lega Serie A, Lega Volley, FIGC, and CONI. A member of the AWS team since 2022, he brings many years of experience in the technology sector, with a strategic focus on digital transformation and cloud innovation.
His track record includes driving projects for major public administrations and sports industry clients. Prior to AWS, he served as Business Developer and Sales Manager for Enel X and ZTE, building deep expertise in business development, sales strategy, and technology solutions across both the public and private sectors.

speakers.name: Massimiliano Greco
speakers.title: Associate Professor, Humanitas University and Senior Consultant, Anesthesiology and Intensive Care, IRCCS Humanitas Research Hospital
speakers.bio: Associate Professor at Humanitas University and senior consultant in anesthesiology and intensive care. Focused on data science and AI in medicine. Holds roles in master’s and PhD programs and scientific societies. Research on epidemiology, machine learning, and predictive algorithms in critical care.

speakers.name: Federico Semeraro
speakers.title: Presidente ERC – European Resuscitation Council
speakers.bio: Anesthesiologist and intensivist at the Local Health Authority of Bologna and Adjunct Professor at the University of Bologna. President of the European Resuscitation Council, with expertise in cardiac arrest, resuscitation, and medical training. Actively involved in research on innovation, AI, and emergency response systems to improve survival rates.

speakers.name: Luca Magrì
speakers.title: Head of Strategy, Excellence & Innovation
speakers.bio: Luca Magrì leads a corporate function focused on strategy, excellence, and innovation. He drives transformation at the intersection of business and technology, fostering high-impact, data-driven innovation across the organization.

speakers.name: Marian Simpetru
speakers.title: Founder & CEO
speakers.bio:
Marian Simpetru is the Founder and CEO of Alteus, an enterprise AI platformfocused on helping organizations adopt and scale practical AI  solutions. With almost 30 years of experience in software development and technology leadership, Marian is also the CEO of eSolutions, where he has led the delivery of custom software solutions and architectures, with a strong focus on big data platforms in the past decade. More recently, he has driven AI initiatives across eSolutions, fostering early adoption of AI practices and shaping teams and capabilities that underpin the development of Alteus.
Marian is an occasional speaker at tech events, sharing insights on Open Source technologies, Java, Big Data, and Artificial Intelligence.

speakers.name: Giovanni Gorgoni
speakers.title: Direttore Generale ASL AT, già Presidente EUREGHA
speakers.bio: Giovanni Gorgoni is a healthcare manager and university lecturer, currently serving as Director General of ASL Asti. He is also active at the European level, where he served as President of EUREGHA. His work focuses on digital healthcare, value-based healthcare, and healthcare service innovation.

speakers.name: Cristina Mussini
speakers.title: Presidente SIMIT, Società Italiana Malattie Infettive e Tropicali
speakers.bio: Cristina Mussini is President of SIMIT (Italian Society of Infectious and Tropical Diseases). She is a Full Professor of Infectious Diseases and one of Italy’s leading experts in the field of infectious diseases and the management of complex infections, with a particular focus on emerging infections and antimicrobial resistance. She is active in clinical practice, teaching, and research, contributing to the development of guidelines and the dissemination of best practices in infectious diseases at both national and international level.

speakers.name: Rita Murri
speakers.title: Professoressa di Malattie Infettive Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore e Responsabile della Unità di Consulenza Infettivologica Fondazione Policlinico Universitario Agostino Gemelli IRCCS Roma
speakers.bio: Professor of Infectious Diseases at the Catholic University and Head of the Infectious Diseases Consultation Unit at Gemelli IRCCS. An expert in antimicrobial stewardship and emerging infections, she leads the SIMIT AI group. She integrates AI and real-world data to improve diagnostics, therapies, and vaccination strategies.

speakers.name: Michele Barletta
speakers.title: Presidente BioPharma Network – Associazione Manager del Farmaceutico
speakers.bio: Michele Barletta is a pharmaceutical industry executive with over 25 years of experience. He is President of BioPharma Network – Pharmaceutical Managers Association, President of the Scientific Committee of WOMA Forum, and Scientific Director of ISTUM Pharma – Institute of Management Studies. He promotes innovation, industry transformation, and talent development.

speakers.name: Francesca Gabrielli
speakers.title: CEO
speakers.bio: Francesca Gabrielli is CEO of Assist Digital, an international company specializing in customer experience, digital transformation, and AI-driven solutions. With solid experience in leading complex organizations and driving service innovation, she focuses on developing strategies that integrate technology, data, and customer-centricity to support business growth. Under her leadership, Assist Digital continues to invest in automation, conversational AI, and process transformation to improve both customer and business experiences.

speakers.name: Silvia Cafagna
speakers.title: Head of Customer Engagement at AstraZeneca
speakers.bio: Head of Customer Engagement at AstraZeneca Italy, with over 17 years of experience in digital transformation, customer excellence, and omnichannel strategies. Leads engagement models by integrating marketing, data, technology, and AI.

speakers.name: Isabella Castiglioni
speakers.title: Professoressa Ordinaria di Fisica Applicata, Università Milano Bicocca
speakers.bio: Isabella Castiglioni is a Full Professor of Applied Physics at the University of Milano-Bicocca. She is an active researcher in the fields of medical imaging, biomedical physics, and artificial intelligence applied to medicine. Her work focuses on the development of advanced data analysis methods and algorithms for diagnostic support and personalized medicine, with a strong emphasis on bridging scientific research and clinical applications.

speakers.name: Sebastiano Di Guardo
speakers.title: Group CEO Meduspace S.p.A. Società Benefit
speakers.bio: Graduated in Engineering and holding a PhD in Information Society, he has built a career as General Director of service companies in local public healthcare and as a management consultant. He has led complex transformation and turnaround initiatives, with a focus on innovation and organizational development.

speakers.name: Roberto De Carlo
speakers.title: Partner
speakers.bio: At Koinos since early 2024, I am responsible for origination, execution, and portfolio monitoring within the private equity division. Previously, I worked for approximately 10 years at 21 Invest (private equity) and 5 years at JPMorgan in London (investment banking), in the M&A FIG and Debt & Equity Capital Markets divisions.

speakers.name: Valentina Bellini
speakers.title: Professoressa Associata Anestesia Rianimazione Università di Parma
speakers.bio: Valentina Bellini is an Associate Professor of Anesthesia and Intensive Care at the University of Parma. She is a specialist physician in anesthesia, resuscitation, and intensive care medicine, carrying out both clinical and research activities with a particular focus on perioperative medicine, critical care management, and innovation in anesthesiology. Her work also focuses on the integration of new technologies and data-driven approaches to improve safety and the effectiveness of care in critical care settings.

speakers.name: Valeria Panebianco
speakers.title: Full Professor of Radiology and Director of the Department of Radiological Sciences, Oncology and Pathology at Sapienza University
speakers.bio: Professor Valeria Panebianco is Full Professor of Radiology and Director of the Department of Radiological Sciences, Oncology and Pathology at Sapienza University. She currently coordinates the CARE Unit for Digital Medicine. Her scientific efforts have focused on the integration of computational medicine, AI, and digital twin technologies. She has coordinated/involved in major EU-funded initiatives.

speakers.name: Daniele Rabia
speakers.title: Customer Innovation Lead
speakers.bio: Daniele Rabia is Customer Innovation Lead at Bayer, with over 14 years of international experience across Telecom, Digital, Retail, and Pharma. He works on business model transformation, analytics, and AI solutions, integrating strategy, technology, and people.

speakers.name: Domenico Cianflone
speakers.title: Direttore Cardiologia Riabilitativa Ospedale San Raffaele - Professore in Malattie Cardiovascolari Università Vita-Salute San Raffaele
speakers.bio: He has decades of clinical and research experience across all major fields of cardiology. He combines clinical practice with academic teaching at Vita-Salute San Raffaele University. A pioneer in the application of technological innovation to medicine, he has coordinated major international projects for the European Union and the ESA (European Space Agency). He has served on prestigious international scientific and technical committees, including the ESC (European Society of Cardiology), ACC (American College of Cardiology), NIH (National Institutes of Health, USA), and the Canada Ministry of Health. He was among the first promoters of pilot projects on neural networks in cardiology and led the development of global medical databases at an international level.

speakers.name: Federico Esposti
speakers.title: Direttore Strategico Ospedale San Raffaele
speakers.bio: Federico Esposti is Strategic Director of San Raffaele Hospital, the largest private research and treatment institute in Italy and part of the San Donato Group. With solid experience in healthcare strategy and operations management, he leads the hospital’s operations and strategic transformation initiatives. He has a background in biomedical and pharmaceutical research, having held academic and industry roles in neuroscience and healthcare innovation. He launched the first major telemedicine service in Italy and is currently implementing generative AI at scale across hospital operations. Federico holds a PhD in Systems and Biomedical Engineering and a Master’s degree in Healthcare Management.

speakers.name: Simona Giubilato
speakers.title: Cardiologa e Coordinatrice Area Intelligenza Artificiale in Cardiologia ANMCO
speakers.bio: Cardiologist and intensivist. Senior physician at Cannizzaro Hospital in Catania, formerly at Gemelli Hospital in Rome. Holds a PhD and specialized master’s degrees. Expert in critical patient management and advanced technologies. Chairperson of the AI in Cardiology area at ANMCO.

speakers.name: Fabio Cubeddu
speakers.title: Digital Health Senior Project Supervisor di Confindustria Dispositivi Medici
speakers.bio: Digital Health Senior Project Supervisor at Confindustria Dispositivi Medici, the trade association representing the medical devices and IVD industry in Italy. She oversees the Association’s strategies on digital healthcare, artificial intelligence applied to medical devices, and healthcare data governance.

speakers.name: Beatrice Delfrate
speakers.title: Direttrice dell'Esecuzione del Contratto per la piattaforma di Intelligenza Artificiale dedicata alle cure primarie, AGENAS
speakers.bio: Graduated in Computer Science, she has gained experience in healthcare information systems within the Friuli Venezia Giulia Region and regional agencies. She has led digital healthcare and NRRP projects, contributing to the Electronic Health Record (EHR) and telemedicine initiatives. She currently works at AGENAS on AI platforms for primary care.

speakers.name: Cristiano Agostini
speakers.title: Chief Information Officer
speakers.bio: Cristiano Agostini is Group CIO of Prada, where he leads the group’s global technology strategy and digital transformation. With extensive experience in IT innovation, information systems management, and business process digitalization, he works to integrate technology, data, and business to support the brand’s growth and evolution in the luxury sector.

speakers.name: Gianluigi Alberici
speakers.title: Partner
speakers.bio: Gianluigi Alberici is a Partner at Arsenalia, where he leads digital transformation and technology innovation initiatives. With a background in management engineering, he is actively involved in developing advanced digital solutions to enhance customer experience and business processes.

speakers.name: Massimo Salviato
speakers.title: CEO Despar Nord
speakers.bio: Massimo Salviato is CEO of Despar Nord, a leading company in large-scale retail distribution in Northern Italy. With solid managerial experience in retail and distribution, he leads the company’s growth, innovation, and process transformation initiatives, with a strong focus on evolving organizational models, operational efficiency, and placing people and customers at the center.

speakers.name: Omar Bortolato
speakers.title: Chief AI Officer
speakers.bio: Omar Bortolato is Chief AI Officer at Despar, where he focuses on the development and adoption of artificial intelligence solutions to support business processes and retail operations. With experience in digital and data-driven environments, he works to integrate AI into the company’s operational and strategic activities, contributing to the evolution of organizational models and innovation in the large-scale retail sector.

speakers.name: Alessandro Pacetti
speakers.title: Global DTC director
speakers.bio: Alessandro Pacetti is Global DTC Director at Vibram Group, where he leads international Direct-to-Consumer strategies. With experience in digital business, retail, and omnichannel development, he focuses on accelerating brand growth through the evolution of direct sales models, the innovation of customer experience, and the integration of digital and data-driven tools into commercial processes.

speakers.name: Alessio Biasiutti

speakers.name: Domenico Leone

speakers.bio: He leads complex teams and projects with a focus on advanced AI, contributing to the development of intelligent solutions that accelerate digital transformation, automation, and new decision-making approaches.

speakers.name: Matteo Milione
speakers.title: Head of CoC Data Marketing – Customer Acquisition
speakers.bio: Manager and entrepreneur with over 13 years of experience in strategic consulting and entrepreneurial ventures. He works on AI and data-driven innovation to transform advanced technology into measurable impact, value for clients, and sustainable growth for stakeholders.

speakers.name: Cecilia Niro
speakers.title: Content Designer
speakers.bio: Specialized in content design and content marketing, she combines strategy and creativity to design user-oriented content where clarity and message effectiveness meet business objectives. speakers.name: Augusto Marietti
speakers.title: CEO and Co-Founder
speakers.bio: Augusto “Aghi” Marietti is an inventor, technology entrepreneur, and angel investor. As the CEO and co-founder of Kong, a leading developer of cloud API technologies, he drives the company’s vision, strategy, and long-term growth. Prior to Kong, he was the CEO and co-founder of Mashape, the largest API marketplace, which was acquired by RapidAPI in 2017. Before that, he founded MemboxX, the first European cloud service for storing documents and sensitive personal data. Augusto holds a B.S. in Economics from the Catholic University of Milan and studied briefly at UC Berkeley. He is the lead inventor on five U.S. patents and an angel investor in more than 10 startups.

speakers.name: Ash Osborne
speakers.title: Field CTO
speakers.bio: Ash is Field CTO at Kong Inc., where he advises global enterprises on how to evolve their architectures toward an AI- and agent-driven future. With over 14 years of experience in the API ecosystem, he has built and managed some of the most complex API platforms currently in production, supporting more than 200 billion API calls per year across 18,000 banking services, enabling transaction peaks of over 60,000 transactions per second during global retail events, and delivering systems classified as national critical infrastructure. This extensive background gives him a highly practical perspective on AI adoption. Today, Ash works with technology leaders to help them move beyond experimentation, supporting them in designing the platform, governance, and runtime capabilities required to implement AI safely and at scale, while avoiding the architectural and organizational pitfalls that often hinder progress.

speakers.name: Giacomo Vecchiato
speakers.title: Data Scientist
speakers.bio: Giacomo Vecchiato is a Data Scientist at Estilos, where he focuses on Advanced Analytics and Business AI. He holds a PhD in Mathematics from the Gran Sasso Science Institute and has five years of academic experience in mathematical analysis and scientific computing in Italy and the United States, including at Penn State University.

speakers.name: Giovanni Fusco
speakers.title: Data Scientist
speakers.bio: Giovanni Fusco is a Data Scientist at Estilos, where he focuses on Advanced Analytics and Business AI. He earned a PhD in Mathematics from the University of Padua and conducted research in control theory at Louisiana State University.

speakers.name: Marco Colusso
speakers.title: Partner
speakers.bio: Marco Colusso is Partner and Co-Founder of Estilos and has more than 20 years of experience in the consulting industry. As an Advisor, he supports companies in adopting new operational and analytical models for the Intelligent Enterprise.

speakers.name: Ayesha Alsuwaidi
speakers.title: Investor
