Previously, she held senior roles across Mubadala’s Sovereign Partnerships covering U.K. & Europe, the M&A team, with secondments to The Blackstone Group and SoftBank Investment Advisers. She is a CFA charterholder and is based in Abu Dhabi.

speakers.name: Andrea D'Onofrio
speakers.title: Cloud Platform and AI Lead
speakers.bio: With over 25 years of experience in sales and marketing, Andrea is responsible at Microsoft for the Cloud & AI business in the Italian market. He takes part in international events as a Data & AI expert and helps companies on their transformation journey driven by Data and Artificial Intelligence.

speakers.name: Daniele Cordioli
speakers.title: Marketing & Business Development Director
speakers.bio: At Expert.ai, Daniele Cordioli is responsible for marketing and business development for artificial intelligence solutions, promoting enterprise adoption and aligning technological innovation with business impact. With over twenty years of international experience, he supports growth across various sectors, from go-to-market strategies to scaling AI initiatives globally.

speakers.name: Kevin Cochrane
speakers.title: Chief Marketing Officer
speakers.bio: Kevin Cochrane is a 25+ year pioneer of the digital experience space. Kevin co-founded his first start-up, Interwoven, in 1996, pioneered open source content management at Alfresco in 2006, and built a global leader in digital experience management as CMO of Day Software and later Adobe. Kevin has also held senior executive positions at OpenText, Bloomreach, and SAP. Now at Vultr, Kevin is now working to build Vultr's global brand presence as a leader in the independent Cloud platform market.

speakers.name: Andrea Schilirò
speakers.title: Solution Product Marketing Manager – HP ACS
speakers.bio: Andrea Schilirò leads global solution marketing for HP’s Advanced Compute and Solutions portfolio, shaping strategy to accelerate edge computing and high‑performance workflows across industries.

speakers.name: Luis Santiago Fernández del Valle
speakers.title: CEO Akkodis Italy & Iberia
speakers.bio: Luis Santiago Fernández del Valle is a professional at Akkodis, active across Madrid, Milan, and Lisbon. He works in international environments focused on technological and industrial innovation, with an academic background from Universidad Politécnica de Madrid.

speakers.name: Bernard Kavanagh
speakers.title: Solutions Architecture & GTM Leader | Building High-Performance AI Data Ecosystems
speakers.bio: Bernard is a specialist in high-performance data systems, helping organizations rapidly pivot from disjointed data stacks to unified infrastructure required for the modern agentic era. At TiDB, he architects Agent-First memory stores that consolidate Vector Search, Hybrid SQL,and Real-Time Analytics into a single platform replacing fragmented multi-service stacks where AI agents lose context and accumulate costHis work productionising AI workflows includes a real-time multi-agent platform for 200,000+ IoT devices that cut infrastructure costs by 65% and LLM token consumption by 10x with agents that improve diagnostic accuracy  from every investigation.

speakers.name: Danilo Cattaneo
speakers.title: e team
speakers.bio: Danilo Cattaneo, who graduated with honors in Computer Science, holds an Executive MBA from the University of Edinburgh and an MBA from the École Nationale des Ponts et Chaussées in Paris. He is currently CEO and General Manager of Tinexta Infocert, a Qualified Trust Service Provider and European leader in revenue and growth rates, with over 750 employees operating across different geographic areas, €159 million in revenue recorded in 2023, clients in more than 60 countries, and a portfolio of over 21 active patents. In addition to serving as Vice President of Assintel, Cattaneo holds several prestigious roles: he is Chairman of Sixtema SpA — an IT services company dedicated to SMEs —, Chairman of Camerfirma SA, a Spanish Certification Authority with subsidiaries in Peru and Colombia, and President of Certeurope France. He also chairs the EMBA Advisory Board at the University of Tor Vergata, is a member of the Executive Board of Federservizi Imprese per l’Italia, Legal Representative of IC Tech Lab Suarl in Tunisia, Board Member of the Tinexta Futuro Digitale Consortium, and member of the Board of Directors of Ascertia. His career has been built on solid prior professional experience, developed in roles of increasing responsibility within internationally recognized organizations, including Oracle Corporation, Andersen Consulting (now Accenture), Sintel Consulting (Finmatica), and Middlesex University in London.

speakers.name: Fabio Roli
speakers.title: Professor of Machine Learning, AI Security Expert, Director sAIfer Lab
speakers.bio:
Fabio Roli is a Full Professor of Computer Engineering at the University of Genova and the University of Cagliari, and Director of the sAIfer Lab. 
He is internationally recognized as one of the pioneers in the field of AI security. 
He is included in Stanford University’s list of the world’s most highly cited researchers. 
He has been appointed Fellow of the Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers, Fellow of the International Association for Pattern Recognition, Fellow of the Asia-Pacific Artificial Intelligence Association.

speakers.name: Francesco Battaglieri
speakers.title: Sr. Solution Engineer - AI & Machine Learning
speakers.bio: Expert in Data Strategy and Artificial Intelligence with over 15 years of experience leading digital transformation for large enterprises. Currently at Snowflake, he coordinates the creation of the virtual AI Center of Excellence for the South EMEA region, defining strategic objectives and leading technical workstreams on high-value deals. Previously, he spent nearly a decade at Google as a Senior Analytical Consultant (Data Scientist), where he launched the first first-party data consulting service in Italy and led complex Machine Learning and Deep Learning projects for market leaders such as L’Oréal and major fashion retailers.

speakers.name: Giovanni Macca
speakers.title: Senior Consultant e trainer
speakers.bio: Consultant and lecturer in Communication Strategies, Digital Innovation, and Artificial Intelligence at Imaginars. With 14 years of experience between managerial roles and strategic projects in Communication and Digital Innovation, he has worked with global brands such as Vans, Moleskine, and Campari Group.

speakers.name: Alessandro Cesarini
speakers.title: Fondatore e CEO
speakers.bio: Innovation Manager with over 30 years of experience across technology, business, and digital processes. He leads the development of a hub where professionals, associations, education, and AI come together to transform shared knowledge and expert validation into reliable agents.

speakers.name: Matteo Restelli
speakers.title: Senior Partner Solutions Architect
speakers.bio: Matteo Restelli is a Senior Partner Solutions Architect at Amazon Web Services (AWS). He helps partners and companies design scalable and secure cloud architectures, driving the adoption of innovative AI-based solutions and AWS services for digital transformation.

speakers.name: Walter Dal Mut

ISDP10003 Auditor. ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO/IEC 42001 Auditor.

speakers.title: Head of Digital Solution Implementation e Digital Solution Strategy Leader
speakers.bio:
Domenico Carboni is Head of Digital Solution Implementation and Digital Solution Strategy Leader at Grenke Italia, a leading company in the operational leasing of technologies for SMEs.

With responsibility for the strategy and implementation of B2B digital solutions in international contexts, Domenico leads the evolution of digital platforms, AI solutions, API integrations, e-commerce platforms, and advanced sales tools for clients and partners, with a focus on operational adoption, scalability, and measurable results. He operates at the intersection of business, technology, and governance, coordinating cross-country teams and digital transformation programs.

speakers.name: Andrea Pepe
speakers.title: AI Engineering Manager
speakers.bio: He leads team growth and the development of scalable AI products. He designs intelligent platforms and LLM-based systems, improving process efficiency and quality while bringing AI into production.

speakers.name: Luca Luperini
speakers.title: Head of Digital & AI

With over 15 years of experience in the ICT and Telco sectors, he has held senior roles in product and marketing management, specializing in the management of the entire lifecycle of digital services.
Since 2024, he has been an elected member of the Steering Committee of the Registro.it , representing Registrars.

speakers.name: Ioannis Foukarakis
speakers.title: Principal AI Engineer
speakers.bio: Ioannis Foukarakis is Principal AI Engineer at Hack The Box, where he works on benchmarking AI agents against real-world cybersecurity challenges. His work includes AI Range, a platform for evaluating and optimizing agents on real-world cybersecurity tasks. With over fifteen years of experience across machine learning, data engineering, and backend systems, and a PhD in Electrical & Computer Engineering from NTUA, his focus is on making AI evaluation in cybersecurity more rigorous and meaningful — and on understanding how capable AI agents actually are when faced with real security challenges.

speakers.name: Stefano Capoferri
speakers.title: CEO
speakers.bio: tefano Capoferri has been CEO of Gulliver S.r.l. since 2026. The company serves over 250 major clients, has an international office in Luxembourg, and partnerships with Google, Fastweb+Vodafone, and Tomorrow Street.

speakers.title: Professoressa Ordinaria di etica, co-titolare cattedra UNESCO ‘AI Ethics and Practical Wisdom’

speakers.name: Gianluca Trifiletti

speakers.bio: Costantino Croce is an Advisory Solutions Consultant at Boomi, where he supports companies in their digital transformation journeys through integration, automation, and data management solutions. With experience in both technology and consulting, he helps organizations simplify complex processes, improve connectivity across systems, and accelerate the adoption of innovative solutions based on cloud, AI, and automation.

speakers.name: Marco Cervone
speakers.title: Head of Document Management & Digital Transformation projects
speakers.bio: For over 20 years, he has led innovation initiatives in digital transformation. He launched and developed the Digital Transformation service at Sefin S.p.A., integrating AI into EDI processes to reduce digital asymmetries between customers and suppliers across the entire order cycle.

speakers.name: Raffaele Morreale
speakers.title: CEO
speakers.bio: C-Level manager with 30 years of international experience in tier-one organizations such as Versace, Berkshire Hathaway, and IED, across Italy, the United States, and China. Today, as CEO of Archetype, he leads the implementation of vertical AI solutions designed to enhance and capitalize corporate knowledge, turning it into a competitive advantage.

speakers.name: Andrea di Foggia
speakers.title: Founder & Product Owner
speakers.bio:
Business designer with over 10 years of experience in B2B consultative sales, commercial strategies, and the development of digital projects for companies. In 2021, he founded ZERO Remote Farm, a consulting firm specializing in marketing and organizational design for SMEs, where he personally managed dozens of negotiations and developed new business opportunities.
From this direct, hands-on experience came askmentor, an Italian conversation intelligence platform that analyzes sales conversations, turns them into concrete actions for sales teams, and fuels marketing with the real language and problems of customers.

speakers.name: Luca Iannelli
speakers.title: CCO & Co-founder
speakers.bio: CCO and co-founder of Fundo.one. Over 6 years of experience in innovative startups. Specialist in EU, national, and regional grants and funding programs, with a focus on digital transformation and business development.

speakers.name: Alexandre Gagliano
speakers.title: CEO
speakers.bio: CEO of Aumentia. I help companies turn AI into measurable business performance. Specialized in scaling operations, structuring execution, and building AI systems that deliver real ROI in 90 days.

speakers.name: Simone Sabba
speakers.title: CTO & Head of AI Squads
speakers.bio:
Simone Sabba is a full-stack developer and co-founder of Devpunks. He has worked across both enterprise and startup environments, gaining experience on complex digital products.
With Devpunks, he focuses on cross-pollination between these two worlds, combining the robustness, processes, and scale of enterprise with the speed, experimentation, and product mindset of startups.
In recent years, he has been working on applied AI for automating operational and creative processes, designing branded digital experiences focused on engagement.

speakers.name: Leonardo Cappabianca
speakers.title: Sales Engineering Manager, Forcepoint
speakers.bio: Leonardo leads Forcepoint’s Sales Engineering team for Italy and the Iberian Peninsula. With over 12 years of experience in Security and Cyber Security (including Darktrace, Accenture, Varonis, and Group-IB), he supports enterprises and public administrations with a technical-strategic approach to Data, Network, and Cloud Security.

speakers.name: Davide Carboni
speakers.bio: Engineer specializing in Information Security in the age of AI. Designs secure architectures integrating cybersecurity and compliance-by-design. Former researcher at Intel Labs, CRS4 and Adj. Professor at LUISS.

speakers.name: Daphne De Backer
speakers.title: Head of Product Marketing & Solution Engineering
speakers.bio: Results-driven executive and tech leader with 18+ years of experience in digital transformation and business growth across Italy and EMEA. Leads Solution Engineering teams, manages complex sales, and champions inclusion, coaching, and talent development.

speakers.name: Andrea Ferretto Parodi
speakers.title: Head of Innovation
speakers.bio: PhD in Physics and Innovation Manager with over 12 years of experience leading Open Innovation and R&D programs. As Head of Innovation at GFT Italia, he works to connect business strategy with the adoption of AI and other emerging technologies, transforming ideas, trends, and research into concrete initiatives that support business growth.

speakers.name: Marco Breda
speakers.title: Director of the University Laboratory on Artificial Intelligence
speakers.bio:
Marco Breda is Director of the University AI Laboratory at the International Telematic University UNINETTUNO, where he is engaged in teaching and research activities; at the same university, he also serves as an Adjunct Professor of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning.
Previously, he founded and led the Advanced Analytics & AI division at Engineering Ingegneria Informatica, overseeing the design of advanced analytical systems for public and private organizations across various sectors. He graduated with honors in Electronic Engineering from the University of Rome “La Sapienza” in 1989 and worked at Ericsson and TIM on broadband networks and complex systems.
Alongside his professional career, since 1997 he has been an Associate Researcher at the Semeion Research Center, where he focuses on Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence, with more than fifty publications in international scientific journals. He has also been a lecturer at the “Enrico Della Valle” School, where he taught courses in Data Warehousing and Advanced Analytics.

speakers.name: Giulia Massini
speakers.title: Senior Researcher, Co-fondatrice e Vice Direttrice del Centro Ricerche Semeion di Roma.
speakers.bio:
Giulia Massini is a Senior Researcher, Co-founder, and Deputy Director of the Semeion Research Center in Rome. She has decades of experience in designing and developing Artificial Intelligence algorithms, software, and adaptive systems. She specializes in the design of neural networks for classification, clustering, and data mining.
She has developed software innovations such as AutoCM for semantic maps and the Populations scaling algorithm. Her work focuses on applying AI in the fields of healthcare, security, and industry. She has collaborated with the Metropolitan Police (New Scotland Yard) on the analysis of investigative databases.
In the biomedical field, she has developed systems for Alzheimer’s diagnosis and diagnostic imaging. She coordinates fraud detection and data analysis projects for public institutions and major international companies. She is the author of numerous publications in international scientific journals such as Physica A, Chaos, and AI in Medicine.
She graduated in Sociology and Statistical Sociology from the University of Rome “La Sapienza.”

speakers.name: Riccardo Petritoli
speakers.title: Senior AI Strategist & Machine Learning Expert
speakers.bio:
Dr. Eng. Riccardo Petritoli is a Senior AI Strategist and Machine Learning Expert with 25 years of experience in the design and delivery of Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Advanced Analytics solutions, including 15 years of specialization in the financial and banking sector.
He works at Be Management Consulting (Engineering Group) and is an Associate Researcher at the Semeion Research Center for Communication Sciences, where he conducts applied research on adaptive analytical systems for the simulation, prediction, and control of complex phenomena.
He holds a degree in Electronic Engineering from the University of Rome “La Sapienza” and is the author of scientific publications in international journals in the fields of artificial intelligence, pattern recognition, and predictive systems.

speakers.name: Gigi Beltrame
speakers.title: Journalist, Host
speakers.bio:
Gigi Beltrame, a technologist and expert in economics and finance, has long been a key reference in communicating digital innovation for businesses and individuals. He is the editor-in-chief of BusinessCommunity.it, hosts the Late Tech Show podcast, and curates editorial projects that explore the impact of data and artificial intelligence on work, markets, and society.
A speaker and moderator at corporate events and conferences, he is the author of popular science books focused on AI, digital transformation, and the skills needed to navigate an increasingly technology-driven economy. With a critical yet pragmatic perspective, he helps managers, professionals, and readers understand today’s challenges and turn innovation into real value.

speakers.name: Fabiano Sileo
speakers.title: Head of Digitalization & Strategic Analytics, docente MBA su AI e Data analytics, fondatore di Dati365
speakers.bio: Bridging data and business decisions. Head of Digitalization & Strategic Analytics, MBA lecturer in AI and Data Analytics, founder of Dati365. Host of the podcast “From Data to Business Intelligence” (community of 20k+ professionals).

speakers.name: Andrea Zaccarelli
speakers.title: Software Engineer & AI Educator
speakers.bio: Software Engineer and AI Strategist with 7+ years of experience in B2B SaaS platform and AI-first startups. I help professionals and businesses in AI adoption through workshops and training. AI Educator (+105k community) on social media, radio and events.

speakers.name: Giovanni Balletta
speakers.title: Autore
speakers.bio:
Giovanni Balletta is an Italian author, cultural designer, and entrepreneur. He is the founder of HumanX, a startup dedicated to fostering empathy in AI, and co-founder of BAIFF (Burano Artificial Intelligence Film Festival). His work lies at the intersection of culture, communication, creativity, and innovation.
He develops ideas and initiatives that bring people, languages, and technologies into dialogue. His perspective combines a humanistic sensibility, an awareness of contemporary change, and a strong interest in the social value of innovation. He promotes an open, interdisciplinary, and research-oriented approach, with particular attention to quality, relationships, and the ethical dimension of cultural and digital processes.
Throughout his career, the relationship between humans and technology remains central, seen as a space for dialogue, growth, and the creation of new possibilities. With care and vision at the intersection of art and AI, he builds networks, fosters ethical uses, and creates meaningful connections.

speakers.name: Maurizio Sanarico
speakers.bio: Degree in Pure Mathematics, with over 30 years of experience in statistics, applied mathematics, machine learning, and artificial intelligence. Extensive expertise in both applied domains and methodologies. Chief Data Scientist at SDG Group from 2013 until April 2026. Member of the Scientific Committee of UNaIVERSE. His current main research interests include Topological Deep Learning, Operator Learning, and Decentralized AI.

speakers.name: Andrea Claudio Cosentini
speakers.title: Head of Data Science & Responsible AI di Intesa Sanpaolo
speakers.bio:
Andrea Cosentini
Head of Data Science & Responsible AI di Intesa Sanpaolo. Laureato in Fisica e PhD in Matematica e Statistica per l’Economia. Esperto in modelli quantitativi e mercati finanziari. Ha ricoperto ruoli apicali in ambito AI, tra cui CEO di una società di settore e responsabile del Centro di Eccellenza AI. È stato Chief Data Officer del Governo (2020–2022).

speakers.name: Nicasio Muscia
speakers.title: Responsabile della practice Responsible AI di Accenture per Italia e Grecia
speakers.bio:
Head of the Responsible AI practice at Accenture for Italy and Greece. He works on strategic transformation, AI governance, and risk management. He actively contributes to the debate on AI regulation (AI Act, GDPR, Data Act, DORA).
With over 20 years of experience, he has worked with Fortune 500 companies and led global teams. He graduated from Università Bocconi and completed an Executive Program at IESE Business School.

speakers.name: Giovanni Ferrero
speakers.company: ISMEL Istituto per la Memoria e la Cultura del Lavoro, dell'Impresa e dei Diritti Sociali
speakers.title: President
speakers.bio: Ingegnere elettronico con un percorso tra bioingegneria, informatica, istituzioni e cultura, è stato Direttore Amministrativo dell'Università di Torino, Assessore della Città di Torino e della Regione Piemonte, Presidente del Castello di Rivoli e dell'Accademia Albertina. Attualmente presiede ISMEL, Istituto per la Memoria e la Cultura del Lavoro, dell'Impresa e dei Diritti Sociali.

speakers.name: Antonio Calegari

speakers.name: Aldo Bisio

From 2004 to 2006, he served as General Manager at RCS Quotidiani S.p.A. From 2007 to 2013, he held the role of Group Managing Director and CEO of Ariston Group S.p.A. Since 2014, he has been CEO for Italy and, since 2022, Group Chief Commercial Officer of Vodafone Italia S.p.A. He is also a member of the Board of Directors of Coesia S.p.A.

speakers.name: Federico Favero
speakers.title: Partner

speakers.name: Valerio Cencig

speakers.name: Stefano Ricca
speakers.title: Founder & CEO
speakers.bio:
Stefano Ricca is the founder, Chairman of the Board, and CEO of Ricca IT, a company founded in Ragusa in 1998 that now employs over 130 people and stands as a national excellence in HPC, Data Centers, AI, and Cybersecurity. Under his leadership, Ricca IT plays a crucial role in managing critical national infrastructures, earning inclusion in Il Sole 24 Ore's "Stars of Southern Italy" for 2024 and 2025, an award recognizing top-performing businesses in the region based on revenue growth. An acknowledged innovator, Stefano Ricca is considered the driving force behind Arianna, the "made in Sicily" generative Corporate AI developed by Ricca IT. Unlike many external cloud solutions, Arianna is deployed directly within corporate infrastructure, ensuring maximum data
security while acting as a multiplier of human expertise rather than a simple replacement.

speakers.name: Stefano Sperimborgo

speakers.name: Maddalena Amoruso

She has built strong experience in data, analytics, and AI, coordinating complex programs aimed at innovating processes, services, and customer experience. In her role, she contributes to the large-scale adoption of AI technologies, with a focus on operational efficiency, responsible innovation, and business value creation.

He has gained experience in managing complex digital transformation programs, with a focus on integrating infrastructure, data, and emerging intelligent technologies.

speakers.name: Fabrizio Baldan

speakers.bio: Fabrizio Baldan is an AI & Data Associate Director at Accenture, where he leads digital transformation initiatives powered by data, artificial intelligence, and advanced analytics. In his role, he supports clients across multiple industries in developing and adopting data-driven and AI-powered solutions, contributing to the modernization of business processes and the implementation of scalable platforms for data management and value creation. He has experience in managing complex transformation programs, with a focus on innovation, AI industrialization, and driving business value through data.

speakers.name: Bruno Mandic
speakers.title: Senior Manager, Solutions Engineering

Bruno Mandic is a Senior Manager in Solutions Engineering at Kong Inc., where he supports enterprise customers in adopting and implementing API platforms and cloud-native connectivity solutions.
In his role, he combines technical expertise and strategic consulting to help organizations modernize their digital architectures, improve API management, and enable scalable and secure software ecosystems. He has gained international experience in areas such as cloud, API management, and digital transformation, working closely with both technical and business teams to accelerate technological innovation.

speakers.name: Silvano Luciani
speakers.title: Senior Director of Engineering
speakers.bio: Silvano Luciani is Senior Director of Engineering for Runtimes at Kong Inc., where he leads engineering efforts focused on the company’s runtime and cloud-native infrastructure technologies. He has extensive experience in distributed systems, cloud computing, and high-performance backend architectures, contributing to the development of scalable API and connectivity platforms. In his role, he oversees engineering teams working on core runtime components that power Kong’s API gateway and cloud-native ecosystem, supporting the company’s mission to enable secure and scalable API-first architectures.

speakers.name: Claudio Spadaccini

In his role, he contributes to the development of modern and scalable digital architectures, enabling integration across systems, products, and distribution channels. He works on evolving service design and API management capabilities, with the goal of improving digital service delivery and supporting the innovation of Sky’s platforms.

speakers.name: Maurizio Cecconi
speakers.title: MD, FRCA, FFICM | Head of Department of Anaesthesia and Intensive Care, Humanitas Research Hospital | Deputy Scientific Director (Clinical Research), Humanitas | Professor of Anaesthesia and Intensive Care, Humanitas University | Past President ESICM
speakers.bio: Intensive care physician and professor at Humanitas University. He focuses on applied physiology, shock, and innovation in intensive care. He works on integrating artificial intelligence into clinical research to improve decision-making, outcomes, and sustainability.

speakers.name: Fernanda Gellona
speakers.title: Coordinatore esecutivo
speakers.bio:
In 1986 in Milan, she joined Assobiomedica, a newly established trade association representing the medical devices sector (then referred to as “surgical and medical devices for human use”). In 2000, the Association decided to broaden its scope by adding more institutional topics to the purely technical ones that had previously formed the basis of its activities. For this purpose, she was appointed to open and lead the Rome office, with the mandate to develop relationships and collaborations with relevant institutions in the sector, scientific societies, professional associations, and patient organizations.
In 2009, she was appointed General Director, a position she held until her retirement at the end of 2024.
In 2019, she led the transformation from Assobiomedica to Confindustria Medical Devices, expanding the scope of competencies and areas of activity of the Association.
She has been a member of technical committees at the Italian National Institute of Health (Istituto Superiore di Sanità) and of the Board of IMQ; she has contributed to the creation of university master’s programs with Sapienza University of Rome and the University of Milano-Bicocca. She has also lectured in several master’s programs at the Catholic University of Rome.
In 2023, she contributed to the founding of Med Device Lab S.c.a.r.l., a public-private joint venture between Sapienza University of Rome and Confindustria Medical Devices, where she serves as Chief Executive Officer, a role she continues to hold today.

speakers.name: Salvatore Distaso
speakers.company: Ambulatorio di Cardiologia del PTA di Mesagne
speakers.title: Responsabile dell’Ambulatorio di Cardiologia del PTA di Mesagne
speakers.bio: Head of the Cardiology Outpatient Clinic at the PTA of Mesagne, ASL BR, he also leads the Heart Failure clinic. speakers.name: Tommaso Carlo Felice Farè
speakers.title: Insurance Value Proposition Director
speakers.bio: Director Sector Insurance and SPOC for AI & GenAI. Insurance executive with a proven track record in transforming and modernizing processes, systems and products. Digital innovator committed to shaping the future of the insurance industry.

speakers.name: Alessandro Colombo
speakers.title: Head of Analytics Solution Center
speakers.bio: Head of Analytics Solutions. Expert in Computer Vision, Machine Learning and AI, with experience in 2D/3D face recognition, object detection, 3D reconstruction, biometrics, ADAS systems, autonomous driving and insurance applications.

He currently leads the EMEA Architecture, Innovation & Acceleration team, composed of specialists and AI architects.

speakers.name: Francesca Meriggi
speakers.title: Group Chief Information Officer
speakers.bio:
Since joining Eng in 2023, she has built her agenda on three pillars: platform evolution, cyber/data resilience, and process redesign through automation and GenAI. Today she is industrialising Generative and Agentic AI, turning experimentation into measurable enterprise value.
Fortune Italia named her among Italy’s top 40 Under 40 Innovation Managers in 2024.

speakers.name: Massimo Del Vecchio
speakers.title: Eng Modernize Executive Director
speakers.bio: Since 2023, Executive Director of Eng Modernize (Engineering), he leads over 1,500 developers in the modernization of legacy applications into cloud-native solutions. He has led complex IT organizations across European, US, Middle Eastern, and African markets. He promotes the adoption of GenAI in software delivery.

speakers.name: Claudio Ricci
speakers.title: Head of Cloud & AI
speakers.bio:
Born in 1974, he holds a degree in Electronic Engineering and an MBA. After an experience in a multinational telecom company, he joined TIM within the Enterprise Sales division, where he held various technical and sales roles.
He is currently responsible within TIM Enterprise for the offering of IT and Cloud solutions and for TIM’s Digital Marketplace.
Passionate about technology and innovation, he closely follows the evolution of Cloud and Artificial Intelligence, both from a technological perspective and in terms of their impact on business and society at large.

speakers.name: Piergiorgio De Campo
speakers.title: Head of Consulting Services
speakers.bio:
He is a manager and strategic leader with solid, long-standing experience in the IT and telecommunications sector. He is currently Head of Consulting Services at TIM S.p.A., where he successfully leads a multidisciplinary team dedicated to consulting, design, and management of complex, tailored IT solutions for clients.
He has a strong entrepreneurial background: from 2013 to 2020 he was Founder and CEO of Noovle S.r.l., a leading Cloud System Integrator and partner of major technology players such as Google, Amazon AWS, and Salesforce. Under his leadership, the company experienced exponential growth, culminating in its acquisition by TIM S.p.A. Following this transaction, he continued his executive path within the TIM Group, serving as Head of Professional & Managed Services for Noovle S.p.A. from 2020 to 2023.
He holds a degree in Computer Science from the University of Milan and combines strong leadership and team-building skills with deep technical expertise in AI, Cloud Computing, and Big Data. Throughout his career, he has demonstrated the ability to integrate deep technological knowledge with a strategic, results-driven, and innovation-oriented vision.

speakers.name: Gabriele Granato
speakers.title: CMO
speakers.bio: Digital entrepreneur and marketing consultant. CMO at Ellycode and Board member of Fare Digitale. He lectures at universities and private institutions and is the author of publications on marketing and digital communication.

speakers.name: Michele Aponte
speakers.title: CEO e CTO
speakers.bio: CEO & CTO at Ellycode. He started as a software developer and consultant, active in tech communities and recognized as Microsoft MVP (Developer Technologies and AI). Founder of Blexin and Ellycode, he promotes data and AI adoption to support SMEs in strategic decision-making.

speakers.name: Diego Zunino
speakers.title: Customer Engineer
speakers.bio: Software Developer and Customer Engineer at Ellycode. He works on software development and customer support, contributing to the implementation and effective use of the platform.

speakers.name: Annalisa Maiorano
speakers.title: Analista Senior Organizzazione Processi di Governo
speakers.bio:
She holds a degree in Business Economics from the University of Pavia and has over twenty years of experience at Banco BPM, where she has developed broad, cross-functional expertise in the banking sector.
She currently serves as a Senior Organisational Analyst within Governance Processes, where she is responsible for monitoring process effectiveness and efficiency, driving innovation, and ensuring alignment with business requirements, regulatory standards, and organisational models.

speakers.name: Marco Gulino
speakers.title: Analista Senior Gestione Modelli Organizzativi e Progetti
speakers.bio:
Senior Analyst in Organisation with experience in designing and evolving organisational models and processes, she has supported initiatives focused on simplification, change, and transformation, also through the integration of management systems and the harmonisation of internal regulations.
She holds a degree in Management Engineering and an MBA, and applies an analytical approach combined with a managerial mindset developed in structured environments, steering her work towards measurable outcomes and value creation for the business.

speakers.name: Fabio Ciolino
speakers.title: Head of Product
speakers.bio:
Fabio Ciolino is an experienced IT professional with a strong background in cloud and data center services, product management, and business analysis. He currently serves as Head of Product at Aruba Cloud (Aruba Group), leading business growth initiatives through the development of solutions designed to strengthen IT infrastructure, while ensuring sustainable growth through strategic planning, service innovation, and operational efficiency.
With over ten years of experience in technology-related roles, he has worked across various sectors, including connectivity within the stock market industry, IT service management, and software development.
His expertise ranges from cloud computing and data center operations to business development and strategic product innovation.

speakers.name: Giorgio Sbriglia
speakers.title: CEO
speakers.bio:
Giorgio Sbriglia is the CEO of Terakraft AI, a company transforming Norway’s industrial and energy heritage into the infrastructure backbone of the AI era.
In Sauda, Norway, Giorgio is leading the redevelopment of a former 1919 hydropower plant into a green, high-density AI data center designed for next-generation GPU workloads. What began as the reconversion of a historic power asset into a server farm has evolved into a broader mission: proving that legacy industrial infrastructure can be reborn as strategic digital infrastructure for the future.
Giorgio combines deep engineering expertise with entrepreneurial execution. Before leading Terakraft AI, he spent almost nine years at Eni, working on complex international energy projects across Norway, Angola, Mozambique, France, the UK and Italy. His background in nuclear energy Engineering, subsea systems and large-scale project delivery gives him a rare ability to bridge energy, engineering and digital infrastructure.
He is also a co-founder at Vitruvian Intelligence AG, where he leads key investments in data centers, AI software and industrial technology.
At AI Week, Giorgio will share Terakraft AI’s journey: how a historic hydropower site in Norway is being transformed into a platform for sustainable AI compute - connecting the energy systems of the past with the intelligence infrastructure of the future.

speakers.name: Mattia Pasquali
speakers.title: Chief of Staff
speakers.bio:
Mattia Pasquali is Chief of Staff at Terakraft AI, where he supports the executive team in transforming strategic vision into aligned execution for the company’s AI-ready data center development in Sauda, Norway. His role focuses on coordination across management, investors, partners and operational workstreams, ensuring that critical priorities are translated into decisive action.
Mattia is also co-founder and Managing Partner at Vitruvian Intelligence AG, a Swiss investment and project-development company focused on early-stage ventures across finance, energy and AI. He has a strong background in strategic partnerships, business development and digital transformation, including leadership roles at  Ufficio Appalti, Tenders Club and PoseidonWave Srl.
Earlier in his career, Mattia spent six years at Bloomberg LP, working in fixed income electronic trading managing key institutional relationship across Switzerland, Luxembourg, Greece and Central and Eastern Europe.
At AI Week, Mattia will speak on behalf of Terakraft AI about the execution challenges and strategic opportunities behind building the next generation of AI infrastructure.

speakers.name: Roberto Serra
speakers.title: SEO Expert
speakers.bio: Da 20 anni aiuto aziende a trasformare le ricerche in clienti. Ho visto cambiare tutto — più volte. Ho scritto Visibilità, il super potere che viene dal web, fatto un TEDx su come rubare il lavoro a un'AI e sono stato invitato al Senato a parlare di cosa sta succedendo alla ricerca con l’AI.

speakers.name: Attilio Trovato
speakers.title: Digital Transition Manager
speakers.bio:
Attilio Trovato was born in 1993. He is a computational linguist specialized in Big Data Analysis, Python programming, and AI research. He earned a degree in Linguistics from University of Siena and a second-level Master’s degree in Big Data and Social Mining from University of Pisa.
He worked at Octo Telematics and Capgemini as a programmer and consultant, and since September 2025 he has held the position of Digital Transition Manager at Intrawelt.
He has contributed to the development of patented technologies as an inventor and throughout his career has collaborated on projects in the fields of smart mobility, quantum computing, and Artificial Intelligence.

speakers.name: Stefano Massimino
speakers.title: co-founder e CMO
speakers.bio: Co-founder and CMO of Vulkano S.r.l., an innovative startup specialized in Edge AI solutions for retail and physical spaces. Alongside his role at Vulkano, he is the founder of AMMU Cannoli, now one of the most recognizable Sicilian formats in the Italian food service landscape, with outlets in Milan, Campania, and Palma de Mallorca. With a business background, he has developed expertise in strategy, marketing, business development, and organizational management.

speakers.name: Sebastiano Massimino
speakers.title: CFO
speakers.bio:
Sebastiano Benedetto Massimino is co-founder of Vulkano S.r.l., an innovative startup bringing Edge AI into physical spaces. Alongside his role at Vulkano, he is a Chartered Accountant, Certified Auditor, and Partner at Centocinquanta Legal & Tax Advisors, where he supports SMEs and technology-driven companies in strategic planning, business planning, and subsidized finance.
He also serves as Statutory Auditor and Board Member for both public and private companies, and as Data Protection Officer (DPO).

speakers.name: Emanuele Zamponi
speakers.title: Co-founder
speakers.bio: Founder of Mela Works, a platform for digitizing field work collaboration. Entrepreneur and innovator with experience in engineering and business management, focused on digital transformation of industrial and operational processes.

speakers.name: Alessio Arcudi
speakers.title: Head of AI
speakers.bio: AI professional with a PhD. He works in research and application of artificial intelligence solutions, with a focus on innovation and the development of advanced technologies.

speakers.name: Massimiliano Concas
speakers.title: founder of the deep-tech startup
speakers.bio: Massimiliano Concas, founder of the deep-tech startup Ciber Fabbrica, is an Italian Data Science and AI expert who formalized the mathematical framework known as Relational Calculus.

speakers.name: Alessandro Piva
speakers.title: Direttore Osservatorio Artificial Intelligence
speakers.bio:
Alessandro Piva is a recognized expert in the field of artificial intelligence in Italy. He is the Director of several Digital Innovation Observatories at the School of Management of the Polytechnic University of Milan, including the Artificial Intelligence Observatory, the Cybersecurity & Data Protection Observatory, the Data Center Observatory, and the new European Digital Tech Watch Observatory, an initiative that analyzes the digital maturity of European organizations and fosters dialogue between institutions, businesses, and academia.
With twenty years of experience in digital innovation research, Piva has made a significant contribution to the understanding and development of AI in business contexts. He has spoken at numerous events and conferences, including TEDx, focusing in particular on the opportunities and challenges of generative and creative artificial intelligence.
He is also the author of articles and publications on topics such as artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, and digital transformation, actively contributing to both public and scientific debate on these subjects.

speakers.name: Victoria Abed
speakers.title: Chief Revenue Officer

She headed the marketing & sales departments at Adobe Systems Inc. (Ukraine & CIS), Allbiz, Weblium, and Bitrix24 Ukraine. For more than 7 years, she has been growing sales and marketing professionals by teaching and mentoring them.

speakers.name: Frederik Van Ruijven

 and aerospace engineer, has led complex technology programs for over 30 years, integrating AI, data, and enterprise systems to drive operational efficiency, strategic control, and industrial value.

speakers.name: Raffaele Pacassoni

speakers.name: Giuseppe Giorgianni
speakers.title: CEO & Founder

Forbes named him among the leading experts in telemedicine and digital health, while la Repubblica described him as “the modern-day Archimedes of Sicily,” including him among the 500 most influential Italians in the field of Artificial Intelligence.
An international speaker at events such as CES in Las Vegas, GITEX Global in Dubai, and WAICF in Cannes, he promotes a human-centered, practical, and strategic approach to technological innovation.

speakers.name: Aldo Podestà

speakers.name: Andrea Perego

speakers.name: Andrea Gerardi

My job is to move AI out of slides and bring it into companies. Working, every day.

speakers.name: Davide Carlomagno

speakers.name: Marco Mezzapesa

speakers.name: Vincenzo Salerno

speakers.name: Luca Mastella

Deep expertise in process improvement, automation and Lean Six Sigma, combined with commercial vision and hands-on execution. Guides Italian companies toward a concrete, measurable AI-first approach.

speakers.name: Massimiliano Tedeschi
speakers.title: Co-Founder & Managing Director Italy, New Digital Intelligence
speakers.bio: Co-Founder and Managing Director Italy at NDI. An extensive executive leadership career in the European ICT sector, with direct P&L ownership, go-to-market strategy and international team management. Recognised for driving growth and innovation in highly competitive markets.

speakers.name: Gary Shannon

speakers.name: Michael Burian
speakers.title: Founder & CEO, New Digital Intelligence

speakers.name: Elio Caiaffa

speakers.name: Beatrice Sbalchiero

speakers.name: Enzo Picardi

At AI Week, she will present practical strategies for approaching digital transformation, combining operational efficiency with regulatory robustness.

Named among Fortune Italia’s 40 Under 40 (2021). Author of “From Zero to Millions Without Investors.” CIO of the Innova Semplice Group (€100M+ revenue) and co-founder of Unicorn — the community of over 3,000 real estate investors using AI to democratize access to the Italian PropTech market.

speakers.name: Petar Stoyanov
speakers.title: Founder of Orender AI - AI filmmaker and educator

Petar is a 3D artist from Bulgaria with many years of experience in architectural visualization and digital arts.

speakers.name: Fabrizio Miranda
