speakers.bio: Giovanni Luca Caiazzo is Business Development Manager at Minnovo, where he focuses on building connections between innovation, business, and emerging technologies. With a background that combines strategic vision and technological expertise, he supports companies and organizations in identifying growth opportunities through AI, digital transformation, and new business models. He also contributes to the development of Minnovo’s community by promoting a culture of innovation and experimentation.

speakers.name: Fabio Momola
speakers.title: Executive Vice President di Eng Digital, Engineering
speakers.bio:
Executive Vice President di Engineering Ingegneria Informatica Digital, la Business Unit del Gruppo Engineering che guida la trasformazione digitale dei clienti end-to-end, dalla definizione della strategia fino all’implementazione di soluzioni integrate in ambito AI, Cloud, Cybersecurity, Digital Experience, Application Modernization ed Enterprise Applications.
È inoltre CEO di Engineering D.HUB, Cybertech, Atlantic Technologies, ExtraRed e Crispy, società del Gruppo Engineering.

speakers.name: Paolo Zangrillo
speakers.company: Dipartimento della Presidenza del Consiglio dei ministri
speakers.title: Ministro per la Pubblica Amministrazione della Repubblica italiana

speakers.name: Danilo Longoni
speakers.title: CEO
speakers.bio:
Danilo Longoni is the CEO and founder of Focus Informatica and has been a tech entrepreneur for over 30 years. After a career that began in software development and business intelligence, he now leads innovation projects focused on the practical application of artificial intelligence in business processes.
He works on the evolution of AI platforms across multiple business areas, including quality management, knowledge management, and operational automation, with the goal of making AI a truly useful, accessible, and integrated tool in everyday business operations.

speakers.name: Danilo Piran
speakers.title: CEO
speakers.bio: Computer engineer with a strong entrepreneurial mindset and extensive experience in digital innovation. Curious, pragmatic, and relationship-oriented, he combines technical expertise, strategic vision, and strong listening skills. He believes technology should simplify people’s work and improve processes while maintaining a strong focus on responsibility, method, and human value.

speakers.name: Simone Donnini
speakers.title: Senior Partner
speakers.bio: With solid experience in the IT sector, he supports companies in transforming complex visions into tailored digital solutions. He believes in strategic, pragmatic, and customer-oriented leadership, where innovation, reliability, and expertise drive every project toward measurable results.

speakers.name: Roberto Tedesco
speakers.title: Specialista AI, NLP
speakers.bio:
Engineer and PhD, he has been working in Natural Language Processing at Politecnico di Milano since 2001. Since 2021, he has been a researcher at SUPSI.
Author of articles and books in the field of neural networks, he holds a patent related to the translation of LIS (Italian Sign Language). He currently collaborates with King Company.

speakers.name: Maurizio Sansone
speakers.title: CEO Nicma Company
speakers.bio: Founder and CEO of Nicma Company, he has been supporting companies in their digital transformation journeys for over 25 years.

speakers.name: Simone Rizzo
speakers.title: Commercial Director
speakers.bio: Over 20 years leading growth and expansion across Europe, with expertise in go-to-market strategy, B2B and SaaS sales & marketing, P&L management, scale-up operations, and M&A. Entrepreneurial mindset and pragmatic approach. Professional Life Coach, because people make the difference. Mountaineer and avid reader.

speakers.name: Gianluca Favro
speakers.title: Managing Director Virtual Land
speakers.bio: Leading a team specialized in IT solutions, ERP, BI, cloud, and AI, with the goal of making technology a concrete driver of growth, innovation, and competitiveness.

speakers.name: Donato Ramunno
speakers.title: Direttore Generale
speakers.bio: Donato Ramunno is a geologist who graduated from the University of Basilicata, where he completed a thesis on hydrogeological instability in the Basilicata region. He is the Director General and Administrative Director of ARPAB – the Regional Agency for Environmental Protection of Basilicata, a role he has held in his second mandate since 2022. He has over twenty-five years of experience in hydrogeological risk management and environmental protection, gained through both freelance professional activity and roles within the public administration. He also holds national-level positions, including participation in the MASE–SNPA Coordination Table for the implementation of the EU regulation on methane emissions, and membership in the Board of Directors of the TERN Consortium. He has worked as a scientific consultant, participated in commissions and selection panels, and is an author and speaker in the scientific field, with publications and presentations on geology, environmental science, and biodiversity. In the past, he has also held institutional roles as President of Commissions on Environment, Territory, and Budget.

speakers.name: Vito Valentino
speakers.title: Collaboratore Tecnico
speakers.bio: Vito Valentino holds a degree in Physics from the Department of Physics at the University of Bari. He subsequently obtained two Master’s degrees in Information Technology from the same Department and from the Polytechnic University of Bari. He is also a specialist in Medical Physics from the University of L’Aquila. He currently works at the Radioactivity and Asbestos Office of ARPA Basilicata – Matera office, where he is involved in gamma spectrometry applied to environmental and food matrices.

speakers.name: Giuseppe Azzone
speakers.title: Managing Director - Milan Monks
speakers.bio: Giuseppe Azzone is a marketing and communications professional with experience in managing digital projects and integrated creative strategies. He currently holds a leadership role at Monks, where he drives initiatives focused on transforming creative workflows through artificial intelligence and technological innovation. His work centers on evolving traditional agency models into more automated, data-driven, and scalable ecosystems.

speakers.name: Wesley ter Haar
speakers.title: co-fondatore e Chief AI Officer di Monks
speakers.bio: Wesley ter Haar is Co-Founder and Chief AI & Revenue Officer at Monks, a global leader in digital creativity and production. With over 20 years of experience, he has helped evolve Monks from a creative studio into a worldwide ecosystem integrating content, data, and technology. Today, he focuses on driving the shift toward agentic systems, where artificial intelligence enables new levels of automation, scalability, and real-time creative relevance.

speakers.name: Emanuele Cacciatore
speakers.title: Director of Innovation, Consulting and Partnerships, Engineering
speakers.bio: Manager with solid international experience gained across leading strategy consulting firms and Big Tech companies. At AI Week, he brings strategic vision and hands-on experience in AI, digital transformation, and the future of work, bridging technology, business, and organizational impact.

speakers.name: Valeria Aste
speakers.title: Consultant Team di Business & Technology Consulting, Engineering
speakers.bio: She contributes to digital transformation initiatives and strategic advisory, leveraging expertise and experience in the AI & Data domain. At AI Week, she participates as a moderator, facilitating dialogue between vision, approach, and real-world experience.

speakers.name: Egidio Ghiorzo
speakers.title: Head of ICT, Bonatti
speakers.bio: He leads IT strategy and cybersecurity in an international, multi-site environment, overseeing IT governance, digital transformation, and information security for globally distributed operations.

speakers.name: Andrea Podda
speakers.title: Chief Innovation & Growth di Villanova.ai
speakers.bio: With a long-standing background in tech and digital, focused on innovation, industrial models, and advanced technologies. As Chief Innovation & Growth at Villanova.ai, he leads strategy and teams, turning ideas and research into practical, scalable, and market-oriented GenAI solutions.

speakers.name: Luca La Brocca
speakers.title: Senior business development manager
speakers.bio:
I represent Villanova.ai, a company backed by Expert.ai and focused on federated GenAI ecosystems.
With over 25 years of experience in digital and innovation, I currently work on strategic partnerships, commercial agreements, and business development, delivering concrete AI solutions to enterprises and public administrations.

speakers.name: Enrico Giardini
speakers.title: CTO & Co-Founder
speakers.bio: Manufacturing entrepreneur, who for 20 years led Giardini Group across international markets. Today he is CTO and Co-Founder of G&G NextGen, operating at the intersection where business leadership meets AI—translating its potential into concrete tools for Italian SMEs.

speakers.name: Irakli Bano
speakers.title: CIO - Chief Information Officer
speakers.bio: CIO | CISO | CTO with experience in management consulting and IT, specialized in digital transformation, cybersecurity, and project management. He has held senior technology leadership roles, driving innovation and leading teams within structured organizations. He holds a background in economics and a master’s degree in project management.

speakers.name: Alessandro Broglia
speakers.title: Co-Founder
speakers.bio:
Alessandro Broglia is an aerospace engineer and co-founder of Up2You, where he helps companies turn sustainability into a growth driver through data-driven ESG strategies and AI applications.
He is also a consultant, lecturer, and content creator. Through his channel “IMPATTO,” he explores the intersection between sustainability, technology, and current affairs, contributing to a broader understanding of sustainable innovation.

speakers.name: Leonardo D’Itri
speakers.title: CEO e co-founder
speakers.bio: Leonardo D’Itri has over twenty years of experience in Knowledge Management. In 2023, he published his first book with Tecniche Nuove, Advanced Knowledge Management. A New Vision for Managing Corporate Knowledge. He is currently CEO and co-founder of Aryanna, as well as a lecturer at several Italian universities and at the School of Knowledge.

speakers.name: Matteo Dora
speakers.title: CTO
speakers.bio: Matteo is the CTO of Giskard, where he leads the company’s AI Security Research team. A pioneer in the field of AI red teaming, he notably recorded the first online course on the subject alongside Andrew Ng and has developed unique expertise in security auditing for Generative AI applications. Together with his team, he conducts security assessments for organizations in highly regulated industries. Prior to focusing on AI security, he conducted academic research in neuroscience and applied mathematics.

speakers.name: Fabio Guadagnini
speakers.title: Direzione Marketing, Commerciale  Comunicazione e Media
speakers.bio:
Fabio Guadagnini is a media executive, journalist, and communication strategist with over 30 years of experience in the sports industry. He began his television career in 1991 and, since 2008, has held top leadership roles at Sky, including Director of Sky Sport and Sky Sport 24.

He led the launch of major projects such as Sky Sport F1 HD and Fox Sports Italy. Later, he served as the Chief Communications Officer for AC Milan and directed the communications strategy for the Rome 2024 Olympic bid.

speakers.name: Alessandro Scipioni
speakers.title: Senior Editor, Sky Sport Events Lead – Football & Basketball
speakers.bio:
Alessandro Scipioni is a Senior Editor at Sky Sport, where he oversees football and basketball events. A member of the Sky team since 2005 and a professional journalist since 2006, he has built extensive expertise in editorial management and live production for major international events.

His track record includes high-profile coverage of the FIFA World Cup, UEFA Euro, and the UEFA Champions League. He has also managed UEFA and FIBA competitions, with a strategic focus on innovation, emerging technologies, and branded content in collaboration with Sky Media.

speakers.name: Luisella Fusco
speakers.title: Media Operations & Broadcast Director
speakers.bio:
Luisella Fusco is the Media Operations & Broadcast Director at Lega Serie A. A manager with extensive experience in the sports media, broadcasting, and live production sectors, she leads the production, distribution, and enhancement of audiovisual content for Italy's top-tier football league.

In her role, she coordinates media operations, broadcaster relations, and media services on both a national and international scale.

speakers.name: Nino Ragosta
speakers.title: Founder
speakers.bio:
Nino Ragosta is the founder and CEO of Fantacalcio, one of the most influential entities in Italy's digital football entertainment landscape.
An entrepreneur and innovator, he transformed an online community of enthusiasts into a benchmark platform for millions of fans, redefining how football is experienced, narrated, and shared in the digital age.

speakers.name: Lorena Martini
speakers.title: Direttrice UOC Formazione ECM Agenas
speakers.bio: Lorena Martini is the Head of the Continuing Medical Education (CME) Unit at AGENAS and serves as National Secretary of the Commission for Continuing Education. An expert in healthcare education and management, she has held positions at local health authorities (ASL), the Ministry of Health, and the INMI Spallanzani. She has been a lecturer since 1995 and is the author of numerous publications.

speakers.name: Gianfilippo Valentini
speakers.title: Founder
speakers.bio:
Gianfilippo Valentini is the Founder of the Social Football Summit and specializes in communication, innovation, and projects dedicated to the development of the sports industry.
Through the Social Football Summit, he has helped establish a landmark event for fostering dialogue between football, media, and innovation.

speakers.name: Massimo Piras
speakers.title: CEO
speakers.bio: CEO of a tech company specializing in cloud and data-driven solutions, with a Master’s in Data Science from the University of Illinois Chicago and 10+ years of experience in AI and data analytics. Leverages business and AI know-how to modernize processes, improve efficiency, and turn data into business insights.

speakers.name: Stefano Perfetti
speakers.title: Chief Technology & Marketing Officer
speakers.bio: Technology and business leader with 25+ years of experience driving transformation programs, improving processes, and leading organizational change. Passionate about turning business challenges into practical, technology-driven solutions with a strong focus on execution and innovation.

speakers.name: Daniele Decaro
speakers.title: CEO
speakers.bio: CEO of a tech company specializing in cloud and data-driven solutions. With deep expertise in cloud architecture, data platforms, system integration, and IoT, leads teams building scalable, intelligent solutions that modernize operations and improve performance and efficiency in complex markets.

speakers.name: Andrea Rinaldi
speakers.title: Instrumentation & Test Systems Director
speakers.bio: Held management roles in automotive companies, starting in CFD simulations before moving to turbocharger R&D. After leading business development in testing solutions across South Europe, joined AVL in 2018 as Sales Director for Italy, and has managed the Instrumentation & Test Systems BU since 2021.

speakers.name: Maurizio Bramezza
speakers.title: CMO
speakers.bio: With 36 years of experience leading corporate marketing and communications across diverse industries, drives strategy and brand development with clarity and impact. Builds and leads teams in marketing, communications, PR, and creative content, turning complex messages into coherent, professional campaigns.

speakers.name: Moreno Callea
speakers.title: Corporate Business Director Cloud AI
speakers.bio:
Corporate Business Director at Microsoft
. Experienced sales manager in the software industry, specialized in sales, partner management, CRM and go-to-market strategy. Graduated from Alta Scuola Politecnica, he supports companies in digital innovation and growth initiatives.

speakers.name: Andrea Passadori
speakers.title: CEO Digital Pills
speakers.bio:
Andrea Passadori is the CEO of Digital Pills, a data and AI consulting firm built from the ground up to serve enterprise clients across Europe in ecommerce, retail, fashion, and financial services.
Before founding Digital Pills, he co-founded Fluentify, the London-based language learning platform, where he led the company’s evolution from a B2C model to enterprise growth.
He studied Marketing at University of Turin and earned a Master’s degree in Econometrics and Quantitative Economics from ESCP Business School.
Outside the office, you’ll likely find him on a climbing wall, along a mountain ridge, or riding a motorcycle.

speakers.name: Gabriele Bruno Franco
speakers.title: Data Engineer
speakers.bio:
Gabriele Bruno Franco is a Software Data Engineer and builder focused on developing AI systems powered by LLMs, data-driven platforms, and solutions that turn data and automation into tangible products.
He holds degrees in Computer Engineering and Data Science and Engineering from Polytechnic University of Turin and primarily works with Python and cloud infrastructure.
Outside the office, you’ll probably find him on a tennis court trying to avoid double faults — with limited success.

speakers.name: Cristiano Redona
speakers.title: CEO PUPAU - Build your Agentic Workforce
speakers.bio:
Cristiano Redona is the CEO of PUPAU AI, ISO 42001 Lead Auditor, author of the book Mind Breach, and Strategic Director at ENIA.
He works at the intersection of innovation, governance, and compliance.

speakers.name: Riccardo Nasuti
speakers.title: Strategic Advisor
speakers.bio: Senior Digital & Media Consultant in sports and Strategic Advisor. He has international experience in the football industry, working with organizations such as AS Roma, ACF Fiorentina and World Soccer Agency, focusing on media, digital and sports strategies.

speakers.name: Michael Mansard
speakers.title: Principal Director and Global Co-Chair of the Subscribed Institute at Zuora
speakers.bio: Michael Mansard is a strategist and thought leader in AI monetization, recurring revenue, and the Subscription Economy. At Zuora, he advises companies on pricing innovation, AI business models, and scalable recurring revenue strategies across SaaS and traditional industries. His work focuses on the future of monetization, agentic AI, and outcome-based pricing.

speakers.name: Francesco Del Bello
speakers.title: WashPass Sr. Leader at Haier Europe
speakers.bio: Francesco Del Bello is a business and technology leader with a strong background in engineering, servitization, and recurring revenue models. With experience across industrial innovation, SaaS, and Equipment-as-a-Service strategies, he focuses on helping companies drive growth through digital transformation, AI-driven business models, and customer-centric innovation. He combines technical expertise with strategic leadership and a passion for scalable business evolution.

speakers.name: Giulio Salvucci
speakers.title: CEO & Co-founder di Search Bridge
speakers.bio:
Giulio Salvucci is CEO and Co-Founder of Search Bridge. He is building the European platform that measures what AI believes about brands — not just what it says.
With over 20 years of experience in digital luxury, he is a former executive at GEOX and YOOX Net-A-Porter, and has launched digital platforms for Saint Laurent, Balenciaga, Armani, and Moncler.
He focuses on GEO, AI search, and the future of commerce.

speakers.name: Alessandro Leoni
speakers.title: Global Digital Business Director at Marni, OTB Group
speakers.bio: Digital & AI transformation executive with over 25 years of experience in luxury, fashion, and omnichannel business. International track record in scaling digital growth, leading global teams, managing P&L, and driving AI adoption and e-commerce transformation within complex organizations.

speakers.name: Federico Chinni
speakers.title: Amministratore Delegato
speakers.bio:
Federico Chinni is a life sciences executive with more than 20 years of national and international experience.
He began his career in the medical devices sector at Johnson & Johnson in 1998, later continuing his experience in other multinational companies such as Covidien and Sorin Group, while also serving on the board of Confindustria Dispositivi Medici. In 2012, he joined the pharmaceutical sector at AbbVie. Within the group, he held the position of Rheumatology Business Unit Head in Italy and later, at the European headquarters in Paris, served as Commercial Director for Rheumatology across Europe and Canada from 2016 to 2018. In April 2018, he joined UCB, a Belgian multinational leader in the development and commercialization of treatments for immunology, neurology, and rare diseases. Since 2019, he has been the CEO of the Italian affiliate. He also serves on the board of Farmindustria, where he is co-coordinator of the Digital & Connected Healthcare group, and on the board of Assobiotec. At INSEAD, he earned an ICC coaching certification in 2021 and a Certificate in Global Management in 2024.

speakers.name: Tommy “Vindex” Regano
speakers.title: Creatore, autore e animatore della serie “Colle S"

speakers.name: Antonio Barbatelli
speakers.title: CTO
speakers.bio: Antonio Barbatelli is CTO of PUPAU AI, Technical Director at Glue Labs, and a Cloud Architect with over 15 years of experience in distributed systems and cloud-native infrastructures. He leads the architecture and technical evolution of Pupau, both as a platform and product, with a focus on security, performance, compliance, and scalability. He works at the intersection of platform engineering, AI agents, and enterprise production systems.

speakers.name: Giuseppe Speziale
speakers.title: Vicepresidente
speakers.bio: Giuseppe Speziale is a physician and healthcare executive, currently serving as Vice President of GVM Care & Research, one of Italy’s leading groups in private healthcare and medical research. With extensive clinical and managerial experience, he focuses on healthcare innovation, clinical governance, and the development of organizational models aimed at excellence in patient care. He is committed to promoting the integration of medical expertise, research, and new technologies to address the future challenges of the healthcare sector.

speakers.name: Ilenia Dell’Aera
speakers.title: Responsabile Area Marketing
speakers.bio: Ilenia Dell’Aera is a professional specialized in healthcare marketing and strategic communication, currently serving as Head of Marketing at Poliambulatorio San Matteo. She is responsible for developing communication strategies, promoting healthcare services, and enhancing the patient experience, with a strong focus on innovation and the integration of healthcare and new technologies.

speakers.name: Federico Moretti
speakers.title: Equity Analyst
speakers.bio:
Analyst at AcomeA SGR, I cover the entire European market across both equities and credit. My approach to company valuation combines quantitative methods with fundamental data; if we were in the US, this would be called “Quantamental.”
I strongly believe that the power of analysis lies in the ability to simply represent complex systems.

speakers.name: Maria Teresa Squillaci
speakers.title: Head of Digital Communication Milano Cortina 2026
speakers.bio: Maria Teresa Squillaci is Head of Digital Communication for Milano Cortina 2026. She is a digital communications professional responsible for the strategy and management of digital channels related to the Olympic and Paralympic Winter Games, with the aim of enhancing the storytelling of the event, engaging a global audience, and strengthening the project’s digital presence through innovative content and multichannel strategies.

speakers.name: Antonio Montanaro
speakers.title: Deep Learning Scientist in computer vision and representation learning
speakers.bio:
I am Antonio Montanaro, a research scientist at Autodesk. I graduated in Theoretical Physics and earned a Ph.D. in Computer Vision and Representation Learning in Artificial Neural Networks.

At Harvard University, I joined Carlos Ramon Ponce’s Lab to study how biological neurons process visual information through the lens of AI models.

Over the past years, my research has focused on world models and generative systems, spanning image and video generation, game models, and 3D human motion modeling.

speakers.name: Paolo Vicchiarello
speakers.title: Capo Dipartimento della Funzione pubblica
speakers.bio: Paolo Vicchiarello is an Italian public sector executive and currently serves as Head of the Department of Public Administration at the Presidency of the Council of Ministers. Throughout his career in public administration, he has gained extensive experience in organizational and managerial roles, with a strong focus on innovation, digital transformation, and improving administrative efficiency. In his current role, he leads policies and initiatives aimed at developing public sector human capital and strengthening the administrative capacity of the State.

speakers.name: Marco Lucarelli
speakers.title: Director – GenAI Hub Leader
speakers.bio: Marco leads Deloitte's GenAI Hub, pioneering technology strategy and transformation. With 10+ years of IT consulting expertise across Aerospace & Defence, Telco & Media, Education, and Utilities, he accelerates GenAI adoption, drives digital innovation, and enables organizational transformation at scale.

speakers.name: Matteo Zanza
speakers.title: Partner - GenAI Change Management Leader
speakers.bio: Matteo transforms organizations from the inside out. As Human Capital Leader and GenAI Change Management Leader at Deloitte, he leverages 15+ years of international consulting across Aerospace & Defence, Telco, Automotive, and Postal Services to drive sustainable organizational change and unlock human potential.

speakers.name: Lisa Manzati
speakers.title: Director – GenAI Change Management
speakers.bio: Lisa helps organizations master digital transformation and GenAI adoption. At Deloitte, she guides change management strategies across SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow, and Oracle—blending Organizational Psychology expertise with practical reskilling to drive real, lasting impact.

speakers.name: Rafy Meghnagy
speakers.title: Director – GenAI Cyber Security
speakers.bio: Rafy leads Cloud Security and GenAI Cyber Security initiatives at Deloitte. As a Senior Cyber Security consultant within the Italian Cyber Risk practice since 2017, he specializes in CERT and SOC governance, infrastructure security, and compliance frameworks, protecting enterprises against evolving cyber threats.

speakers.name: Federico Crecchi
speakers.title: Partner – AI & Data
speakers.bio: Federico is Deloitte's AI & Data Partner, pioneering data science and quantitative finance solutions. With a Physics background and 15+ years building data science practices and leading cross-group AI initiatives, he empowers financial services organizations to harness advanced analytics and intelligent automation.

speakers.name: Riccardo Tiberia
speakers.title: AI Specialist
speakers.bio: Riccardo Tiberia is a professional specializing in artificial intelligence applied to digital processes and technological innovation. As an AI Specialist at Media Engineering, he develops AI-based solutions, automation systems, and workflow optimization strategies, helping companies and organizations adopt innovative technologies to improve efficiency and performance.

speakers.name: Andrea Pugliese
speakers.title: Dirigente della Regione Puglia –Servizio Controllo di Gestione delle Aziende del SSR e Governo del Sistema Informativo MOSS
speakers.bio:
Andrea Pugliese is a public sector executive with extensive expertise in the healthcare sector of Regione Puglia. Since 2019, he has served as a Director within the Department of Health Promotion, where he is responsible for the “Management Control of Regional Health Service Companies and Governance of the MOSS Information System” service. In this role, he oversees the strategic governance of management control for the Regional Health Service at a holding level, coordinates analytical accounting, budget monitoring, and the validation of ministerial economic models, while leading advanced performance analysis, standard cost evaluation (clinical/patient-level costing), and benchmarking across healthcare organizations.
He also serves as Contract Execution Director (DEC) for the MOSS Project, the unified administrative and accounting system designed to monitor and control regional healthcare spending, coordinating digitalization processes applied to expenditure monitoring.

speakers.name: Claudia De Leonardis
speakers.title: https://www.linkedin.com/in/claudiadeleonardis/
speakers.bio: Claudia is a strategic consultant specializing in content strategy and personal branding and founder @ innpurple. After spending two years in Milan, where she gained experience working with Italian companies, she founded innpurple, where she helps founders and professionals build an effective online presence through personalized coaching and content strategies on LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube.

speakers.name: Luca Romani
speakers.title: Regional Sales Director – Italy – Iberia – SSA
speakers.bio:
Sales leader with 25+ years in IT and Data Center markets, driving growth across Italy and EMEA. Experienced in international roles in Germany, US and panEMEA.
Led sales and business development for global players including Supermicro and Intel.

speakers.name: Robin Kuepers
speakers.title: Supermicro Director of Solutions EMEA
speakers.bio:
Robin Kuepers (1968) serves as Supermicro’s Director of Solutions for Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. In this role, he acts as a corporate ambassador for advanced server and storage infrastructure solutions, data centers, cloud computing, enterprise IT, AI factories, high-performance computing and big data, as well as embedded, edge, and IoT systems across the region.
As a member of the EMEA Product & Solutions Group (PSG), he represents the global Supermicro Systems Business Unit, working in close collaboration with Global Product Management and Research & Development teams.
He is responsible for evangelizing Supermicro’s datacenter and infrastructure vision and strategy to customers, partners, alliances, and key influencer communities, including industry analysts and the press. He is also a certified social media and community professional.
Robin joined Supermicro in April 2024, bringing with him more than 25 years of experience in the IT industry.
In addition to his role at Supermicro, he engages in independent consulting as a Regional Field CTO, supporting industry researchers, investor communities, and other third parties. With a strong foundation in thought leadership,he is adept at identifying and contextualizing technology trends, distinguishing between genuine innovation and market hype, analyzing competitive developments, and evangelizing emerging technologies.
Before joining Supermicro, he held a variety of international leadership roles at Dell Technologies, Getronics, and KPN, spanning marketing, product operations, business development, sales, product management, and executive management.
In addition, he served on the Board of Directors of the Storage Networking Industry Association (SNIA) from 2012 to 2014.
Robin has a strong technical background and studied Electronics.

speakers.name: Paolo Zani
speakers.title: Retelit - Head of Innovation Hub
speakers.bio:
At Retelit, in the role of Innovation Hub Director, he is responsible for translating customer needs into innovative and customized solutions. Leveraging a strong background in the design and implementation of cloud services, he leads strategic initiatives that contribute to the development of cutting-edge cloud infrastructures, supporting both pre-sales activities and business development.
His experience enables him to define tailored solutions and coordinate cross-functional teams to address complex project requirements. A strong focus on excellence and a collaborative approach ensure continuous alignment between organizational goals and customer needs.

speakers.name: Alessandro Bergamini
speakers.title: Founder di OSM Finance & Finexa
speakers.bio: Alessandro Bergamini is a business consultant and entrepreneur specializing in management control for SMEs, with a focus on profitability, cash flow, and financial planning. He is the founder of OSM Finance and Finexa, a platform that uses artificial intelligence to automate and digitize management control processes, helping entrepreneurs make faster, more informed, data-driven

speakers.name: Danilo Rivalta
speakers.title: Presidente FINIX Technology Solutions
speakers.bio: Danilo Rivalta is an executive with more than 25 years of experience in the ICT, cloud, and digital transformation sectors. He currently works at Retelit, contributing to the development of innovative solutions and advanced digital infrastructures, supporting enterprises and organizations in their technology innovation journey. Throughout his career, he has developed expertise in business development, pre-sales, cloud infrastructures, and digital strategies, with a strong customer and innovation focus.

speakers.name: Maurizio La Cava
speakers.company: Ceo & Co-founder MLC Presentation Design Consulting
speakers.title: https://www.linkedin.com/in/mauriziolacava/
speakers.bio: Maurizio La Cava is the CEO and Co-Founder of MLC Presentation Design Consulting, a company specialized in presentation design. He helps companies and executives transform complex projects into clear and persuasive communication, using proprietary, structured methodologies focused on delivering results.

speakers.name: Lorenzo Gagliardi
speakers.title: Lead Data Scientist TIM Enterprise
speakers.bio: Professional with experience in the ICT, cloud, and digital infrastructure sectors, focused on developing innovative solutions and supporting enterprise digital transformation. Throughout her career, she has developed expertise in business development, strategic relationship management, and technology innovation.

speakers.name: Marcello Demeglio
speakers.title: Marketing Manager Cloud & AI TIM Enterprise
speakers.bio:
Project and Demand Manager with several years of experience, distinguished by a strong aptitude for managing complex projects, supported by solid problem-solving skills and effective relationship management with various stakeholders, including clients and partners.
Currently, he serves as a Coordinator in the Cloud & AI offering area, primarily focusing on Cloud (SaaS) offerings, products, and partnerships. In addition, he is responsible for the marketing of both off-the-shelf and custom solutions in the field of Artificial Intelligence.

speakers.name: Andrea Massimo Fino
speakers.title: Senior Marketing Specialist Trust Technologies
speakers.bio:
Professional in the field of Digital Identity and Trusted Services, with a focus on regulatory compliance, strategic communication, and go-to-market of regulated services. He has followed the evolution of digital identity in Italy, from SPID and CIE to IT Wallet and eIDAS 2.0, working within an AgID/ACN-accredited QTSP inside the TIM Group.
His career combines Compliance & Governance and Marketing & Communications, aiming to translate the regulatory framework of trusted services into market positioning, project development, and effective communication. He is currently responsible for institutional and commercial communication of digital identity and qualified electronic signature services, while also contributing to tender analysis and participating in technical discussions on the evolution of digital trust in Europe.

speakers.name: Alessandro Sbandi
speakers.title: Data Scientist TIM
speakers.bio: Alessandro Sbandi is a student and professional in the field of Data Science and Information Technology, with experience in both academic and corporate environments. He is involved in data-driven solution development and research on recommendation systems and data analysis models, including scientific and applied contributions. He is currently also working within TIM.

speakers.name: Marco Antonio Desideri
speakers.title: Data Scientist TIM
speakers.bio: Marco Antonio Desideri is a professional working in the ICT and telecommunications sector, currently at TIM, with experience in academic and project-based work in data analysis and technology development. His background is in scientific and computer science fields, with a focus on data analysis, machine learning, and digital applications.

speakers.name: Matteo Mandelli
speakers.title: Artista e Art Director
speakers.bio: Matteo Mandelli is an artist and performer who combines creativity, experimentation, and contemporary languages to create engaging and original experiences. Through live performances and multidisciplinary artistic projects, he explores new forms of expression that blend art, entertainment, and innovation.

speakers.name: Lorenzo Cerulli
speakers.title: Deloitte GenAI Leader
speakers.bio:
Lorenzo Cerulli is GenAI Leader and Enterprise Technology & Performance Leader for Deloitte Central Mediterranean, as well as Life Sciences & Health Care Industry Leader for Deloitte Italy.
He has led complex technology transformation projects for major clients in both the private and public sectors, overseeing areas such as Tech Strategy, Technology Architecture, Tech & Cloud Transformation, and Process Automation through Robotic & Cognitive Solutions.

speakers.name: Matteo Garofalo
speakers.title: Director - GenAI Market Activation
speakers.bio: Matteo is a Director at Deloitte Consulting, driving GenAI Market Activation and guiding enterprise transformation. With 12+ years of IT advisory experience in strategy, governance, and compliance, he helps organizations navigate the AI revolution responsibly, strategically, and profitably while managing emerging risks.

speakers.name: Massimo Zanellato
speakers.title: Senior Manager - GenAI Market Activation
speakers.bio: Massimo is a Senior Manager at Deloitte Consulting, driving GenAI Market Activation and guiding enterprise transformation. With 10+ years of IT advisory experience in strategy, governance, and compliance, he helps organizations navigate the AI revolution responsibly, strategically, and profitably while managing emerging risks.

speakers.name: Paolo Casadei
speakers.title: CEO
speakers.bio: Paolo Casadei is an entrepreneur and executive in the telecommunications sector, currently serving as CEO of ZAL Telecomunicazioni. He leads the company in developing connectivity solutions, digital infrastructure, cybersecurity, and technological innovation for businesses, with a strong focus on sustainable growth and digital transformation. He promotes a vision in which technology, artificial intelligence, and human relationships work together to create tangible value for companies and local communities.

speakers.name: Rinaldo Pietro Platti
speakers.title: CEO
speakers.bio: Rinaldo Pietro Platti is the CEO of DGProlink, a company that combines Artificial Intelligence and a human-centered approach to innovate business processes. DGProlink implements and customizes reliable and innovative IT solutions, making workflows clearer and easier to manage. His vision is that technology only improves work when it places people at the center.

speakers.name: Fabrizio Vigo
speakers.title: Co-Founder e CEO
speakers.bio: Fabrizio Vigo has built extensive managerial experience in the field of big data for business. After holding roles at Ciments Français, Fiat, Italmobiliare, and Seat Pagine Gialle, he became CEO of Consodata in 2007. In 2017, he founded Sevendata. He is currently also Chairman of the Monitoring Body for the Privacy Code of Conduct on Commercial Information, with significant roles in European data marketing associations.

speakers.name: Milena Renzi
speakers.title: CEO  & Founder
speakers.bio: Milena Renzi is the CEO & Founder of Figaro, where she leads projects focused on safe and governed AI for SMEs and regulated industries. She has over 15 years of experience in general management, business development, and the Telco-ICT-IT sector, with a strong focus on data, processes, and partnerships.

speakers.name: Alessandro Spigaroli
speakers.title: Executive Director
speakers.bio: Executive leader driving tech transformation and business growth with a passion for vision, people and innovation. Executive Director at Engineering, CEO at Extra Red and General Manager at Atlantic Technologies.

speakers.name: Enrico Murru
speakers.title: Innovation Advocate Eng Platforms
speakers.bio: As Enterprise Platforms Innovation Advocate, he leads AI adoption strategies and cross-BU innovation programs at Eng Platforms. A Salesforce Architect since 2009 and long-time advocate for technical knowledge sharing, he was the first Italian professional inducted into the Salesforce MVP Hall of Fame.

speakers.name: Alessandro Marasciulo
speakers.title: Head of Data Integration & AI
speakers.bio: Within the Hera Group Information Systems organization, he leads the Technical Units responsible for Data Integration, Artificial Intelligence, and Digital Identity. He oversees the design, development, management, and evolution of technology platforms that support application ecosystems, driving efficiency and innovation across business processes.

speakers.name: Liviu Știrbăț
speakers.title: Head of unit at European Commission
speakers.bio: Liviu Știrbăț, is the Head of Unit for AI in Science in the DG for Research and Innovation at the European Commission. He worked previously as Member of Cabinet of EVP Margrethe Vestager in charge of innovation, space, and sustainability. He was Deputy Head of EU Adaptation to Climate Change, and also Deputy Head for better regulation for Horizon Europe. Before the European Commission, he worked at the OECD and the World Bank.

speakers.name: Shaden Alshammari
speakers.title: Research scientist
speakers.bio: Shaden Alshammari is a PhD student in EECS at MIT CSAIL, specializing in self-supervised learning and vision-language models. With a background in math and computer science, she is also a mentor and organizer in the international math olympiad community.

speakers.name: Andrea Aureli
speakers.title: Founder
speakers.bio: Andrea Aureli is the founder of Aiclo. He has helped over 300 companies build and scale their sales departments and has managed more than 500 salespeople. Today he is focused on developing Aiclo, a conversation intelligence software that enhances sales team performance through AI.

speakers.name: Tommaso Colombo
speakers.title: Head of AI
speakers.bio: Always been attracted by new, complex challenges, Tommaso developed a mix of consulting skills and deep technical competences. Currently, he leads the Artificial Intelligence division of Spindox, a group of 50+ highly-skilled professionals dedicated to R&D, project delivery and consulting in the AI field.

speakers.name: Massimiliano Di Blasi
speakers.title: AI advisor & Innovation Trainer - Docente AI Play
speakers.bio: Massimiliano Di Blasi is a consultant and trainer specializing in Artificial Intelligence applied to digital transformation. With over ten years of experience in the digital sector, he supports professionals and companies in adopting AI through training and consulting programs, helping them integrate new technologies into business processes to improve efficiency, innovation, and competitiveness.

speakers.name: Giorgia Carresi
speakers.title: Project Manager
speakers.bio: Giorgia Carresi is a Project Manager with over 7 years of experience in digital transformation and AI applied to healthcare, finance, telecom, and SMEs. She has deepened her expertise in process and data modeling methods, later acting as a Digital Accelerator in numerous technological innovation projects.

speakers.name: Gianandrea Facchini
speakers.title: Fondatore e Amministratore
speakers.bio:
Since 2007, I have been working in data analysis and social intelligence for large companies. I push the boundaries of the practical and effective adoption of AI in business.
When I’m not immersed in data, I run marathons and ultramarathons, explore mountain trails, or spend time with my two dogs. I am an avid reader and an enthusiast of modern and contemporary art.

speakers.name: Fabio Masini
speakers.title: CTO & CISO
speakers.bio: With 23 years of experience in digital services and products, he leads technology strategy and cybersecurity, integrating innovation, governance, and regulatory compliance at magnews.

speakers.name: Alessandro La Ciura
speakers.title: CEO & CO-FOUNDER
speakers.bio:
Alessandro’s passion for programming began at a very young age, at 13, during the era of the Commodore VIC20 and the first Personal Computers.
In 1996, he created chatexpert.it, the first Italian Java chat, adopted as a chat engine by well-known portals such as GQ and LYCOS, which was already being sold in a cloud model at the time.
In 2001, he realized that chat could have great potential in the business world for providing support, and in 2004 he registered the LiveHelp trademark.
From that moment, the chat was enriched with additional applications, and in 2016 Alessandro and his team created the first Omnichannel Digital Customer Care Suite in Italy, to which Artificial Intelligence was added starting in 2017.

speakers.name: Roberto Bellini
speakers.title: Direttore Generale
speakers.bio: Born in Rovigo, Roberto Bellini holds a degree in Computer Engineering. He has gained extensive experience in the IT sector as an executive in several companies involved in software development for business and professional associations. He has served as Head of the Technical Committee of AssoSoftware since its establishment, and since 2012 he has been the General Director of AssoSoftware.

speakers.name: Federico Agostini
speakers.title: AI Senior Engineer
speakers.bio: Graduated in Physics with an academic background in ML. I combine research and Cloud experience developing Autonomous Agents, Voice AI, and data extraction models. My focus is to transform the latest scientific innovations into concrete industrial solutions.

speakers.name: Vincenzo Merlo
speakers.title: Partner
speakers.bio: Vincenzo Merlo is a Partner at Cluster Reply. A Computer Engineer, he leads digital transformation projects for banks and insurance companies, with a focus on GenAI, cloud, and low-code, supporting the innovation of processes, systems, and applications in the Financial Services sector.

speakers.name: Donvan Grobler
speakers.title: EO Programme Manager | Story-driven EO Solutions
speakers.bio: Donvan Grobler is an Earth Observation Programme Manager at GeoVille with a strong passion for turning complex Earth Observation data into practical, story-driven solutions. He works at the intersection of science, innovation, and real-world impact, helping to lead EO initiatives, including terrAIntel, while advocating for better ways to translate geospatial data into meaningful insights for decision-makers. Through his professional work, he champions a future in which Earth Observation, AI, and strong communication come together to make geospatial intelligence more accessible, actionable, and impactful.

speakers.name: Emanuele Frontoni
speakers.title: Professore Ordinario di Informatica UNIMC, Co-Director del VRAI Vision, Robotics & Artificial Intelligence Lab
speakers.bio: Emanuele Frontoni is a Full Professor of Computer Science at the University of Macerata and co-director of the VRAI Lab, an Affiliated Researcher at the Italian Institute of Technology in Genoa, and since 2022 the Scientific Director of NemoLab at Niguarda Hospital in Milan. His research focuses on artificial intelligence and computer vision, human behavior analysis, augmented reality, and smart environments. He has authored over 300 international publications and collaborates with numerous companies. Since 2021, he has been included in the annual “World’s Top 2% Scientists” list (in the “Artificial Intelligence & Image Processing” category) curated by Stanford University and Elsevier, which ranks the top 2% most cited scientists worldwide.

speakers.name: Leonardo Viola
speakers.title: Head of Development
speakers.bio: A biomedical and bioelectronic engineer, he combines systemic thinking with a strong creative dimension. At QuantumSpace, as Head of Development, he designs visual intelligence infrastructures that transform complex images into structured data, blending scientific rigor with innovative vision.

speakers.name: Giampaolo Parravicini
speakers.title: Chief Technologist
speakers.bio: Giampaolo Parravicini is Chief Technologist at HP Italy, where he supports companies in digital transformation processes and the adoption of advanced technological solutions. With extensive experience in the IT sector, he focuses on innovation, digital services, and technology architectures, with particular attention to cybersecurity, cloud, and as-a-service models. In his role, he contributes to the development of technology strategies that support system modernization and the digital evolution of organizations.

speakers.name: Marinela Profi
speakers.title: Global AI and Generative AI Market Strategy Lead
speakers.bio: Marinela Profi is a professional focused on AI, GenAI, and data-driven market strategy. At SAS, she helps organizations improve decision-making with data and AI, with experience in regulated industries, public speaking, and academic advisory roles.

speakers.name: Sara Fraschini
speakers.title: Project Manager
speakers.bio: Sara Fraschini coordinates AI and Mathematical Modeling projects. With a PhD in Computational Mathematics, she combines deep technical expertise with a project management perspective. Her goal is to translate scientific innovation into strategic assets for businesses.

speakers.name: Alessandro Bruti
speakers.title: Revenue Ops Manager
speakers.bio: Specialist in GTM strategies and Customer Engagement. We build systems to transform complexity into value through processes and technology. We use AI to maximize team effectiveness by accelerating virtuous behaviors and driving exponential growth.

speakers.name: Nicola Laganà
speakers.title: VP of Marketing
speakers.bio: Nicola is VP of Marketing at Factorial, where he leads a global team of 180 people. With a strong background spanning FMCG (Ferrero, Reckitt) and tech (former CMO of Impress), he is now driving growth in strategic markets such as Italy, leveraging AI to simplify business operations.

speakers.name: Franco Marra
speakers.title: Docente IA SPI-CGIL
speakers.bio: Franco Marra, computer scientist and former software architect, Olivetti executive and later consultant, is one of the founders of the Forum for Digital Ethical Democracy and teaches computer science to seniors for SPI-CGIL, focusing in particular on topics such as cloud computing and artificial intelligence.

speakers.name: Derrick De Kerckhove
speakers.title: Direttore scientifico
speakers.bio: Derrick de Kerckhove is Scientific Director of Osservatorio TuttiMedia and Media Duemila. A media theorist, he is known for his work on the impact of digital technologies on society and communication.

speakers.name: Cristina Conti
speakers.title: Head of Customer Engineering
speakers.bio: Cristina Conti holds a leadership role in Customer Engineering and Applied AI in EMEA. She leads technical teams that work closely with customers to support the adoption of cloud and artificial intelligence solutions, with a particular focus on generative AI and business applications. Over the course of her career, she has focused on translating advanced technologies—such as machine learning, generative models, and platforms like Vertex AI—into concrete use cases for companies, contributing to digital transformation and process innovation. She is often a speaker at industry events and shares insights on artificial intelligence trends, with particular attention to the impact of AI on organizations, the scalability of solutions, and value creation through data.

speakers.name: Véronique Van Vlasselaer
speakers.title: AI & Data Science Manager EMEA
speakers.bio: Véronique Van Vlasselaer is leading the AI and Data Science team for Public Sector in EMEA at SAS, and is a true data science enthusiast. In her job, she passionately helps companies to envision and prepare for an AI-driven future, embrace the power of data science to support intelligent decisioning, and discover the real value in their data. Before she joined SAS, she graduated as Doctor in Business Economics at the KU Leuven (Belgium) with the department of Information Management and Decision Sciences. She is co-author of Fraud Analytics Using Descriptive, Predictive, and Social Network Techniques.

speakers.name: Jean-François Cabie
speakers.title: CCO & Managing Director
speakers.bio: With over 20 years of sales experience in the ICT field, Jean-François Cabie – CCO & Managing Director of BDP – drives B2B growth and the adoption of AI solutions supporting Customer Experience. Previously, he held various roles at Fastweb and Postel, significantly contributing to development in private and public markets.

speakers.name: Alessandro Spaziani
speakers.title: Chief Information Officer
speakers.bio: Senior Executive currently leading Corporate IT at Avio, previously working in Procter & Gamble on delivering IT Services and driving large SAP Transformation program as well as in other large IT companies like HP, Infosys and Avvale by developing strong IT consulting experience in SAP, Industry 4.0 Solutions, Cloud Architectures, AI-enabled Data platforms, CyberSec Strategy, Governance and Operations.

speakers.name: Vincenzo De Giovanni
speakers.title: Head of SAP Centre of Excellence
speakers.bio: Vincenzo De Giovanni is Head of SAP Centre of Excellence at the DGS Group and CEO of Allos. With solid experience in enterprise consulting, he drives innovation in organizational models by exploring the concrete impact of AI and cloud, integrating technology, strategy, and human value.

speakers.name: Chiara Montaldo
speakers.title: Head of the Medical Unit, Médecins Sans Frontières Italy
speakers.bio: Chiara Montaldo is a medical doctor specialised in Tropical Medicine and Epidemiology, with extensive experience at Médecins Sans Frontières since 2005 across infectious diseases, epidemics and migrant health. She is currently Head of the Medical Unit of MSF Italy.

speakers.name: Gaetano Rizzitelli
speakers.title: Founder & CEO
speakers.bio: Gaetano Rizzitelli, Founder & CEO of Widecons, is an AI & Digital Transformation Advisor with over 30 years of experience. He supports SMEs and industrial companies in integrating Artificial Intelligence and digital technologies into their processes, transforming data and operations into efficiency and competitive advantage.

speakers.name: Roberto Farina
speakers.title: Business Development Manager
speakers.bio: Passionate about technology with over 20 years of experience in innovation, I support companies in their digital transformation journey. I am currently a Business Development Manager at Cefriel, where I focus on helping organizations get the most out of AI, supporting them from strategy through to adoption.

speakers.name: Christian Koeppel
speakers.title: Tech Entrepreneur& co-founder
speakers.bio: Christian Koeppel is a tech entrepreneur and co-founder of Swisper, a Swiss-based AI development platform for enterprises. Swisper enables businesses to build products using AI along the entire value chain from vision to production, and deploy autonomous AI agents on its agent platform. Christian holds a PhD in Finance from University of St. Gallen and has extensive experience in enterprise-level IT projects for global wealth managers.

speakers.name: Antonio Franzese
speakers.title: Founder & CEO Media Engineering & AI SPECIALIST
speakers.bio: Founder & CEO of Media Engineering, serial entrepreneur with expertise in digital innovation and artificial intelligence. Passionate about new technologies, he has been supporting companies for 25 years in adopting high-tech projects, seeking the most suitable solutions to speed up, innovate, and automate business processes.

speakers.name: Andrea Cassoni
speakers.title: ​Global Head of Collaborative Robots
speakers.bio:
Andrea Cassoni leads ABB Robotics’ collaborative robotics division, where he drives the strategic growth of ABB cobot portfolio, the expansion of cobot distribution networks and the development of ecosystems that make automation more accessible.  With over 30 years of
experience in robotics and industrial automation, Andrea has been leading both local and global businesses, championed innovation, and supported market development across the robotics sector.

speakers.name: Fabio Menichini
speakers.title: Senior Manager
speakers.bio: Fabio Menichini is Senior Manager at Brembo Solutions, where innovation meets practical application. Fabio’s expertise spans marketing, sales, and technical strategy, enabling him to bridge the gap between technology and business impact. In Brembo since more than 10 years, Fabio advocates for solutions that deliver measurable value using AI while enhancing human activities valuing know how and creativity.

speakers.name: Simone Colombo
speakers.title: Partner Content & Community
speakers.bio: Simone Colombo is a partner at Logotel, where he contributes to the development of innovation, design, and organizational transformation projects. He works closely with national and international companies, supporting them in the evolution of their business models, processes, and experiences, with a collaborative approach focused on delivering tangible impact.

speakers.name: Attilio Abbadessa
speakers.title: Amministratore
speakers.bio: My name is Attilio Abbadessa, and together with my team, we specialize in developing next-generation chatbots designed to help businesses improve customer communication and optimize customer care processes. With our intelligent solutions, companies can provide faster, more efficient, and personalized support, turning customer interactions into a real competitive advantage.

speakers.name: Sven Schumacher
speakers.title: Head of Marketing
speakers.bio:
Sven Schumacher is the Head of Marketing at Interprefy, where he leads global marketing strategy, brand positioning, and demand generation for the company’s cloud-based multilingual solutions. With a strong background in marketing strategy and digital transformation, he has held multiple leadership roles driving brand growth and market expansion across international markets. In his role, Schumacher focuses on reinforcing Interprefy’s position as a leader in RSI (Remote Simultaneous Interpretation) and AI-powered language technology, while also championing revenue strategy & intelligence to ensure marketing is tightly aligned with pipeline growth, performance insights, and measurable business impact. He is particularly passionate about integrating AI into day-to-day marketing
operations—pioneering the use of AI-driven systems and workflows to enhance efficiency, decision-making, and scalability across the business. His approach extends beyond product innovation, embedding AI into the core of how marketing operates and delivers value.

speakers.name: Ziad Mabrouk
speakers.title: Founder & CTO
speakers.bio:
Ziad Mabrouk is the Founder and CTO of Archisphere LTD, an AI architecture firm focused on building sovereign, enterprise-grade AI infrastructure. With a strong background in enterprise architecture and digital transformation, he designs and delivers AI-driven platforms that enable organizations to move from experimentation to engineered AI systems.
He is the creator of My AI Foundry, a private and sovereign AI orchestration platform that allows enterprises to build, govern, and scale AI solutions while maintaining full control over data, models, and infrastructure.
With prior leadership roles in large-scale insurance and enterprise environments, Ziad brings deep expertise in policy systems, claims automation, and regulated digital workflows. Today, he focuses on advancing AI infrastructure at the intersection of architecture, governance, and intelligent automation.

speakers.name: Fabrizio Callery
speakers.title: Amministratore Delegato
speakers.bio: Fabrizio Callery joined GFT Italia in 2019 and has been CEO since 2022. He leads the group’s growth with a strong focus on innovation and a sustainable business model, benefiting clients, employees, and partners. He has over 20 years of IT experience, with a strong focus on the financial sector.

speakers.name: Matteo Cardaioli
speakers.title: Innovation Manager
speakers.bio: Matteo Cardaioli is an Innovation Manager at GFT Technologies Italy, where he focuses on driving innovation and digital transformation initiatives, with a particular emphasis on emerging technologies such as Artificial Intelligence, cloud computing, and data-driven solutions. In his role, he contributes to the development of new business models and the delivery of high-impact projects, supporting companies in their journey toward digitalization and the adoption of advanced technological solutions.

speakers.name: Tom Zglobicki
speakers.title: VP, Data Analytics Consulting
speakers.bio: Senior Data & AI leader with 20+ years’ experience turning complex challenges into practical solutions. At EPAM, Tom helps global organisations unlock value from data through modern platforms, AI adoption, and scalable operating models, combining technical depth with a pragmatic, execution-focused approach.

speakers.name: Chiara Arlati
speakers.title: COMMUNICATION & AI ADVISOR
speakers.bio:
From 2007 to 2012, she realized a professional dream working in Product Marketing at Apple, contributing to the launch of the first smartphone and the first tablet in history: the iPhone and iPad.
From 2012, she served as Field Force Manager at Samsung Italy, managing a team of 113 people as Sales Marketing Account across all product categories handled by the company.
Since 2015, she has been an entrepreneur with experience in business in Marketing, Space Economy, and Artificial Intelligence.
In 2016, she met the founders of LiveHelp, developing a deep personal and professional respect. In 2021, she began her collaboration with the company, eventually taking on the role of Communication & AI Advisor.
Since September 2025, she has been recognized by the LinkedIn News editorial team as one of the 10 AI voices to follow.

speakers.name: Fiorenza Succu
speakers.company: The Italian Institute of Artificial Intelligence (AI4I)
speakers.title: Chief Evangelist
speakers.bio: Fiorenza Succu is Chief Evangelist at AI4I, where she leads strategic communication and contributes to the development of the SUK ecosystem connecting companies with AI solutions. An aerospace engineer educated at Politecnico di Torino and KTH Royal Institute of Technology, she has experience across multiple industrial sectors and supports organizations in translating Artificial Intelligence into concrete industrial and business value.

speakers.name: Llion Jones
speakers.title: CTO and Co-Founder and Co-Author "Attention is all you need"
speakers.bio: Llion Jones is co-founder and CTO of Sakana AI, a Tokyo-based AI startup focusing on innovative AI models. A former Google researcher, he co-authored Attention Is All You Need, the paper that defined the Transformer architecture underlying modern generative AI.

speakers.name: Mercedes Bidart
speakers.title: CEO & Co-Founder
speakers.bio: Mercedes Bidart is CEO and co-founder of Quipu, a financing platform for micro-businesses in Latam with an AI-based equitable credit score. She studied in Buenos Aires and at MIT, supporting over 30,000 micro-businesses. In 2025, MIT Technology Review recognized her as an Innovator Under 35.

speakers.name: Antonio Bifulco
speakers.title: DevSecOps Engineer
speakers.bio: Computer engineering graduate with experience in cybersecurity, passionate about drones, licensed pilot.

speakers.name: Sante Roselli
speakers.title: Sales Director EMEA South
speakers.bio: Sante Roselli supports enterprises in the adoption of AI, automation, and digital platforms to orchestrate end-to-end processes, strengthen data-driven decision-making, and drive scalable operational efficiency. His focus is on delivering enterprise-grade AI embedded within core business workflows, enabling organizations to simplify operations, enhance performance, and generate measurable business value.

speakers.name: Aino Bergius
speakers.title: Special Project - CEO Office
speakers.bio: Aino Bergius is a tech and startup leader known for rising through Slush to become CEO. She led the world’s leading startup event and now works at Lovable, focused on enabling anyone to build software without coding.

speakers.name: Antonio Colasante
speakers.title: Chief Growth Officer
speakers.bio: Antonio Lanza is Head of Product and R&D, with experience in developing AI systems in production. He leads the development of Altilia Intelligent Automation, a no-code Agentic AI platform designed for end-to-end automation of enterprise workflows.

speakers.name: Niccolò Caramatti
speakers.title: CEO
speakers.bio:
Niccolò Caramatti is CEO and Founder of Giochiamo.ai, a company focused on applying artificial intelligence to behavioral data and predictive analytics. After several years in Investment Banking, he transitioned into the online gaming industry, bringing a strong background in quantitative models, risk assessment, and data-driven decision making.
He is the creator of PlaySafe, an AI-powered behavioral prediction platform designed to identify and prevent risky patterns and problem gambling, supporting operators in compliance, user protection, and responsible innovation. His work explores the intersection of AI, ethics, regulation, and real-world business impact.

speakers.name: Pascale Fung
speakers.title: Co-founder and CRIO
speakers.bio: Pascale Fung is Director of the Centre for Artificial Intelligence Research (CAiRE) at the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology and Chair Professor of Electronic and Computer Engineering.She specializes in machine learning, NLP and responsible AI, and is a recognized fellow of IEEE, ACL, ISCA, and AAAI worldwide.

speakers.name: Wayne Wang
speakers.title: Data Science & AI Coordinator
speakers.bio: Wayne is a data science and ai professional with over seven years of progressive experience across consulting, FMCG, luxury, automotive and advanced industrial innovation. Currently Wayne serves as Data Science and AI Coordinator at Brembo Inspiration Lab Shanghai. His role focuses on innovation scouting, emerging technology research, and translating cutting-edge AI into practical applications within Brembo’s global engineering and product ecosystem.

speakers.name: Ale Agostini
speakers.title: CEO
speakers.bio:
Ale Agostini is CEO of AvantGrade.com, an agency that integrates artificial intelligence into digital marketing services for Italian and multinational companies.
He previously worked at Ferrero, Campari, and Bruce Clay, and launched Karma Metrix. Since 2011, he has been publishing with Hoepli.
Alessandro has spoken at TEDx and other international events on SEO and artificial intelligence. He has trained thousands of professionals in digital marketing.

speakers.name: Fabio Massimo Nardella
speakers.title: CEO & Founder
speakers.bio: 10 years in marketing, then a bold move: building the voice AI layer for Italian enterprises before anyone else. Today, he manages a product that processes hundreds of thousands of calls per month.

speakers.name: David Attisano
speakers.title: Head of Data Analysis - Racing and R&D
speakers.bio: Graduated in Mechanical and Vehicle Engineering, with a Master’s in Vehicle Engineering, David started at FIAT Group and joined Ducati Corse in 2004 as Data Analyst and Engine Control Engineer, where he took on roles of increasing responsibility. Today he is Head of Data Analysis for Racing and R&D.

speakers.name: Giorgio David Jacchini
speakers.title: Senior Manager Data & Artificial Intelligence
speakers.bio: Senior Manager at Aubay Italia, he leads Data & AI initiatives and supports companies in the strategic adoption of artificial intelligence. A speaker at industry events, he promotes innovation to transform business models.

speakers.name: Alkid Zenuni
speakers.title: Senior Technical Consultant - AI SME
speakers.bio:
I have been working at Aubay for 10 years, where I design and develop AI solutions. After studying Computer Science at the Università degli Studi di Milano and completing a Master’s in Big Data & Advanced Analytics at the Università degli Studi di Milano-Bicocca, I have been focused on Machine Learning since 2016 and now on Generative AI.
My goal is to build practical tools that simplify the work of our teams and our clients.

speakers.name: Rochelle Wang
speakers.title: Director, Experience Consulting
speakers.bio: For 16+ years, Rochelle has proven that that human-centricity is a powerhouse for ROI. Spanning across Australia, China, and the Netherlands, she integrates innovation into business strategy, turning shoppers into advocates while driving serious value for icons like Zalando, Adidas, and Joe & The Juice.

speakers.name: Jacopo Naidi
speakers.title: INNOVIT Ecosystem Lead
speakers.bio: Jacopo Naidi is Ecosystem Lead at INNOVIT – Italian Innovation and Culture Hub in San Francisco, where he works to develop and connect the Italian innovation ecosystem with Silicon Valley. With experience in acceleration programs, venture building, and innovation, he supports startups, SMEs, and stakeholders in their international growth journey, fostering collaboration between companies, investors, and institutions.

speakers.name: Elena Mazzoleni
speakers.title: Data Science Manager
speakers.bio: Elena Mazzoleni is Data Science Manager at Brembo N.V., specialized in Statistical Learning, Machine Learning, and AI. With more than 8 years of experience from consulting to automotive manufacturing, she drives innovation through analytics and AI for Brembo and its partners.

speakers.name: Andrea Rubei
speakers.title: Co-Founder and CEO
speakers.bio: Andrea Rubei is Co-founder and CEO of myMeta Software, an AI-driven digital experience orchestration platform. Former Microsoft and Cisco executive with 25+ years in global tech, he blends enterprise software, SaaS, and UX expertise to power digital transformation worldwide.

speakers.name: Alessandro Moroni
speakers.title: Solution Consultant
speakers.bio: Born in Rome, where he earned a degree in Telecommunications Engineering from La Sapienza University. After over 15 years of experience in the Unified Communications and Collaboration sector, he joined Genesys in 2025 as a Solution Consultant, helping organizations design and adopt AI-powered customer experience solutions.

speakers.name: Karen Hao
speakers.title: Author of EMPIRE OF AI
speakers.bio: Karen Hao is the author of Empire of AI and an award-winning journalist covering the social impact of AI. She writes for The Atlantic and leads the Pulitzer Center’s AI Spotlight Series. She previously worked for the Wall Street Journal and MIT Technology Review.

speakers.name: Matteo Brusco
speakers.title: Distribution Sales Manager presso N‑able
speakers.bio:

His territories include Italy, Spain, and Portugal. With strong experience in account management and channel ecosystems, Matteo supports partners in optimizing sales strategies and adopting the most suitable solutions for their needs. He works in a remote (Italy-based) setup, collaborating daily with international teams and local stakeholders.

speakers.name: Filippo Maria Del Prete
speakers.title: Chief Technology Officer
speakers.bio: Filippo Maria Del Prete is a technology executive with over 30 years of experience leading software development teams, managing complex projects, and driving digital transformation. As Chief Technology Officer at Adiacent, he defines and oversees the technology strategy, the evolution of ICT systems, and the development of advanced digital experience programs for enterprise and SME clients. His career is distinguished by cross-disciplinary expertise spanning CRM, e-commerce, cloud infrastructures, and knowledge and project management, with a strong focus on delivering scalable, sustainable, and high-business-value solutions.

speakers.name: Rong Yan
speakers.title: CTO at Heygen
speakers.bio: Rong Yan is CTO at Heygen and an expert in large-scale machine learning and data mining. A recognized researcher and team leader, he has expertise in multimedia analysis, advertising optimization, and social media, with awards and international keynote presentations.

speakers.name: Alessandro Rapisarda
speakers.title: Principal Solution Engineer
speakers.bio: Passionate about Computer Science, graduated from the University of Milano-Bicocca. I started my career as a developer, then became an application analyst in Document Management. In 2018, I discovered RPA, and in 2019 I joined UiPath, where I now support clients in adopting agentic automation.

speakers.name: Licia Garotti
speakers.title: Partner Intellectual Property & Technology Law Data Protection & Data Governance Artificial Intelligence
speakers.bio:
Licia Garotti is Partner at PedersoliGattai Law Firm, where she heads the Technology
Law and Intellectual Property department and co-heads the Fintech inter-practice group.
Licia has been used playing a pivotal role in assisting clients on tech-driven and intellectual property matters, either in transactional as well as in contentious matters, also coordinating cross border litigations. Her approach is to provide legal assistance in a proactive manner with regard to IP and IT assets to determine risk factors in current or forecasted businesses such as Artificial Intelligence, Blockchain, and Web 3.0. With the integration of AI and machine learning into more sectors, enhancing everything from healthcare diagnostics to autonomous driving systems, Licia has been actively involved in exploring and implementing new forms of legal protection that go beyond traditional approaches, aiming at better safeguarding innovative and disruptive projects and involving a width range of intellectual property assets.
Licia is lecturer at the International MBA in AI-Driven Business Models at the
Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore in collaboration with ICRIM and has been panelist and speaker at several Tech Law seminars, authored various publications in the field of
AI, patents and copyright for both Italian and European legal magazines and co-authored the work “Responsible AI. A Global Policy Framework”, edited by I TECH LAW, first edition.

speakers.name: Fabio Cappa
speakers.title: Institutional Client Manager at Raiffeisen Capital Management
speakers.bio:
Fabio Cappa combines over 40 years of experience in financial markets and investment banking with an unwavering commitment to sustainability. Active in asset management at Raiffeisen Capital Management, he focuses daily on investments with a rigorous ESG approach.
Despite decades spent analyzing rates and returns, he has avoided the cynicism typical of his industry, evolving instead into a passionate environmental communicator. He is the creator and lead performer of the theatrical production “Non c’è più tempo” (“There Is No More Time”), a project he brings to major Italian theaters, as well as schools, universities, and companies, to raise awareness about the urgent need to act on climate change. The content of the show is entirely his own, developed during approximately four months each year spent traveling the world documenting the consequences of unsustainable practices on the planet.
A firm believer that financial education should be democratic and accessible, he translates complex macroeconomic dynamics for his community of clients and thousands of daily readers. In doing so, he leverages the potential of artificial intelligence models to make finance and economics clear, engaging, and, when appropriate, even lightly ironic.
Neapolitan at heart yet open to change, he lives at the foot of Mont Blanc in “his” Aosta Valley. Every day, he works to demonstrate a simple but powerful idea: finance and ethics can not only coexist, but must join forces to ensure a tangible future for the next generations.

speakers.name: Massimo Cortinovis
speakers.title: Head of Digital
speakers.bio: After playing basketball at a professional level in the early 1990s, I founded a web agency and, since 1995, I have been working on digital strategies, innovation, and marketing across sports and other industries. Since 2022, I have been serving as Head of Digital at LBA – Lega Basket Serie A.

speakers.name: Mattia Simoncini
speakers.title: Director
speakers.bio: Mattia Simoncini is Director at Protiviti. He leads the Digital & Business Performance Improvement solution for the Financial Services sector, guiding clients through digital transformation programs and the adoption of innovative, data-driven technologies to enhance their operating models.

speakers.name: Max Ciociola

speakers.bio: Max Ciociola is the Founder and CEO of Musixmatch, the world’s largest music lyrics platform. He is an entrepreneur in tech and digital music known for merging music data and language to enhance experiences for fans, artists, and developers.

speakers.name: Serman Nerjaku
