speakers.bio: Serman Nerjaku founded Deepser in 2019 with a clear mission: to build a European alternative to the giants of Service Management. Integrated AI, no-code , and a high level of governance. Today, more than 350,000 active users prove him right.

speakers.name: Roberta Russo
speakers.title: Presidente Donne 4.0 | AI Consultant
speakers.bio:
Roberta Russo is the President of Donne 4.0, an association dedicated to support women in their personal and professional development leveraging digital technologies.
She holds a MSc Degree in Electronic Engineer from the Politecnico of Milano and has studied Strategic Planning at the London Business School.In Hewlett Packard for more than 20 years, she has held several leadership positions at Italian and international level in IT and sales roles. She is an AI Consultant, keynote speaker, lecturer on topics related to Artificial Intelligence and AI Ethics.

speakers.name: Vincenzo Piccolo
speakers.title: CEO & Co-Founder
speakers.bio: Vincenzo Piccolo is an entrepreneur and Co-Founder with extensive experience in consulting and management, where he has led high-impact projects by combining strategic vision with execution skills. His professional journey has led him to explore the frontiers of digital innovation, culminating in the co-founding of Callin.io, a voice AI platform that transforms business communication through intelligent agents for inbound and outbound calls. Passionate about technology and artificial intelligence, he believes in AI as a transformative force for businesses and society, contributing today to building a more innovative and competitive entrepreneurial ecosystem.

speakers.name: Nicola Donti
speakers.title: Docente Filosofia  del Linguaggio e Filosofia della Scienza
speakers.bio: Nicola Donti is a philosopher, university lecturer, and trainer specializing in effective communication and life skills. He teaches Philosophy of Language and Philosophy of Science at the University of Perugia and works with public and private organizations as a consultant in interpersonal communication. With over 20 years of experience in training, he combines academic rigor with an experiential approach. He is also a successful content creator, known for promoting critical thinking through a clear and engaging style, and is recognized as an authoritative voice in strategic communication and personal development.

speakers.name: Marco Modonesi

He coordinates research and development activities, turning innovation into concrete and scalable solutions. He also ensures the technical delivery of solutions offered to client companies relying on Increso to transform their customer service.

speakers.name: Giacomo Angelucci

speakers.name: Scott Likens

I suoi numerosi articoli e le apparizioni nei media riflettono il suo impegno verso un approccio all’adozione delle tecnologie emergenti che sia guidato dalla tecnologia ma centrato sull’essere umano. Scott ha iniziato la sua carriera come ingegnere del software agli albori di Internet, per poi lavorare con alcune delle più grandi multinazionali al mondo, applicando una prospettiva locale ai trend globali del digitale e delle tecnologie emergenti. Il suo ampio background tecnologico si è sviluppato nel corso di decenni, durante i quali ha fornito strategie pratiche e ad alto impatto legate alle tecnologie emergenti a organizzazioni in tutto il mondo.

speakers.name: Costantino Cavallo

speakers.name: Giuseppe Santonato

speakers.bio: He leads a team of professionals and consultants supporting organizations in their digital transformation and artificial intelligence adoption journeys.His research focuses on digital sovereignty, AI governance, and the evolution toward agentic and multi-model architectures.He is the author of the Sovereign AI Trilemma framework, which analyzes the Infrastructure Gap, the Data Paradox, and the Scale Trap as systemic barriers to European AI.He regularly speaks in leading international institutional and academic contexts.

speakers.name: Andrea Salvati
speakers.title: Founder

In 2024, he founded Luxia, an AI-based data analytics tool that makes data analysis as simple as a conversation.

speakers.name: Corrado Pavanati

He is an experienced banking and financial executive with a strong background in risk management, responsible for overseeing and managing risk within the Italian operations and contributing to the definition of the group’s control and financial stability strategies in the Italian market. Throughout his career, he has held roles of increasing responsibility in risk management, supporting the evolution of governance models and risk frameworks in complex and international environments.

speakers.name: Claudio Iacopino
speakers.title: Head of Φ-lab Explore Office - European Space Agency

He has an academic background in AI and space engineering and he now leads the Φ-lab Explore lab at the ESA since 2025.

speakers.bio: Master’s degree in Computer Science from Padua, with experience as an external lecturer in distributed computing and NLP. Over 10 years of experience in ML engineering and applied research. I transform research on LLMs and autonomous agents into scalable AI systems and real products.

speakers.name: Elmiro Tavolaro

speakers.bio: CEO and Founder of VT Solutions & Consulting, engineer and tech entrepreneur with over 20 years of experience. Expert in AI, Cloud, Data & Cybersecurity, he leads the development of innovative SaaS products and digital transformation projects for companies and public administrations.

focus is on agentic AI, sovereign private AI approaches, and modern digital workspace architectures with high data protection and governance requirements. speakers.name: Fabio Santini

speakers.name: David Moscato

speakers.name: Chiara Marcati
speakers.title: Chief Applied AI Product Officer
speakers.bio:
Chiara Marcati is a leading voice at the intersection of artificial intelligence, institutional transformation, and digital capability and resilience. As Chief Advisory and Business Officer at AI71, a UAE-headquartered company building agentic, sovereign-grade AI platforms, she leads strategy, ecosystem partnerships, and public-sector advisory across national healthcare systems, infrastructure, and enterprise solutions. Chiara has a particular focus on embedding AI into how institutions operate, decide, and evolve.
With more than two decades of experience, Chiara has a proven track record of mobilizing large, complex organizations (from ministries to multinationals) to move beyond pilots and achieve systemic AI adoption. Her approach combines strategic clarity with operational execution, ensuring AI systems are both thoughtfully designed and sustainably absorbed. Previously, Chiara was a Partner at McKinsey & Company, where she led the QuantumBlack AI practice across EMEA and built a 100+ person AI hub delivering applied AI solutions at scale. Her portfolio included national transformation programs and agentic systems, from LLM-based knowledge platforms to decision-support copilots and digital twins; many of which are now deployed across multiple countries and used daily in live institutional settings.

speakers.name: Davide Pecchia
speakers.title: Trustworthy AI Specialist, Data Ethics Practice
speakers.bio: Davide is a specialist in Trustworthy AI within SAS’s Data Ethics Practice, where he supports platform development and promotes Responsible Innovation practices. As a Data Scientist, he has extensive experience supporting major clients in using data- and AI-based solutions to optimize their business processes. Passionate about technology and a sports enthusiast, Davide is committed to promoting ethical and responsible AI.

speakers.name: Duccio De Rosa
speakers.title: Business Innovation Director
speakers.bio: Leads strategies and programs for innovation and AI integration in companies, helping Italian and international organizations orchestrate technologies, processes, and skills to generate tangible value, operational efficiency, and sustainable long-term competitive advantage.

speakers.bio: Co-founder, General Manager, and Chief Design Officer of the Independent Design Company Logotel. She promotes and fosters methodologies, research projects, and experimentation to explore and test new practices on frontier topics.

speakers.name: Francesco Paolo Schiavone

At Datlas, he leads teams and strategies focused on innovating digital products and services, with an emphasis on generative AI, machine learning, and cloud-native technologies. He also promotes knowledge sharing and thought leadership on LLMs and emerging technologies.

speakers.name: Lucilla Sioli

speakers.bio: Lucilla Sioli is Director of the EU AI Office within DG CONNECT at the European Commission, where she leads activities related to the strategy and governance of artificial intelligence in Europe. In this role, she oversees the implementation of the AI Act, coordinates initiatives to foster trustworthy AI, and promotes international cooperation, contributing to the growth of an innovative and secure European ecosystem. Throughout her career, she has worked on research and innovation programs in key areas such as digital, healthcare, and emerging technologies, supporting the adoption of advanced solutions and driving digital transformation at the European level.

speakers.name: Alessandro Bertoli

speakers.bio: He has over 15 years of experience in the industrial operations sector. He has held various technical and pre-sales roles, allowing him to develop both technical and operational expertise in industrial solutions, including SCADA, IIoT, MES, APM, and EAM. Throughout his career, he has worked to understand and address the needs of different profiles within organizations, from maintenance technicians to production managers, as well as plant directors and C-level executives. He is currently responsible for the portfolio at Factory Software Italia

speakers.name: Fabio Lalli
speakers.title: CEO Iconico / ZeroFive.ai
speakers.bio: An entrepreneur, advisor, and lecturer with 25 years of experience in the digital space, he founded IQUII and later launched ICONICO and ZeroFive.AI—ventures focused on innovation, startup growth, and the strategic implementation of AI in businesses. He is the author of numerous essays, including Digital Skin (Egea, 2026).

speakers.name: Pasquale Viscanti
speakers.title: co-Founder
speakers.bio: He founded “IA Spiegata Semplice”, the largest Italian community—and eponymous podcast—on Artificial Intelligence dedicated to Entrepreneurs and Managers. He is among Italy’s leading experts and speakers on A.I., and his talks aim to foster understanding and awareness of the tremendous potential Artificial Intelligence can bring to the business world. He is also a co-organizer of AI WEEK, the largest event in Europe dedicated to Artificial Intelligence.

speakers.name: Valerio Rizzo
speakers.title: AI Manager, Service and Solutions Group
speakers.bio: Dr. Valerio Rizzo is an AI Senior Manager & Solution Architect at Lenovo and operates within the EMEA AI Center of Excellence. He designs and delivers advanced artificial intelligence solutions for complex scenarios such as football, working on data, computer vision, and decision-making systems.

speakers.name: Stefano Melacci
speakers.title: Associate Professor
speakers.bio: Stefano Melacci is an Associate Professor at the University of Siena (Department of Information Engineering and Mathematics) and a member of the Siena Artificial Intelligence Lab. His research focuses on Machine Learning and Neural Networks, specifically exploring Learning Over Time. After earning his PhD from the University of Siena in 2010 and conducting research at Ohio State University, he gained industry experience at CogniTalk and QuestIT, where he developed natural language processing technologies. A co-author of the book Machine Learning: A Constraint-Based Approach, Melacci served as an Associate Editor for IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems and currently sits on the board of the National PhD Program in AI for Society. He was the Program Chair for CoLLAs 2024 (Conference on Lifelong Learning Agents), organized the 2025 and 2026 Learning Over Time Spring Schools, and is a co-author of the 'Collectionless AI' perspective. Additionally, he is the co-founder and chairman of the startup UNaIVERSE

speakers.name: Luisa Ferrari
speakers.title: Strategy and Solution Director
speakers.bio: Luisa Ferrari has thirty years of experience in the software and digital innovation sector. She currently serves as Solution & Strategy Director at Formula SpA. She is also an Honorary Fellow at the Department of Mechanical and Industrial Engineering of the Università degli Studi di Brescia.

speakers.name: Gabriele Giacomelli
speakers.title: Advisory Solution Consultant
speakers.bio:
Gabriele is an Advisory Solution Consultant at ServiceNow with over four years of experience helping organizations optimize workflows, drive operational efficiency, and align technology with strategic business goals. With a career spanning more than two decades in enterprise software, he has held senior presales and solution engineering roles at companies including Splunk, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, and Borland Software, building a deep expertise in solution architecture, ITSM, and complex enterprise sales cycles.
Recognized as EMEA Presales Consultant of the Year at HPE and a ServiceNow Winners Circle honoree, Gabriele combines technical depth with a strong business acumen rooted in his economics background. Based in Milan, he works fluently across Italian and English- speaking environments, partnering with enterprise clients to deliver measurable outcomes through the ServiceNow platform.

speakers.name: Giacomo Bruno
speakers.title: CEO & Founder
speakers.bio:
Giacomo Bruno is an entrepreneur, author, and CEO & Founder of Bruno Editore, widely regarded as one of the pioneers of digital publishing in Italy. An electronic engineer, he is known for introducing ebooks to the Italian market in 2002, anticipating major global platforms.
Author of numerous bestsellers and a reference figure in personal and professional development, he has contributed to the publication of over a thousand titles and the education of millions of readers. He is also recognized as an expert in innovation and artificial intelligence applied to publishing, supporting entrepreneurs and professionals in building their authority through books.

speakers.name: Marco Carotti
speakers.title: CEO
speakers.bio: Marco Carotti is CEO & Founder of Goinweb.com Srl. He oversees company management and development, coordinating technical and commercial activities while leading marketing strategies and business growth.

speakers.name: Mark Hamilton
speakers.title: Senior Research Scientist
speakers.bio: Mark Hamilton is a machine learning researcher and engineer at Google DeepMind. Previously, he was Principal Engineering Manager at Microsoft, leading SynapseML and bringing advanced ML and generative AI techniques into the company’s major data platforms.

speakers.name: Giulio Lippi
speakers.title: COO & Chief of Product
speakers.bio: For over 20 years, he has been working in brand and product marketing, also focusing on digital transformation, business design, and strategic positioning. Formerly the founder of Edge Technologies (an innovative startup) and StudioEsse Srl (2007–2017), he has collaborated with leading national and international companies.

speakers.name: Andy Detaille
speakers.title: Ambassador of Belgium to Kuwait and Bahrain
speakers.bio: Andy Detaille is Ambassador of Belgium to Kuwait and Bahrain. He represents Belgium in bilateral relations with Gulf countries, promoting political, economic, and cultural cooperation, and strengthening institutional and trade relations in the region.

speakers.name: Gianpaolo Barozzi
speakers.title: VP, Global Chief Technology Officer | People, Policy and Purpose Org
speakers.bio: Gianpaolo Barozzi is a manager and innovator, currently serving as Chief Technology & Innovation Officer within Cisco’s People, Purpose and Policy organization. In this role, he leads global initiatives aimed at identifying emerging signals of change in the world of work and developing technology solutions and experience models that put people, teams, and organizations at the center. Throughout his career at Cisco, he has held various roles in human resources and talent development, contributing to projects related to leadership, innovation, and the transformation of employee experience. His work sits at the intersection of technology, design, and organizational culture, with a strong focus on the future of work and the impact of new technologies on people.

speakers.name: Maria Benedetta Riccelli
speakers.title: Sr Solution Consultant
speakers.bio: Maria Benedetta Riccelli serves as a Sr Solution Consultant in Pre-Sales at ServiceNow, where she partners with Account Executives to plan, fulfill, and serve enterprise customers across their AI-driven transformation journey. Maria works closely with business and IT leaders to demonstrate the value of the ServiceNow AI platform, supporting organizations in unlocking tangible outcomes through digitalization. Maria is a seasoned pre-sales professional with 18+ years of experience across global IT companies, combining deep technical expertise with exceptional communication and public speaking skills. From keynote stages to hands-on workshops, she brings a rare ability to connect complex AI and enterprise platform capabilities to real-world business impact — always with the customer at the center.

speakers.name: Davide Massari
speakers.title: General Manager
speakers.bio: I have been working for almost 20 years on processes, data, and analytics. I help companies use AI in a practical way to optimize their business by creating data-driven solutions. My goal is to turn complex data into real value, every day.

speakers.name: Michela Taccheri
speakers.title: Head of innovation
speakers.bio: I am Head of Innovation at Save the Children Italia. I have been working for years on social innovation, digital transformation, and the experimentation of new intervention models, with a strong focus on impact, collaboration, and the responsible use of technology.

speakers.name: Milena Lerario
speakers.title: CEO
speakers.bio: Milena Lerario, who holds a degree in Aerospace Engineering, has held managerial roles in the space industry in Germany, Spain, and France since 2008. From 2022 to 2024, she served as Chief Executive Officer of Airbus Italy. Since September 2024, she has been Chief Executive Officer of e-GEOS and Senior Vice President of the Geo Information Business Line at Telespazio. She is also Head of the Services Centre of Excellence at Leonardo Space and a Board Member of AVIO.

speakers.name: Omar Parrini
speakers.title: AI Presales Manager
speakers.bio: AI Manager at SDG and global pre-sales lead, bridging business needs with advanced AI. With 9+ years of experience, I design and deploy scalable,agentic architectures across industries. I’m passionate about turning complex AI into sustainable, value-driven applications for global organizations.

speakers.name: Laura Prinzi
speakers.title: General Manager SmartCityLab Milano e Senior Manager Digital Innovation
speakers.bio: Laura Viola Prinzi is Innovation Senior Manager at PwC Italy, within the Innovation team, where she supports transformation and strategic development projects for companies and organizations. She works in the field of innovation and entrepreneurship, with a focus on fostering the growth of innovative solutions and approaches within business environments.

speakers.name: Gian Segato
speakers.title: Data Science Manager for Research
speakers.bio: Gian Segato works at Anthropic. Former founding data scientist and engineer at Replit, he built large-scale data infrastructure, trained SOTA models, and led product growth. Previously, he founded Uniwhere, Italy’s first college career management app used by over 600K students.

speakers.name: Samuel Hirschhuber
speakers.title: Co-Founder & CEO
speakers.bio: 17-year-old Co-Founder and CEO of 241.travel, leading sales and business development. Focused on scaling hotel partnerships and driving revenue. Works closely with the AGI241labs team to integrate AI into a fully automated booking platform.

speakers.name: Carmelo Mariano
speakers.title: Partner, AI Practice Leader
speakers.bio: Carmelo Mariano, with a degree in Business Economics, is a Partner at KPMG and AI Practice Leader. With over 20 years of experience in management and technology consulting, he leads teams supporting companies in their Digital Transformation journeys, helping them create value by leveraging emerging technologies such as IoT, Augmented Reality, and Artificial Intelligence. He is also EMEA Industrial Manufacturing Sector Lead, driving the strategic development of the sector and strengthening KPMG’s presence in manufacturing through thought leadership initiatives, innovative services, and go-to-market strategies.

speakers.name: José Manuel Delgado Blasco
speakers.title: Φ-lab Invest Officer | Earth Observation Expert |
speakers.bio: José Manuel Delgado Blasco holds a double PhD in Geoscience and Remote Sensing from Delft University of Technology (Netherlands) and a Doctor of Science in Geography from KU Leuven (Belgium). He has extensive experience in the Earth Observation domain, with a specialization in algorithm development and parallelization, processing platforms, AI, advanced InSAR applications, data fusion, and algorithm optimization. He currently works as a Geospatial Systems Engineer at the ESA Φ-lab Invest Office within the Earth Observation Commercialisation Programme, supporting companies in the development of sustainable EO solutions.

speakers.name: Claudio Pacini
speakers.title: Chief Operating Officer
speakers.bio: Claudio Pacini is Co-Founder and CEO of ReQurv, specializing in full-stack software development and artificial intelligence solutions. With experience in computer vision, LLMs, process automation, and cloud architectures, he has worked as a developer and AI engineer across various industries. He leads innovation projects, applying advanced technologies to create scalable digital products.

speakers.name: Alex Mashrabov
speakers.title: CEO & Founder
speakers.bio: Alex Mashrabov is the CEO and founder of Higgsfield AI, an AI video generation platform that lets users create cinematic video content from simple text prompts, with control over camera motion and narrative structure. The technology is used by creators and marketing teams for fast, high‑quality productions.

speakers.name: Massimo Chiriatti
speakers.title: Chief Technical & Innovation Officer
speakers.bio:
Massimo Chiriatti is Chief Technical & Innovation Officer at Lenovo, with extensive experience in Artificial Intelligence, ethics, and executive-level communication.
Author of books and articles on AI and blockchain, he has taught at prestigious universities such as Luiss and Università Cattolica.
He helps companies develop strategic frameworks for ethical and human-centered AI adoption.
Co-author of national AI and blockchain manifestos, he serves on government advisory commissions on technology and innovation.

speakers.name: Ekaterina Zaharieva
speakers.title: European Commissioner for Startups, Research and Innovation
speakers.bio: Ekaterina Spasova Gecheva-Zaharieva is a Bulgarian politician serving as European Commissioner for Startups, Research and Innovation. She served as Deputy Prime Minister of Bulgaria from 2017 to 2021 and on two occasions from 2013 to 2014. A member of the GERB party, she also served as Minister of Foreign Affairs from 2017 to 2021, Minister of Justice from 2015 to 2017, Minister of Regional Development on two occasions from 2013 to 2014 and Member of the National Assembly from 2021 to 2024.

speakers.name: Andrea Failli
speakers.title: Co-Founder & Chief Technology Officer
speakers.bio: Andrea Failli is Co-Founder and Chief Technology Officer, with experience in developing digital solutions and scalable cloud architectures. With a technical background as a software engineer and cloud solution architect, he leads technological innovation and the design of digital platforms, contributing to the growth of high-tech products and services.

speakers.name: Mauro Strada
speakers.title: VP & CAIO
speakers.bio: Mauro Strada is Vice President of Impresoft Univerce, where he leads strategic projects focused on digitalization and technological innovation. With solid experience in improving business processes, Mauro Strada is a results-oriented leader committed to supporting companies in adopting advanced solutions to optimize operations and face market challenges.

speakers.name: Davide Manzoni
speakers.title: AI Engineer & Science Communicator
speakers.bio: Davide Manzoni is a bionics engineer specialized in AI, signal processing, and machine learning. At tk.digital, he leads end-to-end AI projects, focusing on computer vision and NLP to build scalable solutions across multiple industries.

speakers.name: Davide Ganito
speakers.title: CTO
speakers.bio: Quindi CTO Davide Ganito is a seasoned software architect and entrepreneur. Founder of the edutech firm VAS at 18, Davide headed the development of 40+ business & manufacturing simulations (Bocconi, PoliMi). Today, he leads product development at Quindi, to foster better plant conversations.

speakers.name: Salvatore Majorana
speakers.title: Presidente
speakers.bio: Salvatore is Director of Kilometro Rosso, the innovation district of Bergamo whose mission is to foster collaboration between companies and research institutions, accompanying the processes of technology transfer and the development of new products. Engineer, MBA from INSEAD and innovation expert, he is President of the International Association of Science Parks and advisor to the CYSERO fund focused on robotics and cybersecurity.  He participated in the design, fundraising and launch of the Eureka! investment fund, which invests in initiatives originating from scientific research in the materials sector to create start-ups in the field of environmental sustainability, mobility and energy.

speakers.name: Oddmund Braaten
speakers.title: Chief Executive Officer
speakers.bio: Oddmund Braaten is the Chief Executive Officer of Interprefy, a global provider of cloud-based multilingual communication solutions for events and meetings. A seasoned business strategist and digital transformation leader, he brings over two decades of experience driving growth, innovation, and operational excellence across multiple industries. Braaten has been instrumental in shaping Interprefy’s commercial and operational success, having previously served as Chief Operating Officer and a board member before being appointed CEO in 2022. Under his leadership, the company continues to expand its global footprint, combining AI powered language technology with human expertise to enable seamless multilingual communication at scale.

speakers.name: Antonio Cattarrossi
speakers.title: AI Transformation Lead
speakers.bio: Business leader specializing in digital transformation, cloud platforms, and customer-centric innovation. With over 20 years of experience across technology, e-commerce, SaaS, and cloud environments, he has led international teams across Europe, including senior leadership roles at Amazon and AWS. Passionate about enabling scalable, AI-driven adoption that improves customer outcomes and operational efficiency, since January 2026 Antonio has been part of Genesys as AI Transformation Lead, working with the partner ecosystem to accelerate the adoption of AI across customer engagement platforms. Antonio holds a degree in Telecommunications Engineering, an MBA, and AWS Cloud certification.

speakers.name: Enrico Conte
speakers.title: Co-Founder
speakers.bio: Enrico Conte has a background in finance and data science. He works on the application of Artificial Intelligence models and workflows to make creative production more scalable, controllable, and consistent. He is co-founder of Thousand Dreams, an Italian AI studio dedicated to the production of audiovisual content.

speakers.name: Mariam Hakobyan
speakers.title: CEO and co-founder
speakers.bio: Mariam Hakobyan is the CEO and co-founder of Softr, the AI platform for building business software. A former engineer turned entrepreneur, she has spent more than a decade building products and leading product and engineering teams, and is passionate about making software accessible to everyone.

speakers.name: Roberto Nicolino
speakers.title: Associate Partner | Innovation Strategist
speakers.bio: Innovation Strategist at Avvale with over 20 years of consulting experience at the intersection of technology, strategy, and business transformation. With a strong technical background in enterprise architecture, CX, and system integration, in his today role he bridges business needs and emerging technologies, driving AI-led transformation for leading organizations.

speakers.name: Lanfranco Morini
speakers.title: Co-Founder & CTO
speakers.bio: CTO and Co-Founder of Vantyx, with 29 years of experience in software development and data-driven architectures. I help companies turn Artificial Intelligence into a competitive advantage, with an approach that integrates technology, strategy, and real impact on business and processes.

speakers.name: Gabriele Fava
speakers.title: Presidente
speakers.bio: Labor and employment lawyer and founder of the law firm Studio legale Fava & Associati, he has over thirty years of experience in labor and industrial relations, as well as corporate restructuring and reorganization. He is an adjunct professor of Labor Law at Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore. He has served as Extraordinary Commissioner of Alitalia and Chairman of Autostrade Alto Adriatico SpA. He was also a member of the Presidential Council of the Corte dei Conti. He is passionate about tennis, a sport he regularly practices.

speakers.name: Massimo Buscema
speakers.title: Scienziato, esperto in reti neurali artificiali e sistemi artificiali adattivi
speakers.bio: Massimo Buscema is Director of the Semeion Research Center in Rome (Italy) and Full Professor Adjoint at the University of Colorado Denver (USA) in the Department of Mathematical and Statistical Sciences. Since 2020, he has also been teaching official courses at IULM University in Milan. He carries out international research and consulting activities in the field of AI theory and applications (artificial neural networks and evolutionary algorithms). He has published more than 300 scientific articles and book chapters, 5 edited books, and is the author of 24 international patents. He is a member of editorial boards and a reviewer for numerous journals, and a consultant for several companies and universities.

speakers.name: Filippo Rinaldi
speakers.title: Solution Consultant
speakers.bio: Solution Consultant specializing in AI-powered customer experience and cloud-based enterprise solutions. With a strong background in Data Science and Artificial Intelligence, he supports enterprise customers in designing scalable, data-driven CX architectures aligned with business goals. He holds a bachelor’s degree in mathematical engineering and a master’s degree in management engineering from Politecnico di Milano, and has a strong interest in AI-driven CX, cloud platforms, and innovation at scale

speakers.name: Mauro Medda
speakers.title: CTO
speakers.bio: Mauro Medda is CTO and Co-Founder of HikmaAI, a startup developing AI security and governance solutions. With nearly 20 years of experience in DevSecOps and enterprise architecture, he has held technical leadership roles in organizations such as Emirates Group, Yoox Net-a-Porter, and Zilliqa Research, managing teams of over 100 engineers. He is currently focused on AI agent security, compliance frameworks, and adversarial testing of artificial intelligence systems. He is an advocate of an AI-first approach to software development and a speaker on topics related to AI security and governance.

speakers.name: Dario Biagio Torrisi
speakers.title: Co-Founder & Head of GenAI
speakers.bio:
Dario B. Torrisi is a Service Designer, Art Director, and Venture Builder. He is an expert in Generative AI with a human-centered approach. He earned a
double international degree in Service Design and Business Innovation at Politecnico di Milano, and conducted research with the Digital Innovation
Observatories, developing an LLM-based bot for co-design teams and design tools for prompting. He is an active member of the San Francisco Codame
ART+TECH community.
In 2025, he founded Dolly: a startup vertically focused on the use of Generative AI for the production of commercial creative content and AI-based operational support for companies in every industry.

speakers.name: Matteo Molteni
speakers.title: Partner Digital Innovation
speakers.bio: Matteo Molteni, who holds a degree in Economics and Business Law from Bocconi University in Milan, is a Partner at PwC and has around 20 years of experience in management consulting, with a focus on process transformation, digital innovation, and business development. He works on complex national and international projects and supports companies and startups in developing new business models, with a particular focus on the opportunities offered by the Space Economy.

speakers.name: John Abel
speakers.title: Managing Director EMEA of the Office of the CTO
speakers.bio: John Abel is Managing Director in the Office of the CTO at Google Cloud, leading AI, modernization, and digital sustainability strategies. He has worked on innovative projects such as FormulaE, Bloodhound SSC, World Bee Project, and SailGP.

speakers.name: Marco Pagani
speakers.title: CEO
speakers.bio:
Marco Pagani is CEO of Lidia, an AI platform for legal professionals and businesses. A lawyer, he works at the intersection of law and technology.
Previously, he worked in M&A and structured finance at Chiomenti and founded WizKey, a startup focused on credit tokenization on blockchain.
He is a recipient of the Ambrosetti Innovation Award 2022.

speakers.name: Lorenzo Lorato
speakers.title: Direttore marketing
speakers.bio: Marketing Director at SatisFactory Group, a company specialized in developing solutions that integrate CRM and artificial intelligence into customer management processes. His focus is on the practical implementation of AI projects and maximizing their business value.

speakers.name: Titina Pignatelli
speakers.title: Product Manager & Vibe coder
speakers.bio: Titina Pignatelli is a Product Manager and Design Thinker with a background in digital product design and UX. For over 15 years, she has worked across technology, innovation, and product culture, exploring how AI and new tools are transforming the way people imagine, design, and build digital experiences, with a particular focus on equity and sustainability.

speakers.name: Fabrizio Grillo
speakers.title: Presidente Federeted Innnovation
speakers.bio: Fabrizio Grillo has gained extensive experience in institutional affairs and international relations, working in both public and private organizations. He has held senior positions at the Municipality of Milan, interacting with the European Commission, the European Parliament, and UNESCO. In these roles, he managed legal, economic, research, policy, and analytical matters, as well as advocacy and fundraising activities in the fields of industrial policy and research and development. Between 2009 and 2016, he was involved in Expo 2015 in Milan and in the Italian Pavilion, serving as Secretary General. In this capacity, he managed relations with participating countries and international organizations (UN, EU, OCSE), fostering new partnerships and delivering major corporate projects. Since 2016, Fabrizio Grillo has been Head of the General Affairs and International Relations Office of the Bracco Group. Since 2024, he has also served as President of Federated Innovation @MIND.

speakers.name: Dario Sabella
speakers.title: CEO
speakers.bio: CEO of the Italian company NEXT G CLOUD (Cloud Security & Edge AI), VP at xFlow Research, Chairman of ETSI MEC, and Board Member of MIT Tech Review Italy. With a strong background at Intel and previously at TIM, he is the author of over 80 publications and holds more than 50 patents. A Senior Member of IEEE, he is a recognized expert in standardization, ICT, and cybersecurity.

speakers.name: Riccardo Frisieri
speakers.title: Co-founder
speakers.bio: Riccardo Frisieri is Co-founder of Increso. He works alongside CEOs and C-level executives to turn technology and innovation into concrete drivers of growth. He leads strategic positioning, offer evolution, business development, and partnerships.

speakers.name: Stefano Perinotto
speakers.title: Senior Advisory Solution Consultant, Workplace Solutions Global GTM Specialist
speakers.bio: Stefano is a Senior Advisory Solution Consultant and Workplace Solutions Global GTM Specialist at ServiceNow. With 11 years of experience, he helps customers and field teams connect platform capabilities to real-world business outcomes across Workplace Service Delivery and Health & Safety. He plays a key role in go-to-market strategy globally, driving solution positioning, enablement, and customer engagement. Passionate about AI, he helps organizations build smarter, safer, and more efficient workplaces.

speakers.name: Jozef Marko
speakers.title: VP Agent Platform
speakers.bio: Jozef Marko, Engineering at ElevenLabs, in his role contributes to the development of software solutions and systems related to artificial intelligence. Throughout his career, he has gained experience in software development and AI systems engineering, contributing to the creation of innovative solutions focused on automation and enhancing human–machine interaction.

speakers.name: Sara Del Bianco
speakers.title: Head of ServiceNow Center of Excellence
speakers.bio: Head of the ServiceNow Center of Competence at DGS, Sara Del Bianco is an expert in digitalization and process automation. She holds a degree in Engineering and has extensive experience in analysis, project management, and business innovation.

speakers.name: Michele Catasta
speakers.title: President & Head of AI
speakers.bio: Michele Catasta is President & Head of AI at Replit, where he led the launch of Replit Agent and helped scale revenue from under $10M to over $100M in months. Under his leadership, Replit has become a global reference in AI-powered app development.

speakers.name: Alberto Frison
speakers.title: Head of Growth
speakers.bio: Quindi Co-Founder & Head of Growth Alberto Frison combines a Bocconi Economics background with IT skills and business strategy experience (PagoPA). A former Research Fellow & MBA TA (SDA Bocconi, Rochester-Bern), he now oversees Quindi’s financial and strategic roadmap to drive commercial growth.

speakers.name: Andrew Salter
speakers.title: Gold Winner at the Runway AI Film Festival
speakers.bio: Andrew Salter, Gold Winner at the Runway AI Film Festival, is a visual storytelling and branding expert. Skilled in trailer and sizzle reel editing, he creates engaging stories quickly, with a focus on natural history, factual, and documentary programming.

speakers.name: Yann Alexandre Petretti
speakers.title: Ecosystem Lead, EMEA
speakers.bio: Yann Alexandre Petretti is a tech professional with around 10 years of experience across startups and scale-ups. He has built go-to-market functions including sales, partnerships and marketing, and currently works on marketing and partnerships at Notion.

speakers.name: Philippa Webb
speakers.company: University of Oxford, Blavatnik School of Government
speakers.title: Professor of Public International Law
speakers.bio: Philippa Webb is Professor of Public International Law at the Blavatnik School of Government and co-founder/director of the Oxford Institute of Technology and Justice. She specializes in human rights, international law, and dispute resolution, focusing on national and global justice systems that support flourishing societies and fundamental rights.

speakers.name: Matteo Angelinelli
speakers.title: Senior HPC Data Engineer
speakers.bio: PhD in numerical astrophysics, specialized in managing datasets and models for AI solutions on HPC infrastructures, he combines technical expertise and operational responsibility, supporting the evolution and efficiency of IT4LIA’s processes.

speakers.name: Andrea Pomponi
speakers.title: Head of Partnerships
speakers.bio: He co-founded DeepAgent to bring Voice AI into Italian enterprises before everyone else did. He manages enterprise partnerships and the agency channel. He is not a technical expert, but he knows when technology truly works.

speakers.name: Francesco Scumace
speakers.title: COO & Innovation AI Consultant
speakers.bio:
COO and AI Innovation Consultant. Leads operational and digital transformation projects, applying Lean Strategy and Artificial Intelligence to business processes.
Focus on efficiency, scalability, and people empowerment.

speakers.name: Lorenzo Romanò
speakers.title: Director
speakers.bio:
Lorenzo Romanò is Director at Protiviti. He leads the Data Science & AI solution for the Industrial, Manufacturing, Energy & Utility, and non-financial services sectors, supporting clients in the adoption of AI and machine learning solutions within their business processes.
He is also responsible for the Protiviti AI Studio in Milan.

speakers.name: Rocco Panetta
speakers.title: Chairman
speakers.bio: Rocco Panetta is Chairman of PANETTA Consulting Group and Managing Partner of PANETTA Studio Legale, as well as a Supreme Court lawyer recognized internationally. He is considered one of Europe’s leading experts in the law of new technologies, data governance, and artificial intelligence strategy. Throughout his career, he has led one of the most specialized teams in Europe on data and AI, providing strategic and legal advice to multinational companies, institutions, and public administrations on the impact of emerging technologies.

speakers.name: Antonio Autorino
speakers.title: Head of AI & Data Sense Strategic Offering
speakers.bio: Head of Data & AI at DGS and GM of BID Company. For 18 years, he has been turning data and technologies into growth levers, guiding companies toward a strategic use of AI. He has executed international projects in Analytics, AI Strategy, Data Governance, and Digital Transformation across key sectors.

sessions.title: Welcome to AI WEEK 2026 | Live Rock Opening Show
sessions.titleIt: Benvenuti alla AI WEEK 2026 | Live Rock Opening Show
sessions.desc: Get ready for the Live Rock Opening Show with Captain Joey Kent, an explosive live performance inspired by the iconic energy and atmosphere of Back to the Future. Expect powerful guitars, timeless rock vibes, and a high-energy opening designed to take the audience on a journey through music, innovation, and pure adrenaline.
sessions.hook: Kick off AI WEEK with a high-energy Back to the Future-inspired live rock show from Captain Joey Kent.
sessions.ideal: All attendees wanting an energizing conference opener

sessions.title: Welcome to the Tech Stage at AI WEEK 2026
sessions.titleIt: Benvenuti nel Tech Stage della AI WEEK 2026
sessions.desc: With Alessia Preda as host, the Tech Stage comes to life: a journey through innovation, real-world use cases, and the technologies shaping the future of AI.
sessions.hook: Open the Tech Stage with host Alessia Preda framing the innovations, use cases, and technologies shaping AI's future.
sessions.ideal: Attendees following the Tech Stage program

sessions.title: Hybrid AI: Why AI in Organizations Is an Organizational, Technical, and Economic Choice
sessions.titleIt: Hybrid AI: perché l’AI in azienda è una scelta organizzativa, tecnica ed economica
sessions.desc: AI cannot exist solely in the cloud or only on-premises. Hybrid AI is emerging as a necessary model to bring AI into production, aligning organizational structure, technical architecture, and economic sustainability. A decision-making framework to generate real value.
sessions.hook: Learn a decision framework for hybrid AI, balancing organization, technical architecture, and economics to bring AI into real production.
sessions.ideal: Tech and business leaders deploying AI at scale

sessions.title: Opening Ceremony
sessions.titleIt: Opening Ceremony
sessions.desc: Pasquale Viscanti and Giacinto Fiore officially open the seventh edition of AI WEEK 2026, the largest AI event in Europe, welcoming attendees to two days dedicated to innovation, artificial intelligence, and the future of business and technology. The Opening Ceremony will be further enriched by a special video message from Ekaterina Zaharieva, European Commissioner for Startups, Research and Innovation.

sessions.title: Agents that learn: a soft actor-critic approach
sessions.titleIt: Agenti che imparano: ​un approccio soft actor-critic
sessions.desc:
At AI Week 2026, we will present an architecture for autonomous, adaptable agentic systems oriented toward continuous learning.
At the core of the solution, reasoning is separated from execution: a first multi-agent system composed of “Actors” and “Critics” collaborates in an adversarial setup to define the action strategy, also leveraging the history of past executions. A second multi-agent system, organized hierarchically, is responsible for execution and real-world implementation through specialized agents and operational functions, known as “Tools”.
The system implements a reinforcement learning paradigm, where evaluating agents compare the generated outcome with user expectations, feeding a global and personalized memory that ensures continuous performance improvement and prevents the repetition of errors.
The infrastructure, which is portable on-premise, guarantees full data sovereignty and security, featuring a modular and LLM-agnostic design that eliminates vendor lock-in risk. Finally, the multi-agent architecture ensures maximum explainability and transparency of decision-making processes, enabling the solution to evolve and scale in close collaboration with end users through co-design.
sessions.hook: Explore a soft actor-critic architecture where Actor-Critic agents plan and a hierarchical system executes for continuous learning.
sessions.ideal: ML engineers and researchers building agentic systems

This talk covers a joint technical case study between Xference, a Sovereign European inference provider, and HikmaAI, showing how we designed a two-stage security architecture, adversarial testing before deployment, and runtime enforcement via the HikmaAI Intelligence Gateway. We walk through the threat model, the validation methodology we used against models and agentic workflows, the attack classes we caught before going live, and the runtime controls that now block prompt injection, jailbreaks, data exfiltration attempts, and policy violations on live traffic. We share real numbers, attacks found, attacks blocked, latency overhead, false positive rates, and without killing private inference performance.

sessions.titleIt: Oltre il copilota: il nuovo modello operativo dell'AI Software Factory di Plenitude

sessions.ideal: Operations and IT leaders scaling enterprise AI.

sessions.title: Business AI supporting enterprise management processes
sessions.titleIt: Business AI al supporto dei processi gestionali dell’azienda
sessions.desc: During the presentation, the latest innovations in SAP Business AI will be showcased, along with how the integration of artificial intelligence within the S/4 system can make business processes more automated, faster, and smarter.
sessions.hook: See the latest SAP Business AI innovations and how S/4 integration makes enterprise processes more automated, faster, and smarter.
sessions.ideal: SAP users and enterprise process and IT leaders.

sessions.title: AI as a decision-making infrastructure: what changes for business decision-makers
sessions.titleIt: L’AI come infrastruttura decisionale: cosa cambia per chi prende decisioni in azienda
sessions.desc: Artificial intelligence is no longer just an operational support, but an infrastructure that structures, guides, and often anticipates decisions within organizations. This talk explores how AI is redefining roles, responsibilities, and decision-making processes at the managerial level. At the core is not only performance, but also risk governance, the quality of decisions, and their traceability. This leads to new needs: adaptive control models, integration between compliance and business, and a real capacity for human oversight. For decision-makers, the challenge is not simply to use AI, but to govern it without delegating decision-making power to it.
sessions.hook: AI becomes decision-making infrastructure, reshaping managerial roles, risk governance, decision quality, and traceability.
sessions.ideal: Business decision-makers and managers governing AI risk.

sessions.title: The thinking territory: how AI and IoT transform distributed data into intelligent decisions
sessions.titleIt: Il territorio che pensa: Come AI e IoT trasformano dati distribuiti in decisioni intelligenti
sessions.desc:
A city produces millions of signals every day: traffic, mobility, environment, consumption, events, and people flows. For years, we have collected this data without truly managing to turn it into decision-making capability. Today, Artificial Intelligence is changing the paradigm: no longer passive dashboards, but territorial systems capable of interpreting context, anticipating phenomena, and suggesting operational actions.
In this workshop, we will explore how the integration of AI, IoT, and Smart Land platforms is redefining territorial governance. From urban mobility management to hydrogeological risk prevention, from predictive analysis of tourist flows to environmental monitoring, we will see how data coming from sensors, mobile networks, infrastructure, and public sources can converge into an intelligent and interoperable ecosystem.
Through real-world cases and live demos, we will show how the territorial Digital Twin evolves from a simple representation of the city into a true cognitive decision-support system.
Because the future of Smart Lands is not about having more data. It is about having territories capable of understanding it.
sessions.hook: AI, IoT, and smart city systems turn millions of urban signals into anticipatory, actionable territorial decisions.
sessions.ideal: Smart city and public sector innovation leaders.

sessions.title: Data2Pocket – Your data assistant, always with you
sessions.titleIt: Data2Pocket - Il tuo assistente per i dati, sempre con te
sessions.desc:
Talk to your data the way you talk to your assistant: ask questions and receive statistical answers and intelligent insights.
This is Data2Pocket, unlimited power for expert users, and ready-to-use simplicity for those who don’t yet know what to ask.
It enables centrally defined questions to be delivered directly to users via push notifications on WhatsApp or a mobile app.
sessions.hook: Meet Data2Pocket: ask questions in plain language and get statistical insights pushed via WhatsApp or mobile app.
sessions.ideal: Business users and data teams wanting accessible analytics.

sessions.title: AI Growth Strategy
sessions.titleIt: AI Growth Strategy
sessions.desc: Il Go-to Market di prodotti e servizi è cambiato per sempre. Cosa c'è da sapere in questa rivoluzione di mercato e quali sono i trend per crescere nel 2026.
sessions.hook: AI has rewritten go-to-market playbooks and which growth trends will drive product and service success in 2026.
sessions.ideal: Founders, marketers and growth leaders planning 2026 GTM

sessions.title: Towards AI that understands the Real World
sessions.titleIt: Towards AI that understands the Real World
sessions.desc:
Recent advances in AI have been driven by large-scale generative models with impressive capabilities in language, code, and digital tasks. Yet these systems still have a limited understanding of the physical world, human intentions, and real-world context.
In this talk, Pascale Fung will discuss the next frontier of AI: world models.
World models allow AI systems to learn abstract representations of the world from continuous multimodal data, enabling reasoning, planning, memory, and action beyond next-token prediction. Moving toward real-world AI agents requires modeling not only the physical world, but also the mental world, including intent, attention, goals, and social context.
The future of AI will depend on systems that can understand, adapt, and collaborate in the real world, safely and reliably.
sessions.hook: Explore world models: how AI learns abstract representations from multimodal data to reason, plan, remember and act in the physical world.
sessions.ideal: AI researchers and leaders tracking the AGI frontier

sessions.title: Evaluating and improving Replit Agent at scale
sessions.titleIt: Evaluating and improving Replit Agent at scale
sessions.desc: Building AI agents that work reliably at scale is one of the hardest challenges in applied AI. In this talk, Michele explores how Replit approaches evaluation and continuous improvement of Replit Agent: the AI-powered coding assistant used by millions of builders worldwide. From designing meaningful evals to closing the feedback loop between real-world usage and model improvements, Michele shares the frameworks, lessons learned, and open questions from operating an AI agent at production scale.
sessions.hook: See how Replit designs evals and feedback loops to keep an AI coding agent reliable at production scale for millions.
sessions.ideal: AI engineers building and operating production agents

sessions.title: When AI Reinvents the Creation of Complex Technical Content
sessions.titleIt: Quando l’AI reinventa la creazione di contenuti tecnici complessi
sessions.desc:
Every aircraft comes with thousands of pages of technical documentation that must be continuously created and updated with accuracy and speed. Today, this process is still largely manual, complex, and prone to errors.
The program developed by Leonardo introduces a system of specialized AI agents supporting technical authors, working together like a digital assembly line: they analyze engineering changes, identify impacts, and generate content compliant with aeronautical standards, ensuring consistency and safety through a proprietary infrastructure that leverages open models to create a sovereign technological solution for the business.
The result is not only greater speed: the technical writer becomes the supervisor of an intelligent process, with full traceability, fewer errors, and higher quality delivered in less time, creating a new way of working.
sessions.hook: Leonardo's specialized AI agents auto-generate aircraft technical documentation compliant with aeronautical standards, like a digital assembly line.
sessions.ideal: Industry leaders automating complex regulated technical content

sessions.title: Alteus Medical: practical AI support for better clinical consultations
sessions.titleIt: Alteus Medical: practical AI support for better clinical consultations
sessions.desc:
Doctors work under constant pressure: limited time, fragmented patient information, and growing documentation requirements. This often reduces time for what matters most, the patient conversation and clinical decision. Alteus Medical is an AI-powered clinical copilot, part of the alteus.ai platform, designed to support doctors before, during, and after consultations. It helps clinicians quickly understand patient context, ask better follow-up questions, and prepare structured draft documentation for review and approval. In this session, we show how Alteus Medical supports three key outcomes: faster access to relevant patient history and medical context. Better consultation flow through contextual AI assistance. Clearer, more consistent doctor-approved documentation with less administrative effort. The presentation also highlights why governance is essential for healthcare AI adoption: privacy, role-based access, auditability, and human clinical oversight are built into the workflow. The goal is practical impact at scale, helping clinical teams work more efficiently while keeping medical judgment fully in the hands of doctors.
togli gli spazi tra paragrafi
sessions.hook: See an AI clinical copilot that gives doctors patient context, better follow-up questions and structured draft documentation before, during and after consultations.
sessions.ideal: Clinicians and health-tech builders improving consultations

sessions.title: Agent Sovereignty
sessions.titleIt: Sovranità Agentica
sessions.desc:
Italian companies are deploying AI agents without knowing where they are going, what they are saying, or what is leaving their perimeter. This is not a technological problem, but a legal and strategic exposure that is already in effect: Mind Breach, AI Act, GDPR, ISO 42001. It will not disappear with the next model.
In this speech, the CEO and CTO of Pupau.ai explain what it means to govern an agentic company today: the difference between deploying agents in production and keeping them under control, and why companies that have already made this leap are turning governance into a hard-to-copy competitive advantage.
The thesis: the 2027 agentic enterprise will not be defined by how many agents it has in production, but by its ability to govern them. Those who build today the cognitive infrastructure with data sovereignty, native auditability, and controlled deployment (on-premise or private cloud) are not just reducing risk. They are building the key differentiator of the next industrial cycle.
With real production use cases: public institutions, industry, large-scale retail (GDO), and professional services.
sessions.hook: Understand the legal and strategic exposure of deploying AI agents, and how to govern an agentic company under AI Act, GDPR and ISO 42001.
sessions.ideal: Executives and CTOs governing AI agents in production

sessions.title: Built to Decide. From AI adoption to the design of intelligent and scalable operating models
sessions.titleIt: Built to Decide. Dall’adozione dell’AI alla progettazione di modelli operativi intelligenti e scalabili
sessions.desc: Nicola Sciumè, CEO of the e-Goals Group, will illustrate how Artificial Intelligence is evolving into a new cognitive infrastructure for businesses, capable of redefining the way organizations interpret complexity, design processes, and make strategic decisions. Through the presentation of proprietary platforms developed for intelligent resource planning (Turn-IT), CRM system migration via AI agents (CRM Agent Port), and educational and career guidance (Deedalo), e-Goals will demonstrate how AI-native architectures can enable increasingly adaptive, scalable, and value-driven operating models. The integration of predictive models, conversational AI, and agent-based systems paves the way for organizations to use artificial intelligence not merely as a business support tool, but as an integral part of their operating model.
sessions.hook: See AI become a cognitive infrastructure for decisions through real platforms for resource planning, AI-agent CRM migration, and career guidance.
sessions.ideal: CDOs and leaders designing intelligent operating models

sessions.title: AI Training and Solutions for Businesses: Discover the New Recurring Business Model
sessions.titleIt: Formazione e Soluzioni AI per le aziende: scopri il nuovo business ricorrente
sessions.desc: In the Artificial Intelligence market, everyone talks about tools, prompts, and automation. But for Italian SMEs, the real challenge is something else: understanding where to start, how to truly apply AI to business processes, and above all, how to turn it into concrete results. In this pitch, you will discover the Zero to AI model: a journey that combines training, strategic assessment, and operational AI solutions to support companies in the real adoption of Artificial Intelligence. We will explore how to transform a simple training activity into a structured, recurring business capable of generating continuous value through business assessments, specialized training, implementation of AI tools, automation, software, and advanced services dedicated to SMEs. We will discuss how the journey is built: from mapping key business areas and internal processes to developing customized roadmaps that help entrepreneurs and teams use AI concretely in marketing, sales, administration, customer care, operations, and internal organization. We will also dive into the commercial and territorial growth model of Zero to AI, designed for professionals, agencies, consultants, system integrators, and entrepreneurs who want to enter one of the fastest-growing markets of the coming years with a ready-made structure, supported by content, methodology, the AI Play platform, and events. A session dedicated to those who want to move from simple “curiosity about AI” to building an ecosystem of services and recurring revenues, becoming a reference point for innovation in Italian SMEs.
sessions.hook: Learn the Zero to AI model combining training, strategic assessment and operational solutions to turn AI into recurring results for SMEs.
sessions.ideal: SME owners and consultants starting real AI adoption

sessions.title: L’AI non capisce niente, ed è per questo che funziona
sessions.titleIt: L’AI non capisce niente, ed è per questo che funziona
sessions.desc: Come usare ChatGPT, Claude, NotebookLM e gli agenti in modo efficace senza trattarli come se fossero magia.
sessions.hook: Use ChatGPT, Claude, NotebookLM and agents effectively by understanding why AI's lack of understanding is exactly what makes it work.

sessions.title: Can AI hack? Benchmarking frontier models against real-world web vulnerabilities
sessions.titleIt: Can AI hack? Benchmarking frontier models against real-world web vulnerabilities
sessions.desc: This is a technically-informed talk focused on measuring the built-in offensive security capabilities of frontier LLMs. Rather than relying on vendor claims or synthetic evaluations, we designed a rigorous, reproducible benchmark: 10 models tested against real Hack The Box challenges spanning the OWASP Top 10, with 10 independent runs per challenge and identical conditions across the board. The talk covers the methodology behind this design, walks through the results , including where models succeed and where they fail.
sessions.hook: See a reproducible benchmark of 10 frontier LLMs against real Hack The Box OWASP Top 10 challenges, with methodology and results.
sessions.ideal: Security engineers and AI researchers testing offensive capabilities

sessions.title: From human language to AGI: what the internal representations of models reveal
sessions.titleIt: Dal linguaggio umano all'AGI: cosa rivelano le rappresentazioni interne dei modelli
sessions.desc:
In 1977, we sent 55 human languages into space. In 2017, a paper by eight researchers made today’s generation of Large Language Models possible. Today, Natural Language Autoencoders can read the internal representations of models.
In that space, between saying and thinking, the next phase toward AGI is unfolding.
sessions.hook: Natural Language Autoencoders read models' internal representations, revealing the space between saying and thinking on the path to AGI.
sessions.ideal: AI researchers exploring model interpretability and AGI

sessions.titleIt: Human vs Artificial Intelligence: theory and Application through BELT for Forecasting
sessions.desc: How can GenAI refine traditional tasks like forecasting? While humans define strategy, AI scales execution. sessions.hook: See how the BELT framework uses foundation models and AI agents to boost forecasting accuracy and shift focus from doing to deciding.

sessions.titleIt: Arsenalia e IVAS Group: come innova una PMI manifatturiera italiana
sessions.desc: A conversation on how innovation truly happens in an Italian manufacturing SMB. sessions.hook: Explore on-premise voicebots that respect privacy and governance, plus VoiShield detecting deepfakes in real time to prevent vishing and fraud.

sessions.title: Shadow AI: controlling the uncontrollable to create value through rules
sessions.titleIt: Shadow AI: controllare l’incontrollabile per creare valore con le regole
sessions.desc: Shadow AI is already present in organizations, often outside IT control but embedded in everyday workflows. Trying to block it is unrealistic the real challenge is to govern it. This session explores how to make the invisible visible, define effective policies, and turn risk into opportunity, while complying with regulations such as the AI Act and GDPR. A pragmatic approach to control the uncontrollable and create value through rules.

sessions.titleIt: Approcci pratici all’Intelligenza Artificiale Generativa tra i principali editori di notizie a livello globale
sessions.desc: News organisations around the world are rapidly integrating generative AI into their workflows, moving from experimentation to practical implementation. This session explores how leading publishers are using AI across the newsroom, from newsgathering and research to content creation, packaging, and distribution. Drawing on real-world case studies, it will highlight the tools, processes, and organisational approaches that are delivering value today. The talk will also examine the challenges of scaling AI responsibly, balancing efficiency with editorial integrity, and identifying where human expertise remains essential.
sessions.hook: Top news publishers apply generative AI across the newsroom, with real case studies, tools, processes and scaling challenges.
sessions.ideal: Media and newsroom leaders adopting generative AI

sessions.title: Ban it or teach it? The AI dilemma in schools, seen by Digital 4 Children
sessions.titleIt: Vietarla o insegnarla? Il dilemma dell’AI nelle scuole, visto da Digital 4 Children
sessions.desc: The debate around artificial intelligence in schools often swings between two extremes: strict bans or open access without guidance. Meanwhile, students are already using it daily, outside any educational framework. In this context, the experience of Digital 4 Children comes into play, bringing digital education programs directly into schools. The focus thus shifts from control to education, from access to AI to how younger generations learn to use it.
sessions.hook: Examine the schools AI dilemma between bans and free access, and how Digital 4 Children shifts the focus toward digital education.

sessions.title: How conversations within a company (especially sales conversations) can become your competitive advantage
sessions.titleIt: Come le conversazioni in azienda (soprattutto quelle di vendita) possono diventare il tuo vantaggio competitivo.
sessions.desc:
Every day, thousands of conversations between salespeople and customers generate valuable data that no CRM captures: real objections, buying signals, recurring mistakes. Globally, conversation intelligence is a billion-dollar market. In Italy, it’s still at zero.
Andrea di Foggia, founder of askmentor, uses real data to show how the systematic analysis of sales conversations makes it possible to identify correlations invisible to the human eye (such as a success rate increasing, for example, from 1% up to as much as 92% when a specific company protocol is followed), generate corrective actions for each salesperson, and fuel marketing with the real language of customers.
Through a practical demonstration, the talk explores why companies that start digitizing their conversations today will build a competitive advantage that is impossible to replicate.
sessions.hook: See how systematic analysis of sales conversations reveals objections, buying signals and hidden correlations no CRM captures.
sessions.ideal: Sales leaders and founders in conversation intelligence

sessions.title: Europe’s digital journey: between AI adoption and technological sovereignty
sessions.titleIt: Il percorso digitale dell’Europa: tra adozione dell’AI e sovranità tecnologica

Through a cross-disciplinary approach, EDTW aims to understand Europe’s positioning in the global landscape in terms of innovation, competitiveness, and digital sovereignty.
Starting from evidence gathered through research involving more than 1,500 companies across 15 European countries, the session will analyze the state of digital technology adoption within large European organizations, highlighting the continent’s level of readiness in relation to the objectives set by the European Union in the race to develop a European AI ecosystem, considered a key element for maintaining and strengthening competitiveness in a rapidly evolving global context.

An invitation to understand AI not simply as a technical innovation, but as a cultural phenomenon capable of redefining what it means to be human in the digital era.

sessions.title: Panel: Building an AI Valley in Italy: Vision, Strategies, and Reality
sessions.titleIt: Panel: Costruire una AI Valley in Italia: visione, strategie e realtà
sessions.desc:
AI Valley evokes demanding references and was not chosen by chance, even if it requires a bit of imagination to fully grasp.
Times are moving fast, and often there is no time to reflect , we are constantly forced to chase what comes next. But today, let’s try to pause for a moment within this context so rich in stimuli. Can Italy truly build a solid AI ecosystem? And if so, how, with whom, and by learning from what?

sessions.titleIt: Sport, Intelligenza Artificiale e Salute Pubblica: la nuova frontiera delle politiche regionali.
sessions.desc:
Sport is no longer just physical activity or entertainment: today it represents a strategic tool for economic growth (contributing to a territory’s GDP), social development, and increasingly a driver of public health, prevention, and the medium- to long-term sustainability of healthcare systems.
This talk will explore how Artificial Intelligence can transform regional sports policies through the intelligent use of data, health prevention, the analysis of sedentary behaviors, and the personalization of public interventions.

sessions.title: From dynamo to co-thinker: why your AI isn’t working yet
sessions.titleIt: Dalla dinamo al co-thinker, perché la vostra AI non sta ancora funzionando
sessions.desc:
When factories first gained access to electricity, for decades they simply replaced the steam engine with a dynamo, same factory, same layouts, same belts. Productivity didn’t move. The real leap came only when a new generation of entrepreneurs had the courage to tear down the factory and rebuild it from scratch around the electric motor.
Today, with artificial intelligence, we are in the dynamo phase. Companies buy copilots and layer them onto unchanged processes: AI summarizes, generates drafts, answers questions. Useful, but it’s not transformation, it’s cosmetic automation. The real discontinuity has a name: moving from co-pilot to co-thinker. Not a faster assistant, but a system that enters the decision-making process, understands context, reasons about implications, and raises risks no one in the room is considering.
This will be illustrated through a case every company knows: a strategic procurement. A multi-million contract, eleven months of negotiation, thirty people at the table, and a liability clause hidden on page 47 that none of the thirty noticed. The co-thinker did. We will see how, concretely: specialized agents, structured organizational memory, and a workflow where AI doesn’t assist the team but thinks alongside the team. Those leaving this talk will have a framework to understand whether their company is using AI like a dynamo, and what it takes to rebuild the factory.
sessions.hook: See why bolting copilots onto unchanged processes fails, and how to rebuild your company around AI like factories rebuilt around electric motors.
sessions.ideal: CEOs and leaders rethinking organizational design around AI

sessions.title: The carbon ROI of AI. How much does Artificial Intelligence cost in CO2? What benefits does it generate instead? The first quantitative study on Italian SMEs.
sessions.titleIt: Il ROI carbonico dell'AI. Quanto costa in CO2 l’Intelligenza Artificiale? Quali sono in guadagni che invece ne derivano? Prima indagine quantitativa sulle PMI italiane
sessions.desc: Generative AI is presented as an ally of the transition: it optimizes consumption, predicts waste, and accelerates ESG reporting. But every query to a language model consumes energy. Global data centers could double their electricity consumption by 2030, with an estimated carbon footprint of between 32 and 80 million tons of CO₂ in 2025 alone. Around 60% of the new electricity demand from data centers will be covered by fossil fuels. No one has ever measured this paradox at the level of individual Italian companies. This white paper does so for the first time: through an analysis of companies and sectors, it assesses the net carbon impact of AI adoption, comparing the emissions generated by the use of AI tools (infrastructure, computing, cloud) with the emissions saved thanks to the efficiency gains enabled by AI itself (logistics, energy, processes). The result is a “carbon balance sheet of AI” by company type, size, and sector, accompanied by future scenarios.
sessions.hook: Get the first quantitative study measuring AI's CO2 footprint versus its benefits in Italian SMEs, with real carbon ROI numbers.
sessions.ideal: Sustainability leads, ESG analysts, founders weighing AI impact

Artificial Intelligence connects symbols and produces results; Spiritual Intelligence connects meanings and preserves purpose. sessions.title: NeuroForge
sessions.titleIt: NeuroForge
sessions.desc:
What if training were no longer designed, but generated?
In a context where skills become obsolete increasingly quickly, traditional training models are no longer sufficient. NeuroForge introduces a new paradigm: a system in which artificial intelligence does not merely support learning, but builds it, adapts it, and evolves it in real time. Starting from existing knowledge, a network of AI agents transforms static materials into dynamic learning experiences, generating multimodal content and structured learning paths in moments. But the real shift happens during learning itself: users interact with an intelligent system that understands context, responds in a targeted way, and guides the exploration of information. Training thus becomes a living experience. Thanks to an adaptive gamification engine, every piece of content becomes an interactive environment that evolves based on the learner’s actions, mistakes, and progress. The AI observes, learns, and continuously modifies the path, making it increasingly personalized, effective, and relevant. It is no longer the user who adapts to the course.
It is the course that adapts to the user. NeuroForge redefines the very concept of learning: from a static process to an intelligent, continuous, and generative system.
sessions.hook: See how a network of AI agents generates and adapts training in real time, turning static materials into dynamic learning.
sessions.ideal: L&D, HR and corporate training innovators

sessions.title: Patient & Treatment Digital Twin – Accelerating and improving decision-making in the era of Generative AI
sessions.titleIt: Patient & Treatment Digital Twin - Accelerare e migliorare il decisioning al tempo della Generative AI
sessions.desc:
What if it were possible to interact with a digital patient and anticipate insights before they emerge in reality?
Digital Patients transform Generative AI into a tool for simulating clinical scenarios, understanding needs and behaviors, and supporting decision-making in the Life Sciences sector. A new way to innovate medical education, healthcare strategy, and high-value insight generation.
sessions.hook: Digital patient twins use generative AI to simulate clinical scenarios and accelerate Life Sciences decision-making.
sessions.ideal: Healthcare, pharma and life sciences decision-makers

sessions.title: From clustering to action: how agentic AI transforms retail from reactive to autonomous
sessions.titleIt: Dal cluster all’azione: come l’AI agentica trasforma il retail da reattivo ad autonomo
sessions.desc: Every retailer knows the pain of margins eroded by promotions and of customer loyalty that never quite takes off. Starting from a real case of a fashion e-commerce, we will show how AI-driven customer segmentation based on clustering is already capable today of mapping precise behavioral patterns, from high-spending customers to “opportunity seekers.” But the real revolution begins when AI stops observing and starts deciding. We will explore the evolution toward Agentic AI, capable of making the entire marketing and CRM cycle autonomous: agents that update clusters in real time, generate hyper-personalized communications, and orchestrate recovery campaigns to intercept at-risk customers before it is too late. We will conclude with a necessary reflection on governance and the AI Act: your CRM knows who your customers are, but does your AI already know what to do, and when to do it autonomously? A talk designed for C-level executives who want to see how AI can move from data to action, in compliance with the AI Act and algorithmic accountability.
sessions.hook: See a fashion e-commerce case where clustering segmentation evolves into agentic AI that autonomously decides retail actions.
sessions.ideal: Retail, e-commerce and data science professionals

sessions.titleIt: AI-Powered Procurement. Driving Efficiency and Value with AI
